title: Sr. Business Analyst - Finance Systems
jd_text: McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care. What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you. About the Role McKesson is seeking a Senior Product Manager, Finance Systems & ERP Transformation to help modernize and optimize Finance technology capabilities across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Financial Close, Reporting, and related Finance processes. In this role, you will partner with Finance, Accounting, Decision Intelligence, Technology, and business stakeholders to translate business needs into clear requirements, product priorities, and scalable system solutions. This role is ideal for a finance systems product leader who understands ERP platforms, financial operations, data quality, reporting, controls, and Agile delivery. You will own and prioritize the Finance Systems product backlog, support roadmap planning, and help prepare the organization for future ERP transformation initiatives, including SAP S/4HANA. What You’ll Do Serve as a key liaison between Finance stakeholders and technology teams to translate business needs into actionable requirements, user stories, and delivery outcomes. Manage and prioritize the Finance Systems product backlog, including epics, features, acceptance criteria, release readiness, and stakeholder communication. Partner with Finance leaders to evaluate, optimize, and standardize processes across GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Financial Reporting, Budgeting, Forecasting, and Close. Lead requirements gathering, process mapping, gap analysis, solution design, and business case development for Finance systems initiatives. Support ERP transformation readiness, including SAP S/4HANA planning, process alignment, UAT, change management, adoption, and business readiness. Collaborate with engineering, data, analytics, integration, vendor, and platform teams to deliver scalable Finance reporting, data quality, and automation improvements. Define Finance data quality, reconciliation, validation, reporting, lineage, and acceptance criteria to support trusted financial information. Support change control, release governance, SOX-aware requirements, auditability, and operational readiness for Finance system enhancements. Basic Requirements 7+ years of experience in Finance Systems, Business Analysis, Product Management, ERP implementations, Finance transformation, or related roles. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience with Finance processes such as General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Financial Reporting, Budgeting, Forecasting, or Financial Close. Experience gathering, documenting, and managing business requirements, process flows, functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Experience managing or contributing to product backlogs, roadmap priorities, sprint planning, backlog refinement, UAT, and release readiness. Experience working with ERP platforms such as PeopleSoft Financials, SAP S/4HANA, or comparable enterprise Finance systems. Experience analyzing current-state processes, designing future-state solutions, and driving measurable process improvement. Experience partnering with business stakeholders, technology teams, vendors, and implementation partners to deliver Finance systems enhancements. Preferred Skills/Experience Experience supporting large-scale ERP implementations, Finance transformation, SAP S/4HANA programs, cloud modernization, or enterprise system upgrades. Knowledge of Finance data warehousing, data integration, semantic layers, business intelligence, reporting modernization, or analytics platforms. Experience defining Finance data quality rules, reconciliation needs, validation logic, reporting requirements, and business acceptance criteria. Familiarity with SOX-aware requirements, audit controls, change control, release governance, and data integrity practices. Experience with Enterprise Performance Management tools, including Oracle Essbase or similar budgeting, planning, forecasting, and management reporting platforms. Experience in healthcare, oncology, provider networks, life sciences, or other regulated environments. Strong facilitation, communication, stakeholder management, and executive-facing presentation skills. Travel, Work Environment and Physical Requirements Primary location: Houston, TX; secondary location: Dallas, TX. This is a standard professional office/computer-based role requiring frequent use of business systems, collaboration tools, and virtual or in-person stakeholder meetings. title: Principal Business Systems Analyst, Oracle Supply plan (ASCP)-Remote
jd_text: A Day in Your Life at MKS: As a Principal Business Systems Analyst, Supply Planning you will develop and implement Information Technology and management information systems within the Oracle eBusiness Suite of applications. You will partner with the business system analysts, business users and technical teams, to ensure full adoption, effective usage, and efficient deployment of our IT solutions. You will manage the change control process, gather end-user requirements, involve in developing, test, implement, support and maintaining IT solutions in Oracle EBS environment. In this role, you will report to the Director, IT Business Systems. You Will Make an Impact By: Act as a liaison between business teams and IT to elicit ideas and requirements, provide guidance and validate requirements for application changes. Collaborate with global teams on the design, development, deployment, and enhancement of Oracle R12 eBusiness Suite applications. Collaborate with Supply Chain Planning, Operations, Procurement, and analytics stakeholders to understand needs, identify pain points, document requirements, drive design and solution. Lead the development of functional specifications, implementation, maintenance, and support for Supply chain within Oracle EBS. Drive techno-functional solution design and integration with upstream and downstream systems. Provide technical leadership leveraging Oracle configuration expertise and best practices for Supply chain business functions. Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for Oracle Supply Planning. Partner with cross-functional business groups to implement new or improved processes for IT-related business, financial, and operational systems critical to organizational success. Travel Requirements: Up to 5% of Travel is required. Skills You Bring: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Supply Chain or other 4-year degree focusing on information technology or equivalent. 8+ years of experience in a senior or principal business analyst or similar role. Experience with Oracle EBS R12 Supply Chain module, specifically Supply planning. Experience optimizing demand planning, supply planning, inventory planning, supply collaboration areas by working with business stakeholders, DBAs, Technical teams, and other SMEs. Experience developing supply planning insights within Oracle EBS and collaborating with external analytics teams Strong techno-functional experience in designing and supporting integration between Oracle EBS and external systems using APIs, middleware, EDI, concurrent programs, and file-based interfaces. Experience supporting Oracle EBS R12 in a global manufacturing and distribution environment. Career path demonstrating growth and handling complex initiatives. Very strong communication skills and ability to synthesize complex issues into business language. Preferred Skills: Experience with Advanced Supply Chain Planning (ASCP) is required. Experience with Oracle Value Chain Planning (VCP) is nice to have. Working exposure to Financials (GL, AP, AR) and Supply Chain Planning process interactions. Experience leveraging with AI capabilities within Oracle EBS is a strong nice to have. Exposure to Oracle Fusion Supply chain cloud is a nice to have. Physical Demands and Working Conditions: . Ability to take and follow directions and instructions. Ability to interact with other employees, customers, suppliers, vendors, or the public, in a safe, professional, and respectful manner. Access to sensitive and confidential business systems and software, personally identifying information, the company’s financial information, and/or the ability to maintain physical security and safety. Because this position involves the above material job duties, trustworthiness, reliability, and good judgment also are material job duties. Compensation and Benefits Salary Pay Range: $109,750.00 – $182,900.00 per year. This range is a good faith estimate of the expected salary range for this position, based on a wide range of factors including qualifications, experience and training, operational and business needs, and other considerations permitted by law. Bonus: This position is eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, in an amount to be determined by MKS. Benefits: MKS offers a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance coverage (medical, dental, and vision), 401(k) with company match, life and disability insurance, 12 paid holidays, sick time, 15 paid vacation days, fully paid parental leave, adoption assistance, and tuition reimbursement, along with opportunities for career growth and development in a collaborative and innovative environment. title: Senior Escrow Product Manager
jd_text: Overview: M&T Bank is seeking a strategic and execution-oriented Escrow & Virtual Account Management (VAM) Product Manager to lead the growth, modernization, and commercialization of our escrow and virtual account solutions. This role is responsible for defining product strategy, delivering new capabilities, managing the product roadmap, and ensuring that M&T's escrow and VAM offerings meet the evolving needs of commercial clients across multiple industry segments. The successful candidate will combine deep product management expertise with strong commercial banking knowledge to deliver differentiated solutions for clients requiring fund segregation, reconciliation, liquidity optimization, and operational efficiency. This position serves as the central point of accountability across Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, Legal, Treasury Management, and Sales teams to successfully design, launch, and enhance escrow and virtual account solutions. Primary Responsibilities: Product Strategy & Market Leadership: Develop and execute the strategic roadmap for Escrow and Virtual Account Management solutions. Identify emerging client needs, industry trends, competitive threats, and fintech opportunities. Define product positioning and value propositions across Commercial Banking, Business Banking, and specialized vertical markets. Establish multi-year product vision aligned with M&T's deposits, liquidity, and treasury management strategies. New Capability Development: Build business cases, secure funding, establish success metrics, and manage prioritization. Partner with Technology and Agile delivery teams to execute product initiatives. Drive capabilities such as: Self-service virtual account administration Virtual account-to-physical account reconciliation Enhanced reporting and analytics Treasury workstation and ERP integrations API connectivity Automated funding and sweeps Real-time payments and liquidity functionality These initiatives align with existing roadmap priorities including reconciliation tools, Treasury Center integration, balance reporting, Direct Connect integration, and enhanced escrow reporting. ​ Market Segmentation & Client Differentiation: Design product strategies tailored to the unique needs of distinct customer segments, including: Commercial Real Estate Property Management Attorney Trust Accounts Municipal Escrow 1031 Exchange Intermediaries Funeral Escrow Providers Leasing & Security Deposit Providers Large Corporate Treasury Organizations Franchise and Multi-Entity Businesses The Product Manager will be responsible for understanding the operational workflows, regulatory requirements, reconciliation challenges, and reporting needs unique to each segment and ensuring solutions are designed accordingly. M&T's escrow offering currently supports multiple specialized escrow structures across these client types. Virtual Account Management Solution Design: Lead the evolution of M&T's Virtual Account Management platform. Responsibilities include: Designing virtual account hierarchies and account structures. Defining cash concentration and fund segregation models. Supporting treasury visibility and liquidity optimization. Developing reporting and reconciliation frameworks. Building client-controlled virtual account administration capabilities. Enhancing integration with Treasury Center, APIs, ERP platforms, and treasury workstations. Supporting real-time information delivery and account governance. Commercialization & Revenue Growth: Partner with Treasury Management, Sales, Segment Management, and Marketing teams to drive product adoption. Develop pricing, packaging, and go-to-market strategies. Create sales enablement materials and client-facing value propositions. Support large prospect opportunities and strategic client engagements. Risk, Compliance & Operational Excellence: Ensure products operate within all regulatory, legal, and risk management requirements. Partner with Legal, Compliance, Operations, and Audit functions. Drive operational efficiency and scalability. Identify process improvement opportunities that enhance both client and employee experiences. Success Measures: The Escrow & VAM Product Manager will be accountable for: Growing escrow and VAM revenue Increasing product adoption and client penetration Delivering new roadmap capabilities on schedule Improving client satisfaction and retention Reducing operational complexity and servicing costs Enhancing competitive differentiation in target markets Improving treasury visibility and reconciliation outcomes for clients Education and Experience Required: Bachelor’s degree 7 years’ proven product management experience in commercial banking, treasury management, liquidity solutions, or payments. OR in lieu of a degree, A combined minimum of 11 years’ higher education and/or work experience, including a minimum of 7 years Proven product management experience in commercial banking, treasury management, liquidity solutions, or payments. Education and Experience Preferred: Experience with: Escrow services Virtual Account Management ZBA and Sweep solutions Treasury Management platforms ERP integrations Commercial deposit products Knowledge of commercial real estate, property management, legal trust, and fund administration workflows Proven experience launching and commercializing new banking or fintech capabilities. Experience managing cross-functional product delivery initiatives. Strong understanding of commercial deposit and liquidity products. Demonstrated ability to create product roadmaps and business cases. Experience working with Technology, Operations, Risk, and Sales organizations. M&T Bank is committed to fair, competitive, and market-informed pay for our employees. The pay range for this position is $107,500.00 - $179,100.00 Annual (USD). The successful candidate’s particular combination of knowledge, skills, and experience will inform their specific compensation. The range listed above corresponds to our national pay range for this role. The specific pay range applicable to you may vary based on your location. Location Clanton, Alabama, United States of America

title: Marketing Automation Systems Analyst

title: Technical Product Support Consultant- Curam
jd_text: The Company Curam by Merative empowers governments around the world to deliver smarter, faster, and more compassionate social services. For more than 25 years, Curam has helped national, regional, and local governments modernize social programs, equip caseworkers with powerful tools, and connect individuals and families to the support they need. Trusted across 12 countries and jurisdictions, available in 14 languages, and supporting more than 970 government programs, the Curam platform helps protect and serve 187 million people annually—from large-scale national modernization initiatives to mission-critical child welfare and social care systems. This isn’t just software—it’s the digital safety net that helps communities thrive. We are currently looking for a Technical Product Support Consultant to join the team now! As a Technical Product Support Consultant, you thrive on solving complex technical challenges and delivering exceptional customer experiences. In this role, you'll serve as a trusted technical advisor, partnering with customers and cross-functional teams to investigate, resolve, and prevent issues across the Curam platform. *Position is Remote, but flexibility to participate in on-call rotations and occasional after-hours support is required. Key Responsibilities Own and resolve complex customer issues from investigation through resolution. Deliver advanced technical support for Curam applications and related technologies. Act as an escalation point for critical customer concerns, partnering closely with Development, Product Management, and Release teams. Analyze logs, technical data, and application behavior to identify root causes and recommend solutions. Communicate clearly and proactively with customers, providing regular updates and managing expectations. Document troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and best practices to strengthen internal and customer knowledge. Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance support processes, tools, and customer outcomes. Continuously expand your expertise in Curam, cloud technologies, AI and enterprise application support Skills and Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Experience with Java/JEE and technologies such as SQL, XML, XSL, and JavaScript. Knowledge of relational databases, including IBM Db2 and Oracle. Experience troubleshooting enterprise applications, analyzing logs, and debugging complex issues. Customer-facing support experience and a passion for delivering outstanding service. Understanding of software development lifecycles and Agile practices. Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities with a high level of ownership and independence. Willingness to participate in on-call support rotations. Preferred Skills Experience with Curam. Knowledge of cloud platforms and architectures. Experience with WebSphere, WebLogic, or similar enterprise application servers. Familiarity with REST and SOAP services and integration troubleshooting. Exposure to modern development tools and frameworks, including React, Eclipse-based environments, and UML modeling tools. title: Sr. Analyst, Statistical Forecast & Accuracy
jd_text: McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care. What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you. Position Summary The Sr. Analyst, Statistical Forecast & Accuracy is an individual contributor within the Demand Planning team, reporting directly to the Consensus Demand Planning Lead. This role is the technical authority for the statistical forecast that underlies the consensus plan. The Sr. Analyst is accountable for ensuring the system produces a reliable, accurate baseline forecast across portfolios, and governing forecast performance over time. This role intervenes when the engine produces outputs that do not reflect reality, manages model parameters and bias across portfolios, and drives the continuous improvement discipline that makes the consensus forecast credible and defensible. This is a technical role that requires deep proficiency in statistical forecasting methods, hands-on expertise in Kinaxis Maestro, and the judgment to distinguish a model problem from a demand reality problem. The Sr. Analyst must be able to translate statistical findings into clear, actionable guidance for the Consensus Demand Planning Lead. Key Responsibilities Statistical Forecasting & Model Governance Own the configuration and maintenance of statistical forecast parameters in Kinaxis Maestro, including model selection and parameter tuning. Apply history cleansing disciplines prior to each forecast cycle, adjusting for outliers, customer losses, NDC switches, and new product launches to ensure the statistical baseline reflects true underlying demand patterns. Intervene directly when the system produces outputs that are wrong: update model parameters, alter model selection, and document the rationale for every change so that interventions are traceable and auditable. Serve as the primary point of contact for the COE on statistical forecast configuration, parameter governance, and planning engine integrity questions. Forecast Accuracy & Bias Management Own the forecast accuracy and bias measurement framework across all portfolios, tracking MAPE, bias, and error metrics at the appropriate level of granularity to surface actionable insights rather than just headline numbers. Conduct structured root cause analysis on forecast misses, distinguishing between model failure, enrichment failure, and genuine demand variability, and communicating findings clearly to the Consensus Demand Planning Lead and Channel Leads. Identify and flag systematic bias in the statistical forecast, whether directional over- or under-forecasting by product type, channel, or time horizon, and drive model adjustments to correct it. Maintain a continuous improvement cadence, tracking accuracy trend over time and holding the team accountable to improving against a defined baseline as the system matures and data quality improves. Partner with Channel Leads to determine whether a forecast miss originated in the statistical baseline or in enrichment inputs, and prepare forecast performance reporting for S&OP reviews facilitated by the COE, ensuring accuracy findings are visible to cross-functional participants and tied to operational implications for supply and inventory. Minimum Requirement Degree or equivalent and typically requires 7+ years of relevant experience. Education Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field strongly preferred or equivalent experience. Critical Skills 7+ years in demand planning, supply chain analytics, or a related field, with demonstrated hands-on experience owning statistical forecast configuration and model governance in a production planning environment. Direct experience working in Kinaxis Maestro, including parameter configuration, model selection, and demand planning engine operation. Experience in a comparable advanced planning system (SAP IBP, Blue Yonder, o9) considered with a clear expectation of rapid Maestro proficiency. Demonstrated ability to diagnose and correct statistical forecast failures, including history cleansing, outlier management, and model parameter adjustment. Proven ability to build and maintain a forecast accuracy and bias measurement framework, including root cause analysis and continuous improvement tracking. Configuring, maintaining, and intervening in Kinaxis Maestro to ensure the statistical forecast engine produces reliable outputs across all portfolios. Applying disciplined cleansing and data preparation so that the statistical baseline reflects real demand patterns rather than data noise. Diagnosing forecast failures with precision, distinguishing model problems from enrichment problems from genuine demand variability, and routing accountability correctly. Building and sustaining a bias management discipline that improves forecast quality over time rather than accepting persistent error as unavoidable. Operating as the technical anchor for a team that is otherwise oriented toward commercial and market judgment, without creating a bottleneck or a knowledge silo. Additional Skills Experience operating within a structured S&OP or consensus planning process, including preparing performance reporting for cross-functional review. Familiarity with pharmaceutical, healthcare, or wholesale distribution demand dynamics is a strong plus, particularly experience with product lifecycle events, NDC switches, and new business onboarding that create history anomalies. Comfort operating in ambiguity and building process structure where governance is still maturing, particularly in the context of a large-scale system transition where baselines and benchmarks do not yet exist. Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders, including explaining why the system produced a wrong output and what was done to fix it. Physical Requirements Traditional office requirements. A large percentage of time performing computer-based work is required. Hybrid role, must live near Las Colinas office. Up to 5% travel. The selected candidate is expected to work on-site at our Las Colinas office a minimum of two (2) days per week , with the remaining days worked remotely. Specific in-office days may be designated based on team needs and business priorities. We are proud to offer a competitive compensation package at McKesson as part of our Total Rewards. title: Sr. Analyst, Consensus Demand Planning – (Channel Lead)
jd_text: McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care. What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you. Job Description Position Summary The Sr. Analyst, Demand Planning Channel Lead is an individual contributor within the Demand Planning team, reporting directly to the Director, Consensus Demand Planning. This role serves as the senior demand planning subject matter expert for an assigned channel, leading the development of demand planning methodologies, driving strategic forecast improvements, and influencing cross-functional decision making that impacts inventory, service, and financial outcomes across the enterprise. This role serves as the subject matter expert on their channel's demand dynamics, translating external signals, and near-term order patterns into forecast inputs that improve the accuracy and reliability of the consensus plan. This role requires both analytical depth and strong cross-functional partnership skills; this individual must be comfortable working inside Kinaxis Maestro and engaging with cross functional stakeholders to build the alignment that a credible consensus forecast requires. Key Responsibilities Market Intelligence & Enrichment Own the process of identifying, evaluating, and incorporating external demand-side signals for the assigned channel into the statistical baseline forecast, including macroeconomic trends, payer policy changes, healthcare system dynamics, and geopolitical disruptions that could materially affect product demand. Monitor the external environment on an ongoing basis for the assigned channel, proactively surfacing signals that warrant a forecast adjustment rather than waiting for downstream teams to flag the impact. Ensure all enrichments are documented and traceable so that forecast decisions can be explained, audited, and used to improve future enrichment quality over time. Lead the development and continuous improvement of demand enrichment methodologies, standards, and governance practices across demand planning. Evaluate emerging market trends and industry developments, translating insights into forecasting strategies and planning assumptions. Provide guidance and consultation to planners and business partners regarding the interpretation and application of external demand signals. Long Range Consensus Forecasting Own the channel-level demand inputs into the long-range consensus forecast, aligning signals from cross functional partners into a single agreed-upon view in Kinaxis Maestro for the assigned channel. Extend the planning horizon beyond near-term views for the assigned channel, ensuring that forward-looking demand assumptions are reflected in the consensus plan and available to support supply and inventory decisions across a meaningful planning window. Maintain active relationships with cross functional partners for the assigned channel, ensuring that demand-relevant intelligence is flowing into the planning process on a timely and structured basis rather than arriving ad-hoc. Facilitate resolution of complex cross-functional demand planning issues where business priorities, supply constraints, and forecast assumptions require executive-level alignment. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance forecast accuracy, forecast efficiency, and planning capabilities across the broader organization. Represent Demand Planning in strategic planning discussions and provide recommendations that influence long-term inventory and capacity decisions. Prepare channel-level demand assumptions packages that are ready for presentation in S&OP reviews facilitated by the COE, ensuring the framing is clear and the key assumptions are visible to cross-functional participants. Demand Sensing Monitor short-term order patterns, shipment data, and near-real-time demand signals for the assigned channel to identify deviations from the statistical baseline that require immediate forecast adjustment. Refine near-term forecasts on a rolling basis using demand sensing inputs, reducing the lag between market reality and the plan without waiting for the next monthly consensus cycle. Apply clear thresholds for when a demand sensing signal for the assigned channel is material enough to trigger an off-cycle forecast update versus being held for the next scheduled planning cycle. Ensure near-term demand sensing outputs for the assigned channel are visible and actionable in the weekly S&OE cycle, flagging operationally significant deviations before they create inventory or service risk. Develop and refine demand sensing frameworks, exception management criteria, and planning best practices used across planning teams. Anticipate emerging risks and opportunities by identifying demand pattern shifts before they materially impact business performance and proactively recommend mitigation strategies. title: Software Product Manager - Integrated Systems
jd_text: It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing! Software Product Manager Location: Remote Position Summary The Software Product Manager is responsible for defining and leading the strategy, roadmap, delivery, adoption, performance, and lifecycle of assigned software products and platform capabilities. This role serves as the voice of the customer and market, translating validated user problems, business objectives, product data, technical constraints, and competitive insights into clear outcomes, prioritized investments, and executable plans. As a key member of the Platform Product Management team, the Software Product Manager owns assigned software products and platform capabilities from problem discovery and business-case development through delivery, launch, adoption, optimization, and retirement. This position is accountable for establishing a compelling product vision, defining measurable outcomes, and making evidence-based prioritization decisions that improve customer value, revenue growth, retention, operational efficiency, and strategic differentiation. The Software Product Manager works closely with Product Design, Engineering, Architecture, Data, Quality Assurance, DevOps, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Regulatory, Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Support, and regional teams. Success in this role requires the ability to lead through influence, balance customer and business needs with technical considerations, and enable agile teams to deliver secure, scalable, accessible, and supportable software solutions. Essential Functions Define and communicate product vision, strategy, target customers, value proposition, positioning, and measurable objectives in alignment with portfolio and company goals. Lead continuous product discovery through customer interviews, workflow observation, usage analysis, market research, competitive analysis, and concept or prototype validation. Translate validated customer problems and strategic opportunities into outcome-based roadmaps, product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, release goals, and prioritized backlogs. Apply consistent prioritization methods and make clear tradeoffs across customer value, business impact, delivery effort, technical health, risk, and time to learning. Partner closely with Engineering and Product Design throughout discovery and delivery to clarify intent, reduce ambiguity, review progress, and adapt scope based on learning. Define product and feature success measures, instrumentation, and dashboards. Evaluate adoption, activation, engagement, retention, customer satisfaction, product quality, cost-to-serve, and revenue impact. Run experiments and post-launch reviews, using customer feedback and product data to determine whether to iterate, scale, reposition, or discontinue investments. Own the full software product lifecycle, including release planning, launch readiness, adoption, maintenance, migrations, deprecation, end-of-life planning, and customer communications. Partner with Engineering, R&D, Portfolio Owners, Quality Assurance, Security, Privacy, and Regulatory teams to incorporate scalability, reliability, interoperability, data governance, compliance, accessibility, supportability, and technical debt into product decisions. Guide platform, API, integration, data, and entitlement decisions to support cohesive customer workflows and sustainable product architecture. Develop business cases and contribute to pricing, packaging, forecasting, investment planning, and build-buy-partner recommendations. Lead go-to-market and release-readiness planning with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Support, Training, and regional teams. Support positioning, enablement, documentation, migration, and adoption planning for new and existing software capabilities. Provide concise, decision-oriented updates regarding outcomes, roadmap changes, dependencies, risks, assumptions, and tradeoffs to customers, delivery teams, stakeholders, and senior leaders. Promote modern product management practices, responsible and ethical use of data and AI where applicable, and a culture of customer empathy, accountability, learning, and continuous improvement. Perform other duties as assigned. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Product Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, Design, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 3+ years of software product management experience. Experience owning customer-facing software, SaaS products, enterprise applications, digital platforms, or data products from discovery through post-launch optimization. Demonstrated experience delivering software capabilities and improving measurable customer or business outcomes. Experience with product discovery, product strategy, roadmapping, prioritization, requirements definition, agile product delivery, launch management, adoption, optimization, and lifecycle planning. Experience developing product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, release goals, and prioritized product backlogs. Experience working with cross-functional Engineering, Design, Quality, Security, Data, Commercial, Customer Success, and Support teams. Ability to define and track product KPIs and use data to evaluate customer behavior and product performance. Technical understanding of modern software concepts including cloud services, APIs, integrations, data models, identity and access management, observability, release pipelines, and architectural tradeoffs. Strong written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder communication skills. Ability to influence without direct authority and create alignment across cross-functional and distributed teams. Ability to navigate ambiguity and manage competing priorities. Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and product collaboration tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, Figma, Miro, Power BI, or comparable platforms. Schedule flexibility to collaborate with international teams across multiple time zones. Preferred Qualifications Experience with B2B software products, regulated industries, laboratory workflows, food safety, connected instruments, or global products. Experience using SQL, product analytics tools, or business intelligence platforms to evaluate product performance. Experience analyzing funnels, cohorts, experiments, adoption metrics, and customer behavior. Working knowledge of secure software development, privacy by design, accessibility, regulatory or quality requirements, and operational resilience. Experience supporting platform, API, integration, data, or entitlement strategy. Experience with pricing, packaging, forecasting, investment planning, or build-buy-partner analysis. Strong commercial acumen with an understanding of how product decisions affect revenue, retention, margin, customer value, and cost-to-serve. Experience leading go-to-market, release-readiness, customer migration, and product adoption initiatives. Experience with responsible use of artificial intelligence, data, or emerging technologies within software products. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Strong customer empathy and product judgment. Ability to identify meaningful customer problems and define measurable desired outcomes. Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills. Ability to balance customer desirability, business viability, technical feasibility, usability, reliability, and risk. Strong understanding of software product development and agile delivery practices. Ability to translate complex technical and business concepts into clear product direction. Strong project and stakeholder management capabilities. Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership. Strong problem-solving, prioritization, and decision-making skills. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Physical Demands There are no significant physical demands associated with this role. Work Environment This position is remote. The employee is responsible for maintaining an appropriate remote work environment that allows them to perform the essential functions of the position effectively. title: Senior Product Manager,
jd_text: About Us: insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate. We empower leaders from over 32,000 organizations to make timely and intelligent decisions. Our comprehensive solutions span Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Controllership, and Data and Analytics. We deliver finance teams the insights required to navigate any economic climate and drive greater financial intelligence, while increasing productivity, visibility, accuracy, and compliance. Learn more at insightsoftware.com. Job Description: We are seeking a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the product strategy and execution for the AI Services team at insightsoftware . This is a dedicated product role for a team that already builds the agentic capabilities, tool and connector layer, and AI quality infrastructure that the entire insightsoftware portfolio depends on. You will take the roadmap from a shared responsibility across engineering leadership and make it your own — setting direction, sequencing the work, and driving it to delivery. AI Services is one of our most visible and strategically important programs. It operates as a shared service, which means our internal customers are the product teams across the insightsoftware portfolio, and our end customers are the finance and accounting professionals who use their products every day. This role is a senior individual contributor position: you will work as a peer to our chief architect and engineering manager, go deep on technical design decisions, and write the specifications, evaluation criteria, and enablement material yourself. Success requires someone who has built agentic systems in production, not someone who has only read about them. What Will You Do? Own the AI Services Roadmap: Define and maintain the strategy, roadmap, and quarterly priorities for agentic workflows, the tool and connector layer, and AI quality infrastructure. Make the trade-off calls on sequencing, scope, and technical direction, and defend them with evidence. Define Agentic Capabilities in Depth: Specify multi-step agent behavior — planning, tool selection , memory, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, fallback paths, and guardrails. Translate ambiguous business problems into agent designs that are reliable enough to put in front of finance users. Drive the Tool and Connector Strategy: Own the roadmap for our Model Context Protocol (MCP) surface and tool interfaces. Decide which insightsoftware data, actions, and product capabilities are exposed to agents and third-party assistants, and define the contracts, versioning, and access controls that make them safe to consume. Establish AI Quality as a Product Discipline: Build and own the evaluation framework for AI features — golden datasets, offline and online evals, regression harnesses, accuracy and hallucination measurement, and production observability. Set the quality bars that gate release and hold the team to them. Enable Consuming Product Teams: Treat portfolio product managers and their engineering teams as your customers. Run intake, document integration paths, publish reference implementations and adoption guidance, and measure whether teams are successfully building on AI Services rather than around it. Partner Deeply with Engineering and Architecture: Work daily with the chief architect and engineering manager on design reviews, technical trade-offs, model and vendor selection, and cost and latency management. Participate in sprint planning and refinement, and unblock the team on product decisions in hours, not weeks. Measure and Communicate Outcomes: Define the metrics that show whether AI Services is working — adoption across product lines, agent task success rates, eval scores, cost per task, latency, and incident rates. Report them to senior leadership with a clear read on what to do next. Manage AI Risk and Trust: Work with security, legal, and compliance to address data handling, model governance, auditability, and customer trust concerns before they become launch blockers. language model applications to production — not prototypes or internal demos Working technical fluency in agentic architectures : orchestration and planning patterns, tool and function calling, enterprise systems Practical experience building or operating evaluation frameworks for AI systems, including how to construct datasets, choose metrics, and interpret results Experience delivering a shared platform or API-based service where other product teams are the primary consumers Ability to read code, reason about system design, and hold your own in architecture discussions with senior engineers Strong command of Agile delivery, with the judgment to know when process helps and when it gets in the way Ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders without formal authority Excellent written communication — this role produces specifications, decision records, and enablement documentation that others rely on Bachelor's degree in Computer Science , Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience Preferred Qualifications: Experience taking AI capabilities to market in a B2B enterprise SaaS environment, including packaging, pricing input, and sales enablement Background in enterprise finance, accounting, ERP, or business intelligence domains Experience managing inference cost, latency, and model routing across multiple providers at scale Familiarity with AI security, data residency, and regulatory considerations for enterprise customers Prior experience as the first product hire on a team, establishing product practice where none existed Contributions to open source AI tooling, published evaluation work, or an active public presence in the agentic AI community Why This Role Matters Every insightsoftware title: Appian Forward Deployed Product Owner
jd_text: Overview: The Wilmington Trust Institutional Services (IS) division is experiencing rapid business growth and has initiated a strategic digital transformation program. The goals of the program are to grow revenue through new and transformed digital-first trust and agency service products, to move from a product-centric to client-centric operating model, to move from market-specific to global solutions, and to dramatically lower the cost to serve. Wilmington Trust is seeking an Appian Forward Deployed Product Owner to help accelerate digital transformation across our core operations. This role is designed for an experienced product, business analysis, or transformation professional who can operate close to business users, translate operational needs into deployable digital workflows, and help lead iterative delivery in a regulated financial services environment. This role is a hybrid between a product owner, business analyst, low-code workflow designer, and AI-enabled process lead, with a strong focus on designing and configuring end-to-end workflows directly in Appian Designer. The role requires hands-on Appian experience , strong business process and analytical skills, and the ability to partner across business, operations, technology, risk, and product stakeholders to move quickly from discovery to working solutions. While working closely with individual business teams, the role will maintain a platform-first mindset by leveraging shared capabilities, reusable components, and consistent design patterns rather than creating isolated or duplicative solutions. Ideal candidates will be comfortable owning product outcomes, facilitating working sessions, writing stories and specifications, validating build quality, and using AI-assisted tools to accelerate analysis, documentation, prototyping, testing, and workflow improvement. The successful candidate will be able to work forward-deployed with business teams while maintaining strong product discipline, governance, and delivery rigor. Primary Responsibilities: Design, configure, and improve business process workflows using Appian Designer, with a focus on speed to value, user-centric design, reuse of shared platform capabilities and patterns, governance, and operational control. Partner closely with business product owners, operations leaders, technology teams, and risk partners to gather requirements, map processes, define user needs, and prioritize workflow improvements. Own and manage product backlog items, including authoring, refining, and grooming user stories, acceptance criteria, specifications, process flows, UI concepts, test scenarios, and release-ready requirements. Lead stakeholder working sessions to define current-state and future-state workflows, identify friction points, iterate on MVP designs, resolve issues, and drive alignment across business and technology teams. Evaluate business requirements to identify opportunities for reuse across workflows and business areas, and partner with platform and technology teams to determine when an existing capability should be reused or extended before creating a new solution. Use AI-assisted and agentic AI tools to accelerate discovery, process analysis, requirements documentation, story drafting, workflow prototyping, test case generation, defect analysis, and delivery communications. Focus on outcomes over outputs, incorporating design thinking, analytics, business process engineering, and user feedback to inform product decisions and continuous improvement. Support QA, UAT, regression testing, and production validation by defining test scenarios, validating builds, documenting defects, gathering issue resolution requirements, and confirming readiness for release. Partner with technology teams on integration points, data dependencies, security considerations, platform constraints, and production support needs. Keep current with Appian capabilities, including Appian AI, Case Management Studio, RPA, data fabric, reporting, and platform governance, and recommend opportunities to apply new capabilities responsibly. Champion a platform-first approach and Appian best practices around governance, reusability, modular design, shared patterns, versioning, packaging, maintainability, and controlled delivery in a regulated environment. Participate in agile ceremonies, including daily standups, planning sessions, backlog refinement, demos, and retrospectives. Build and maintain Appian reports and dashboards to track workflow performance, user activity, operational quality, and business metrics; partner with senior stakeholders to define meaningful KPIs. Understand and adhere to the Company’s risk and regulatory standards, policies and controls in accordance with the Company’s Risk Appetite. Identify risk-related issues needing escalation to management. Promote an environment that supports belonging and reflects the M&T Bank brand. Maintain M&T internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators as applicable. Complete other related duties as assigned. Education and Experience Required: Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 10 years’ business, analytical, technical, digital product, transformation, or product ownership experience, or in lieu of a degree, a combined minimum of 14 years’ higher education and/or relevant work experience, including a minimum of 10 years’ business, analytical, technical, digital product, transformation, or product ownership experience. Hands-on experience with Appian, including experience building, configuring, testing, or supporting workflows, forms, interfaces, records, process models, reports, dashboards, or related Appian objects. Experience in financial services and/or fintech, including exposure to regulated business processes, operational risk, client service, banking, wealth management, trust services, payments, capital markets, lending, compliance, or similar domains. Experience operating as a product owner, product analyst, business analyst, transformation lead, or workflow designer in an agile or iterative delivery environment. Experience writing detailed, actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, specifications, process flows, business rules, UI concepts, testing scenarios, or release documentation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to structure ambiguous problems, assess operational impacts, analyze data or process evidence, and recommend practical solutions. Exposure to QA, UAT, regression testing, defect triage, test case development, production validation, or other solution quality practices. Working knowledge of AI-assisted tools or agentic AI concepts and the ability to use AI responsibly to improve analysis, documentation, testing, prototyping, or workflow delivery. Ability to bridge business and technical teams, translating needs into executable solutions and explaining technical constraints, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs to stakeholders. Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to facilitate working sessions, present recommendations, document decisions, and drive alignment across teams. Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and deliver in a fast-paced, regulated transformation environment. Education and Experience Preferred: Appian Level 1 or higher certification, or equivalent hands-on experience with Appian Designer. Familiarity with SAIL expressions for configuring dynamic forms, validations, conditional logic, and reusable interface patterns. Understanding of Appian object reusability, versioning, packaging, release management, performance considerations, and platform governance best practices. Experience with Appian AI, Case Management Studio, Appian RPA, data fabric, connected systems, integrations, or document management workflows. Experience delivering business-specific workflows on a shared platform and identifying opportunities to reuse or extend common capabilities across multiple use cases. Experience using agentic AI or AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Open Claw, Hermes, or similar tools to support product analysis, prototyping, testing, documentation, or automation. title: Sr. Analyst, Customer Demand Planning
jd_text: McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care. What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you. Position Summary The Sr. Analyst, Customer Facing Demand Planning sits within the demand planning organization, part of the Supply Chain Inventory Planning team and serves as the primary owner of customer–level demand execution for assigned accounts. This role reports to the Director of Customer Facing Demand Planning. They execute the customer-specific demand remit for the assigned accounts, managing inventory positioning, and service levels at the account level, while capturing and qualifying inbound demand signals including new product launches, and translating that customer intelligence back into the consensus planning process. Key Responsibilities Customer Demand Execution Maintain the customer portfolio for assigned accounts, managing formulary changes, product switches, and customer-specific inventory positions to ensure the customer-product data feeding into demand planning accurately reflects current program commitments and account relationships. Own sequestration for assigned accounts, creating and maintaining inventory buckets, assigning the correct customer accounts to each program, and coordinating with DC inventory teams to move product and discontinue sequestered item numbers as needed. Execute customer-specific award switch management for assigned accounts, updating the demand signal, adjusting the forecast for outgoing items, loading anticipated demand for incoming items, and coordinating with key stakeholders to confirm timing before transitions go live. Manage new customer onboarding for assigned accounts, including tracking, analysis, inventory builds, allocation planning, coverage reporting, SL queries, and omit analysis to ensure readiness for go-live. Manage customer-facing calls and relationships within the context of customer demand for assigned accounts, handling ad-hoc inquiries, SL questions, and contractual requirement tracking to ensure compliance and customer satisfaction. Demand Signal Intake & Translation Capture and qualify demand intelligence from assigned accounts, translating customer-specific signals including new product launches, promotional activity, program changes, and account-level shifts into structured forecast inputs, operational rules, and purchasing inputs that are consumable by the consensus demand planning team. Monitor and manage upstream demand inputs for assigned accounts, including program changes, new launch items, promotional activity, and customer-specific shifts, ensuring they are captured proactively and reflected in the plan before they create a supply risk. Own the handoff of enriched demand signal inputs from assigned accounts to the consensus demand planning team, ensuring inputs are complete, documented, and delivered on time within the monthly planning cycle. Maintain an active working relationship with the consensus demand planning team, ensuring demand signal inputs for assigned accounts are understood, accepted, and incorporated into the consensus forecast without delays or misalignment. Service Level Reporting & Analytics Create, publish, and monitor service level reports for assigned accounts, provisioning SL tracking metrics and ensuring that performance data is accurate, timely, and actionable for both internal planning teams and customer-facing stakeholders. Conduct root cause analysis on service level escalations for assigned accounts, identifying precipitating events, distinguishing supply-side from demand-side causes, and providing education and context to sales teams and customers to support sell-side conversations. Create queries and reports from multiple data sources to support data-driven decisions for assigned accounts, producing dashboards and insights that drive adjustments and surface emerging service risk before it becomes a customer issue. Process Improvement & Project Management Lead process improvement initiatives within the assigned account set, owning at least one project per year focused on improving demand accuracy, customer experience, or operational efficiency within the team. Define and maintain templates, forms, and intake documentation for assigned accounts, reducing email churn and rework by ensuring that requests from customers and internal partners arrive in a structured, actionable format. Identify and escalate process gaps or systemic friction points within the assigned account set to the Director, providing a clear description of the issue and a recommended solution. Minimum Requirement Degree or equivalent and typically requires 7+ years of relevant experience. Education Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Data Analytics or related field, or equivalent experience. Critical Skills Functional proficiency in Kinaxis Maestro or comparable advanced planning system. Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills. Demonstrated experience managing customer programs, sequestration models, or high-touch account relationships. Managing a high-volume, operationally intensive account portfolio with precision, ensuring that customer commitments, program changes, and demand signal inputs are handled accurately and on time. Translating customer intelligence into structured, high-quality demand signal inputs that improve forecast accuracy and reduce supply risk for assigned accounts. Conducting root cause analysis on service level misses with enough depth and accuracy to equip sales teams and customers with credible, well-framed explanations. Building and maintaining trusted relationships with customers and cross-functional partners while maintaining the objectivity required to challenge demand signals that do not reflect system or market reality. Adapting quickly to new system capabilities and ways of working, including Kinaxis Maestro, and maintaining execution quality on assigned accounts through the transition. Additional Skills Experience managing sequestration programs, or high-touch strategic customer inventory models is a strong plus. Experience managing customer onboarding processes. Comfort managing a high volume of concurrent account activities with precision, prioritizing effectively when multiple issues require simultaneous attention. Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to engage customers and sales teams directly and translate supply chain complexity into clear, actionable context. title: Manager, Supply Chain
jd_text: Menasha Corporation Employees, please log-in to your Workday account to apply for positions. ABOUT US (AND OUR EXCITING FUTURE) Menasha Corporation is all about possibilities. Our two businesses, Menasha Packaging and ORBIS Corporation, are leaders in their industries, providing corrugated and plastic packaging products and related services to major global companies. Our employees make the difference, proving that great ideas, collaboration and quality turn possibilities into success. Working at Menasha Corporation means that your insights provide cutting-edge solutions for our customers. If you like to make things happen and are passionate about what you do, you’re going to want to be here. Join us and become part of the power behind possible. About The Opportunity Manage purchasing, warehousing, cycle counter (inventory), and maintaining the production capacity plan that best supports the origination area in the plant. Analyze capacity, production speed, and lead times. Work with vendors and Master Scheduler to determine the best solution for the business to manage capacity, inventory and provide outsourcing alternatives. Move work around the network to level load plants and assets accordingly. Key Duties and Responsibilities: 1. Analyze forecast data, annual usage and historical data to pre-plan for changes in volume and pre-plan activities to support changes accordingly. 2. Monitor plant schedules and review MRP results to ensure purchased components and inventory are optimized and available when needed. 3. Monitor plant schedules and open backlog to optimize weekly availability, lead times, and shipping attainment. 4. Determine optimal inventory levels to maximize service levels while minimizing costs and maintaining inventory accuracy. 5. Assist operations team in optimizing production flow. 6. Support and drive continuous process improvement in support of the ORBIS Quality Policy. 7. Other duties as assigned. Performance Measures and Outcomes: 1. Ensure acceptable supply lead times in line with asset base capability. 2. Maintain acceptable inventory levels consistent with business service and working capital goals. 3. Ensure timely asset/order moves to meet business needs. 4. Monitor schedule attainment and scheduling practices ensuring in-line with business goals. 5. Cycle count attainment and accuracy. Education/Certification: Level Required - Bachelor's Degree; Description - Experience may be considered in lieu of education. Required - 3-5 years in demand planning or production scheduling. Desired - 5-7 years in demand planning or production scheduling. Additional Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: 1. Strong communication and organizational skills. 2. Basic understanding of MRP, Material Master Settings, and SAP. SAP knowledge and understanding is highly desired. 3. Proficient in Microsoft Excel. 4. Proficiency in diplomatic communication. 5. Demonstrates effective multitasking and prioritization skills. 6. Demonstrates adept analytical skills for identifying and resolving problems. 7.
