title: Assistant Manager, Logistics
jd_text: Job Title: Assistant Manager, Logistics Location: Rewari, India We are seeking an Assistant Manager, Logistics to lead and coordinate end-to-end logistics and shipping operations that ensure the timely, compliant, and cost-effective movement of materials and finished goods. In this role, you will partner with Customer Service, Planning, Warehouse, Sales, Transporters, Freight Forwarders, and Customs partners to support business requirements and customer commitments. Working at the intersection of supply chain execution, transportation management, and trade compliance, you will drive operational excellence across domestic and international logistics activities while supporting continuous improvement, cost optimization, and digitalization initiatives. What you will get: Opportunity to play a key role in managing end-to-end logistics and transportation operations that directly impact customer satisfaction and business performance. Exposure to domestic and international logistics, including freight forwarding, customs processes, import/export operations, and trade compliance activities. Ownership of logistics performance management through KPI monitoring, cost optimization initiatives, and service provider governance. Cross-functional collaboration with Customer Service, Planning, Warehouse, Operations, Sales, Procurement, and external logistics partners. Opportunity to drive logistics digitalization, process standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives within a global supply chain environment. Experience working with ERP/SAP systems, transportation management processes, and logistics analytics to support operational decision-making What you will do: Plan and execute day-to-day logistics and shipping activities in line with customer requirements, dispatch priorities, and business objectives. Coordinate with Customer Service, Planning, Warehouse, Sales, and Operations teams to ensure timely shipment execution and customer deliveries. Manage vehicle planning, freight booking, shipment consolidation, route selection, and shipment tracking to achieve service, productivity, and cost targets. Coordinate shipment loading and dispatch readiness while ensuring compliance with product handling, transportation, safety, and quality requirements. Ensure timely closure of transportation documentation, proof of delivery (POD) tracking, and resolution of shipment-related exceptions and claims. Manage freight forwarding, customs clearance, and import/export documentation activities while ensuring regulatory compliance. Ensure shipping documentation accuracy and compliance with applicable Customs, DGFT, FEMA, Incoterms, and company requirements. What we are looking for: Proven experience in logistics, transportation, shipping, warehousing, and supply chain operations. Strong understanding of dispatch planning, freight management, shipment documentation, and logistics execution processes. Experience working with transporters, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and third-party logistics providers. Working knowledge of import/export operations, Customs regulations, DGFT requirements, Incoterms, and trade compliance practices. Strong analytical, problem-solving, negotiation, and stakeholder management capabilities. Experience monitoring logistics KPIs, freight costs, transportation performance, and service provider effectiveness. Proficiency with SAP ERP systems (SD/MM preferred), Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and logistics reporting tools. Ability to work effectively across multiple functions and manage priorities in a fast-paced operational environment. At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

title: Appian Forward Deployed Product Owner (Bond Management)
jd_text: Overview: The Wilmington Trust Institutional Services (IS) division is experiencing rapid business growth and has initiated a strategic digital transformation program. The goals of the program are to grow revenue through new and transformed digital-first trust and agency service products, to move from a product-centric to client-centric operating model, to move from market-specific to global solutions, and to dramatically lower the cost to serve. Wilmington Trust is seeking an Appian Forward Deployed Product Owner to accelerate the modernization of Bond Management capabilities and the operational workflows supporting Corporate Trust products and services. This role is designed for an experienced product, business analysis, or transformation professional who can operate close to business users, translate operational needs into deployable digital workflows, and help lead iterative delivery in a regulated financial services environment. This role combines Product Ownership, business process transformation, and hands-on Appian workflow design responsibilities within a regulated financial services environment. The role requires hands-on Appian experience, strong business process and analytical skills, and the ability to partner across business, operations, technology, risk, and product stakeholders to move quickly from discovery to working solutions. Ideal candidates will be comfortable owning product outcomes, facilitating working sessions, writing stories and specifications, validating build quality, and using AI-assisted tools to accelerate analysis, documentation, prototyping, testing, and workflow improvement. Primary Responsibilities: Design, configure, and improve business process workflows using Appian Designer, with a focus on speed to value, user-centric design, reuse, governance, and operational control. Lead business process discovery across Bond Management operations, including debt servicing, transfer agent, paying agent, waterfall accounting, and exception management processes. Identify automation opportunities, document current state pain points, and establish baseline measures for effort, cycle time, exception volume, straight-through processing, and control effectiveness. Define value hypotheses, business outcomes, and success measures to guide workflow prioritization, backlog decisions, and benefit realization. Apply Appian to modernize Bond Management workflows across debt servicing, transfer agent, paying agent, waterfall accounting, exception management, and related operational control processes. Partner closely with business product owners, operations leaders, technology teams, and risk partners to gather requirements, map processes, define user needs, and prioritize workflow improvements. Own and manage product backlog items, including authoring, refining, and grooming user stories, acceptance criteria, specifications, process flows, UI concepts, test scenarios, and release-ready requirements. Lead stakeholder working sessions to define current-state and future-state workflows, identify friction points, iterate on MVP designs, resolve issues, and drive alignment across business and technology teams. Build, configure, and maintain workflows in Appian Designer, leveraging out-of-the-box components wherever possible to accelerate delivery, support consistency, and reduce the need for custom development. Use AI-assisted and agentic AI tools to accelerate discovery, process analysis, requirements documentation, story drafting, workflow prototyping, test case generation, defect analysis, and delivery communications. Own assigned Bond Management workflow outcomes from discovery through configuration, validation, pilot adoption, and post release optimization; establish baselines and measure realized improvements in straight-through processing, exception volume, cycle time, manual effort, control effectiveness, and user adoption. Support QA, UAT, regression testing, and production validation by defining test scenarios, validating builds, documenting defects, gathering issue resolution requirements, and confirming readiness for release. Partner with technology teams on integration points, data dependencies, security considerations, platform constraints, and production support needs. · Keep current with Appian capabilities, including Appian AI, Case Management Studio, RPA, data fabric, reporting, and platform governance, and recommend opportunities to apply new capabilities responsibly. Champion Appian best practices around governance, reusability, modular design, versioning, packaging, maintainability, and controlled delivery in a regulated environment. Participate in agile ceremonies, including daily standups, planning sessions, backlog refinement, demos, and retrospectives. Build and maintain Appian reports and dashboards to track workflow performance, user activity, operational quality, and business metrics; partner with senior stakeholders to define meaningful KPIs. Understand and adhere to the Company’s risk and regulatory standards, policies and controls in accordance with the Company’s Risk Appetite. Identify risk-related issues needing escalation to management. Promote an environment that supports belonging and reflects the M&T Bank brand. Maintain M&T internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators as applicable. Complete other related duties as assigned. Education and Experience Required: Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 10 years’ business, analytical, technical, digital product, transformation, or product ownership experience, or in lieu of a degree, a combined minimum of 14 years’ higher education and/or relevant work experience, including a minimum of 10 years’ business, analytical, technical, digital product, transformation, or product ownership experience. Hands-on experience with Appian, including experience building, configuring, testing, or supporting workflows, forms, interfaces, records, process models, reports, dashboards, or related Appian objects. Experience in financial services and/or fintech, including exposure to regulated business processes, operational risk, client service, banking, wealth management, trust services, payments, capital markets, lending, compliance, or similar domains. Experience operating as a product owner, product analyst, business analyst, transformation lead, or workflow designer in an agile or iterative delivery environment. Experience writing detailed, actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, specifications, process flows, business rules, UI concepts, testing scenarios, or release documentation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to structure ambiguous problems, assess operational impacts, analyze data or process evidence, and recommend practical solutions. Exposure to QA, UAT, regression testing, defect triage, test case development, production validation, or other solution quality practices. Working knowledge of AI-assisted tools or agentic AI concepts and the ability to use AI responsibly to improve analysis, documentation, testing, prototyping, or workflow delivery. Ability to bridge business and technical teams, translating needs into executable solutions and explaining technical constraints, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs to stakeholders. Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to facilitate working sessions, present recommendations, document decisions, and drive alignment across teams. Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and deliver in a fast-paced, regulated transformation environment. Education and Experience Preferred: Appian Level 1 or higher certification, or equivalent hands-on experience with Appian Designer. Familiarity with SAIL expressions for configuring dynamic forms, validations, conditional logic, and reusable interface patterns. Understanding of Appian object reusability, versioning, packaging, release management, performance considerations, and platform governance best practices. Experience with Appian AI, Case Management Studio, Appian RPA, data fabric, connected systems, integrations, or document management workflows. Experience using agentic AI or AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Open Claw, Hermes, or similar tools to support product analysis, prototyping, testing, documentation, or automation. Experience with low-code or no-code workflow platforms beyond Appian, such as Power Platform, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Pega, Airtable, Retool, Mendix, or similar tools. Corporate Trust, securities servicing, bond administration, transfer agent, paying agent, or financial operations domain experience is preferred. Strong understanding of business process mapping, process engineering, service design, user journey design, and operational improvement methods. Experience developing, managing, or launching digital capabilities in financial services, fintech, trust services, institutional services, compliance, legal operations, or document-intensive environments. Experience working in partnership with user experience, design, data, architecture, cybersecurity, risk, legal, compliance, or operations teams. Knowledge of Agile, Lean, design thinking, systems thinking, and continuous improvement principles and practices. M&T Bank is committed to fair, competitive, and market-informed pay for our employees. The pay range for this position is $148,300.00 - $247,100.00 Annual (USD). The successful candidate’s particular combination of knowledge, skills, and experience will inform their specific compensation. The range listed above corresponds to our national pay range for this role. The specific pay range applicable to you may vary based on your location. Location Clanton, Alabama, United States of America

title: Category Manager - Technology
jd_text: Job Summary: WHO ARE WE? Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com . WHO ARE YOU? Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! THE ROLE The Category Manager, Technology on Live Nation's Global Procurement team is jointly responsible for strategically managing $250M+ in annual IT spend. This hands-on role leads procurement for stakeholders' highest-priority technology projects – reducing cost structurally and permanently where possible, while supporting stakeholders' broader strategic and operational objectives. The role also shares responsibility for strategic supplier management within the category. WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO Stakeholders & Sourcing Jointly develops, with the category leader and key stakeholders, the overarching enterprise-wide procurement strategies for Live Nation's technology spend, primarily software/SaaS, telecom and networking, physical and cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, AI/ML platforms, and IT professional services. In a non-mandated environment, leads multiple simultaneous direct negotiations and full-lifecycle competitive sourcing events (e.g., RFPs). Advises senior executives on negotiation strategy, supplier selection and qualification, and contracting approach; analyzes business, financial, and legal risk and develops practical mitigation options. Identifies, quantifies, and captures cost reduction, cost avoidance, and other value opportunities across divisions and functions, incorporating rigorous analysis of available spend data and market dynamics with a confident, collaborative, creative and adaptable negotiation style. Partners with IT, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Risk Management, Finance, and Operations to bring deals to closure. Suppliers Leads the commercial and operational contracting process for procurement projects, ensuring terms reflect Live Nation's business interests and policies. Supports stakeholders’ efforts to manage and maintain ongoing supplier performance, contributing to development and negotiated implementation of solutions to service, quality, and commercial issues and disputes. Represents Global Procurement with account representatives at Live Nation's incumbent technology suppliers. Team Performs additional duties as assigned, consistent with the nature and level of this role, as business needs evolve. WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING 5-7 years of progressively responsible experience in sourcing/procurement, supply chain, or operations transformation; top-tier consulting experience preferred. Proven track record of generating financial and operational value from procurement projects, ideally in a non-mandated environment; advanced influencing and negotiation skills. Working knowledge of one or more IT categories: software/SaaS, infrastructure, networking/telecom, cybersecurity, cloud economics, or IT professional services. Familiar with generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) and comfortable validating AI-generated output rather than relying on it uncritically. Demonstrated project management skills; thrives self-directed in a fast-paced, matrixed environment with minimal supervision. Strong business acumen, including contract development and risk mitigation. Exceptional written and verbal communication; able to influence audiences from analysts to senior executives. Fluent English required. Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud Procurement or a comparable source-to-pay platform (SAP Ariba, Coupa) preferred. Bachelor’s degree required (Master's preferred); candidates with an Associate's degree and a strong track record of significant professional experience will also be considered BENEFITS & PERKS Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits: HEALTH : Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA) YOURSELF : Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days WEALTH : 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program FAMILY : New parent programs including caregiver leave and baby bonuses, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support CAREER : Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment OTHERS : Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. Live Nation strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), family and medical care leave or the denial of family and medical care leave, mental or physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), marital status, domestic partner status, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, military and veteran status, political affiliation, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, race, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, sexual orientation, intersectionality, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law, rule, ordinance or regulation. title: Supply Chain Manager - 1st Shift
jd_text: Job Description: ROLE PURPOSE/ POSITION SUMMARY The Supply Chain Manager (SCM) is responsible for overseeing and optimizing the end-to-end supply chain processes and improvement of service, inventory, and cost to customers. The SCM manages and oversees the day-to-day activities of customer service, production scheduling, procurement, storage, and inventory control activities of raw materials, ingredients, and finished goods. Deliverables range across key customer and vendor management, short and long-term material and production planning, and materials management. The role requires strategic thinking, effective collaboration with internal and external stakeholders, and a commitment to ensuring the efficient and timely flow of materials and products KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES/PRIMARY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES Strategic Planning Develop and implement strategic plans for the entire supply chain to align with the company's business goals and objectives Identify opportunities for cost savings, process improvements, and enhanced efficiency Maintain a clear understanding of customer expectations for accuracy, quality, and timeliness; then, develop and implement methods for meeting or exceeding those expectations Accountable for departmental project deliverables. Secure and allocate appropriate resources and manage projects to meet goals and achieve financial objectives Leverage internal/external experts in network to accomplish goals Responsible for delivery of short-term and-long term results in order to develop and maintain the organization’s credibility with our core customer base Procurement and Vendor Management Oversee the procurement of raw materials, ingredients, and packaging materials Support the account manager to negotiate terms, contracts, and pricing with suppliers to ensure cost-effectiveness and reliability Production Planning Manage the day to day and week to week production schedule Collaborate internally and externally with key shareholders to develop production schedules that meet demand forecasts Optimize production processes to ensure efficient resource utilization Analyze production yield, material usage, and material loss data to understand customer/material impacts Analyze actual and theoretical run rates to optimize production schedule Maximize production efficiency through change to current planning processes which will result in reduced changeovers, machine downtime and downtime due to raw materials/component shortages Logistics and Distribution Manage transportation and distribution logistics to ensure on-time deliveries to customers Coordinate with logistics partners to optimize shipping routes and reduce costs Inventory Management Implement inventory control measures to maintain optimal stock levels Minimize excess inventory and prevent stockouts to meet customer demand Drive change in managing inventory levels and inventory turns and minimizing obsolescence, scrap, aged inventories, and inventory reserves Quality Control Ensure that quality control standards are maintained throughout the supply chain process Collaborate with quality control teams to address and resolve any quality issues Technology Integration Implement and leverage technology, such as ERP systems and supply chain management software, to enhance visibility and streamline processes Stakeholder Collaboration Collaborate with internal and external teams, including production, sales, finance, and quality control, to ensure alignment and coordination across departments Foster strong relationships with key external partners, including suppliers and logistics providers Participate and assist in development of new, effective programs/policies for customer, supplier, transportation, and logistics management in conjunction with Supply Chain and plant leadership Provide daily, weekly and or monthly inventory and service reports to internal and external shareholders, as well as participate in the monthly metrics review Team Leadership and Development Lead and motivate the supply chain team, fostering a collaborative and results-driven culture Provide mentorship and professional development opportunities for team members Risk Management Identify and assess potential risks in the supply chain, including disruptions, and develop mitigation strategies Monitor and respond to changes in market conditions that may impact the supply chain Regulatory Compliance Ensure compliance with relevant regulations and standards governing food safety, quality, and supply chain practices Perform other duties as assigned MSI Express is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Engineering Project Manager
jd_text: At Motiva, our employees’ energy, passion, and dedication to excellence are what make us who we are and what allows us to generate energy that makes a house a home, gets us from point A to point B, and enables our health and wellbeing. We invest in every aspect of our employees’ lives because, at Motiva, our people matter. Headquartered in Houston, Texas, Motiva refines, distributes and markets petroleum products throughout the Americas. The company’s Port Arthur Manufacturing Complex in Port Arthur, TX, is comprised of North America’s largest refinery with a total throughput of 720,000 barrels per day, the largest base oil plant in the western hemisphere, and an integrated chemical plant. Under exclusive long-term brand licenses with Shell and Phillips 66 (for the 76® brand), Motiva’s commercial operations supply more than 12 billion gallons of fuel to customers annually. Motiva is wholly owned by Aramco, one of the world’s largest integrated energy and chemicals companies. Position Overview: The Engineering Project Manager at Motiva’s Port Arthur Manufacturing Complex leads the planning and execution of projects, coordinating cross-functional teams to deliver capital projects that meet defined scope, schedule, budget, quality, and business objectives. This role develops work plans, resource requirements, cost estimates, timelines, and controls while managing stakeholders, vendors, subcontractors, and internal teams throughout project execution. The Engineering Project Manager applies technical and project management expertise to resolve complex issues, improve processes, ensure regulatory and HSSE compliance, and deliver solutions that meet or exceed customer and organizational expectations. Responsibilities: Lead the planning and execution of small to medium-sized capital projects and complex engineering programs from initiation through completion. Develop and manage project scope, work plans, schedules, resource requirements, cost estimates, budgets, and project controls. Coordinate cross-functional engineering, technical, operational, and business teams to ensure effective project integration and execution. Manage day-to-day project activities, track milestones and deliverables, and ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and in accordance with approved scope. Monitor project costs, resources, risks, and performance while ensuring accurate and timely reporting to leadership and stakeholders. Identify, analyze, and resolve complex technical and project-related issues, providing recommendations and coaching to team members as needed. Evaluate technology and technical solutions for complex project challenges and drive appropriate decisions within project scope. Proven experience leading complex data migration efforts across multiple applications, business functions, or acquired organizations. title: Product Manager, Payments Hardware & Deployment
jd_text: About NCR VOYIX NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide. Department: Payments Hardware & Deployment Reports To: Director / Executive Director, Deployment Position Type: Full-Time Location: Irving, TX Position Summary The Product Manager, Payments Hardware & Deployment is responsible for supporting the lifecycle, certification, release, and operational readiness of payment hardware solutions. This role serves as a key connection point between Product, Deployment, Technology, Operations, Sales, Finance, vendors, suppliers, logistics partners, and other internal stakeholders to ensure payment devices are successfully evaluated, certified, launched, deployed, supported, and managed throughout their lifecycle. The Product Manager will manage a portfolio of payment hardware products while supporting the operational processes required to deliver those products to customers. The role requires a combination of product management, payments industry knowledge, project coordination, vendor management, and operational execution. This individual will help drive product readiness, improve deployment execution, strengthen vendor and supplier relationships, reduce operational risk, and ensure the organization can efficiently scale its payments hardware capabilities as business needs evolve. Key Responsibilities Product & Hardware Lifecycle Management Manage payment hardware products throughout the product lifecycle, from evaluation and onboarding through deployment, maintenance, and end-of-life. Coordinate new payment device evaluations and provide recommendations based on business requirements, customer needs, functionality, cost, and operational considerations. Develop and maintain product requirements in partnership with business, technology, operations, and deployment stakeholders. Support product roadmap planning and prioritization for payment hardware initiatives. Monitor product performance, industry trends, market developments, and competitive offerings to identify opportunities for improvement. Coordinate end-of-life and replacement strategies for hardware products to minimize customer and operational disruption. Maintain accurate documentation related to supported devices, configurations, capabilities, dependencies, and lifecycle status. Product Releases & Certifications Manage payment hardware release activities from initial planning through production readiness. Coordinate hardware and solution certification activities with internal teams, payment processors, manufacturers, vendors, and other applicable partners. Track certification requirements, dependencies, testing activities, defects, and outstanding deliverables. Ensure appropriate stakeholders are aligned on release scope, timelines, risks, and readiness criteria. Identify and escalate risks that could impact certification, release, deployment, or customer commitments. Partner with technical and operational teams to ensure new products are operationally ready before deployment. Coordinate post-release activities and capture lessons learned to continuously improve future product launches. Deployment & Operational Readiness Partner closely with Deployment teams to ensure payments products can be successfully ordered, configured, provisioned, injected, fulfilled, shipped, installed, and supported. Define and document operational requirements associated with new payment hardware and product launches. Support the development and improvement of deployment workflows, procedures, controls, and documentation. Coordinate cross-functional activities required to move products from certification into operational deployment. Identify process gaps and opportunities to improve deployment efficiency, quality, scalability, and the customer experience. Support resolution of product-related issues affecting deployments or customers. Assist with deployment initiatives and projects requiring Product Management ownership or coordination. Vendor, Supplier & Partner Management Develop and maintain strong relationships with payments hardware manufacturers, suppliers, logistics providers, and other external partners. Coordinate vendor deliverables, product roadmaps, hardware availability, lead times, certifications, and product changes. Monitor vendor performance and escalate issues that could impact business operations or customer commitments. Partner with internal Procurement and Finance teams as needed to support hardware purchasing, forecasting, and vendor-related activities. Coordinate across the supply chain to identify and resolve hardware availability, fulfillment, logistics, or operational issues. Serve as a primary point of contact for designated product and vendor relationships. Cross-Functional Leadership Serve as a central point of coordination across Product, Technology, Deployment, Operations, Finance, Sales, Support, Compliance, and other stakeholders. Translate business and customer needs into clear product and operational requirements. Facilitate working sessions to drive decisions, resolve dependencies, and maintain alignment across stakeholders. Communicate product status, risks, dependencies, and key decisions to leadership and business partners. Coordinate multiple initiatives simultaneously while managing competing priorities and deadlines. Promote accountability by clearly defining owners, deliverables, timelines, and escalation paths. Process Improvement & Documentation Develop and maintain product documentation, procedures, requirements, workflows, and operational reference materials. Identify opportunities to simplify processes, reduce manual effort, improve controls, and minimize operational errors. Establish repeatable processes that support business continuity and organizational scalability. Develop appropriate tracking and reporting for product releases, certifications, vendor activities, and deployment readiness. Capture institutional knowledge to reduce dependency on individual resources and strengthen business continuity. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business, Product Management, Technology, Finance, Operations, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 3+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Operations, Payments, FinTech, Operations, Deployment, or a related field. Experience managing products, projects, or operational initiatives involving multiple stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment. Strong project coordination and organizational skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience working with external vendors, suppliers, or business partners. Ability to identify operational risks, dependencies, and process improvement opportunities. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities. Preferred Qualifications Experience within the payments, merchant acquiring, financial technology, or payment processing industry. Knowledge of point-of-sale terminals and payment hardware. Experience with payment device certification and release processes. Familiarity with payment terminal manufacturers and hardware suppliers. Understanding of PCI-related requirements and payment security concepts. Familiarity with payment terminal configuration, encryption, key injection, or Key Injection Facility operations. Experience working with logistics, fulfillment, inventory, or hardware deployment organizations. Experience managing hardware lifecycle and end-of-life initiatives. Key Competencies The successful candidate will demonstrate: Ownership: Takes accountability for initiatives from planning through execution. Execution: Can effectively move initiatives through complex cross-functional environments. Collaboration: Builds strong relationships across technical, operational, commercial, and external teams. Risk Management: Identifies issues and dependencies before they negatively affect customers or delivery. Customer Focus: Understands how product and operational decisions ultimately affect merchants and customers. Continuous Improvement: Looks for opportunities to simplify processes and improve quality and efficiency. Adaptability: Effectively manages changing priorities and evolving business requirements. Communication: Clearly communicates status, risks, decisions, and expectations across all levels of the organization. title: Manager, Data Products
jd_text: 7-Eleven is an iconic family of brands with over 86,000 locations, surpassing every retailer in the world. We revolutionize convenience, restaurants and fuel through cutting edge innovation — working hard to be the customer's first choice. 7-Eleven empowers our employees to "activate awesome" and make a meaningful impact in their stores and communities every day. If you're ready to grow, lead and make a difference, come join our team and help shape the future of convenience. About This Opportunity Manage the team that turns enterprise data into trusted products people can use to make decisions, run the business, and serve customers and stores. Own data products from discovery through retirement, including the roadmap, requirements, delivery, adoption, quality, support, and value tracking. Work in the 7-Eleven Enterprise Data Platform environment with teams that build and support Databricks-based data pipelines, medallion architecture, reusable datasets, master and reference data, governed metrics, semantic models, Power BI reporting, self-service analytics, and AI-assisted data experiences. Use tools such as Databricks, Unity Catalog, Alation, Monte Carlo, Power BI, Dataiku, and approved AI tools to help make data products discoverable, governed, secure, observable, reliable, and useful. Partner closely with business owners, data engineering, architecture, platform, analytics, data science, privacy, security, and governance teams to define what each product should do, how it should be used, how it will be supported, and how value will be measured. Forecast staffing and costs, manage team capacity, and guide the team in using automation and AI to reduce manual effort, improve self-service, and increase trust in enterprise data. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Product Lifecycle · Own the full lifecycle for internal and external data products, from discovery and design through launch, support, improvement, and retirement. · Work with business users to understand the problem, define the intended outcome, identify the right data, and agree on how success will be measured. · Set and maintain product vision, roadmaps, priorities, requirements, acceptance criteria, release plans, and product documentation. · Make sure each data product has a clear owner, purpose, user group, support model, quality expectations, metadata, lineage, refresh timing, known limits, and measurable business value. · Manage data products that may include enterprise datasets, data marts, master and reference data, governed metrics, reporting datasets, semantic models, APIs, and data used by AI/ML, analytics, and operational systems. 2. Product Delivery · Translate business needs into clear features, user stories, data rules, source-to-target needs, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans that engineering and analytics teams can execute. · Manage and prioritize the backlog based on business value, urgency, data availability, technical complexity, risk, platform cost, support impact, and team capacity. · Partner with data engineers, analysts, data scientists, architects, privacy, security, platform, and data governance teams to balance speed, quality, controls, cost, and long-term maintainability. · Work with engineering and architecture teams on practical product design choices, including batch or streaming patterns, Databricks medallion layers, reusable components, data contracts, semantic models, and downstream consumption patterns. · Identify dependencies, risks, data gaps, scope changes, access needs, platform constraints, and key decisions early so delivery stays on track and stakeholders understand tradeoffs. · Help users choose between an existing data product, self-service data, an AI-assisted answer, a managed report, or new development before adding new work to the backlog. 3. Adoption and Results · Track product performance, usage, reliability, data quality, refresh success, support demand, user feedback, and business outcomes. · Use KPIs, adoption trends, support tickets, data-quality results, and stakeholder feedback to decide what to improve, expand, simplify, automate, or retire. · Create clear documentation, definitions, lineage notes, training materials, release notes, and known-issue guidance so users can find, understand, and use available data products. · Drive adoption by explaining product value in plain language and helping business teams apply the data to real decisions and processes. · Partner with engineering and platform teams to make product health visible through monitoring, alerts, runbooks, service expectations, and permanent fixes for recurring issues. · Communicate status, risks, decisions, adoption, value, and delivery tradeoffs to leaders, business partners, and delivery teams. 4. Data Governance, Quality, and Controls · Make sure data products follow company standards for data quality, security, privacy, access, encryption, retention, stewardship, metadata, lineage, and responsible use. · Partner with governance, privacy, security, architecture, platform, and legal teams to manage data definitions, data lineage, access needs, classification, sensitive data controls, and compliance expectations. · Define quality checks, issue handling, ownership, service expectations, and escalation paths so users can trust the data and know how to get help. · Ensure data products include the controls needed for reliable production use, including testing, monitoring, documentation, release readiness, access approval, and support plans. · Support privacy and regulatory requirements, including appropriate controls for sensitive data, consumer data, and data used by AI-enabled tools or self-service analytics. 5. Workforce Planning and Forecasting · Forecast staffing and skill needs based on planned work, support demand, and team capacity. · Provide staffing and cost estimates for annual planning, project funding, and new work. · Recommend when to hire, use contractors, train employees, automate work, or move work between teams. · Track vacancies and expected staffing changes and explain how they affect delivery and funding. 6. AI Use and Team Expectations · Use approved AI tools in day-to-day work to prepare plans, analyze information, draft documentation, summarize issues, test ideas, and speed up routine tasks. · Set the expectation that employees use approved AI tools where those tools can reduce manual work, improve documentation, support data discovery, or shorten delivery time. · Help the team use tools such as Windsurf, Devin, and Databricks Genie for coding, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, requirements analysis, and data exploration when appropriate. · Guide the shift from custom report creation to governed self-service, reusable data products, and AI-assisted answers that business teams can use safely. · Require employees to review, validate, and test AI-generated work before it is used in production or shared as a final answer. · Make sure the team follows company rules for security, privacy, data handling, intellectual property, and responsible AI use. · Track where AI is helping the team and where training, controls, or process changes are needed. 7. People Management · Manage employees and set clear goals, priorities, and expectations. · Assign work, balance workloads, and make sure the team has the skills and support needed to deliver. · Give regular feedback, complete performance reviews, and address performance concerns. · Mentor and coach employees, build development plans, and prepare employees for larger roles. · Support hiring, onboarding, succession planning, and retention. platforms, data warehouses, machine learning-enabled products, or similar technology products. · 3+ years managing employees or technical teams, including planning work, setting priorities, coaching employees, and managing performance. · Experience translating business needs into requirements, user stories, data rules, acceptance criteria, delivery plans, product documentation, and release decisions. · Working knowledge of SQL and familiarity with Databricks, Spark, data pipelines, ETL/ELT, data modeling, semantic models, data quality, BI tools, and modern cloud data platforms. · Experience with Agile or Scrum ways of working, including backlog management, sprint planning, prioritization, stakeholder demos, release planning, and dependency management. · Experience applying data governance, privacy, security, access, metadata, lineage, and quality standards to data products. · Experience using approved AI tools to improve personal and team productivity while validating outputs before use. · Strong communication skills with the ability to explain data, analytics, product decisions, risks, costs, adoption, and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences. · Experience with enterprise data products, master data, reference data, customer data, store or item data, analytics, BI, governed metrics, or self-service reporting. · Experience with tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Databricks, Azure cloud data platforms, data catalogs, data observability tools, data quality tools, Dataiku, or similar platforms. · Experience working with data science, machine learning, forecasting, AI-enabled products, conversational BI, or AI-assisted analytics. · Experience in retail, convenience, restaurant, supply chain, merchandising, finance, operations, loyalty, jd_text: 7-Eleven is an iconic family of brands with over 86,000 locations, surpassing every retailer in the world. title: .  Senior Solution Architect – Supply Chain & Logistics
jd_text: 7-Eleven is an iconic family of brands with over 86,000 locations, surpassing every retailer in the world. We revolutionize convenience, restaurants and fuel through cutting edge innovation — working hard to be the customer's first choice. 7-Eleven empowers our employees to "activate awesome" and make a meaningful impact in their stores and communities every day. If you're ready to grow, lead and make a difference, come join our team and help shape the future of convenience. Senior Solution Architect – Supply Chain & Logistics The Role 7-Eleven is looking for a Senior Solution Architect to lead the technical strategy for our Supply Chain and Logistics ecosystem. You will be the bridge between our business goals—demand planning, inventory optimization, and logistics—and the engineering teams building the solutions. We are looking for a seasoned technologist who will define a roadmap, and guide implementation across a complex retail landscape. You will be instrumental in building out our next-generation Supply Chain processes. Also driving the control tower implementation turning massive amounts of data into actionable operational insights. What You’ll Be Doing Driving the Roadmap: Move beyond just "supporting" the business. You will actively shape the technology roadmap for our supply chain platforms, ensuring for future expansion and growth Technical Liaison: Act as the primary conduit between product management, business stakeholders, and our engineering squads. You’ll take abstract business requirements and translate them into concrete, actionable technical designs. Architecting for Scale: Design robust, cloud-native solutions. Whether it’s microservices, event-driven integrations, or complex data pipelines for our control tower, you’ll be the one ensuring the architecture is resilient and performant. Data & AI Application: Go beyond standard reporting. You will lead data modeling efforts that enable real-time visibility to embed forecasting and optimization models into our core logistics workflows. Executive Presence: You’ll be expected to hold your own in a room with leadership. You should be able to explain the why behind an architectural decision, clearly articulate trade-offs, and get buy-in on the long-term vision. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: EDUCATION: Bachelors/4 Yr Degree YEARS OF RELEVANT WORK EXPERIENCE: 8+ years YEARS OF MANAGEMENT EXPERIENCE: NA What We’re Looking For The Experience: 8+ years in software engineering and solution architecture, with a significant portion of that time spent in retail supply chain, logistics, or demand planning. Full-Stack Fluency: You have a strong background in development. You understand the nuances of modern full-stack engineering, API-first design, and integration patterns (event-driven vs. batch). Domain Depth: You know the retail supply chain inside and out—from replenishment and inventory visibility to transportation and store-level fulfillment. Cloud & Data: You are comfortable working in cloud-native environments and understand how to model data for high-velocity, real-time analytics. Communication: You can simplify complexity. If you can’t explain a technical hurdle to a business stakeholder in a way that helps them make a decision, this probably isn't the right fit. Adaptability: 7-Eleven is a fast-paced environment. We need someone who can navigate legacy system complexities while pushing forward with modern, cloud-first implementations. Why This Matters This is a high-visibility role. The technology you architect will directly impact how we move product to thousands of stores, how we forecast demand in a shifting market, and how we empower our operations teams to make decisions faster. You aren't just building a system; you're building the future of supply chain logistics for 7-Eleven If an hourly or salary range is included in this ad it represents the range 7-Eleven in good faith believes is the range of compensation for this role at the time of this posting. title: Manager, Product Operations & UX
jd_text: Merge medical imaging solutions, offered by Merative, combine intelligent, scalable imaging workflow tools with deep and broad expertise to help healthcare organizations improve their confidence in patient outcomes and optimize care delivery. Merge is one of the most widely deployed medical imaging platforms in the world. Radiologists and cardiologists rely on us to store, move, and read imaging studies across enterprise health systems, teleradiology reading centers, and community hospitals. We are modernizing the portfolio for the cloud and building empowered product teams that own outcomes — and this role builds the operating model and design foundation those teams run on. The opportunity This is an enabling-function leadership role with three connected parts. Product Operations is how product gets built and run — the product development lifecycle, program management, the operating cadence, and the tooling and data that keep everyone working from one source of truth. AI enablement is how we make that lifecycle faster and sharper — using AI to accelerate funnel development, build and pressure-test business cases, and prioritize where the org spends its capacity. UX is product design, user research, and the design system that make the reading experience consistent, usable, and clinically sound. Together they are the backbone that lets empowered teams move fast without losing quality. You will report directly to the VP, Product, and lead across all three — serving every product team rather than owning a single product. What you’ll own Operating model and cadence. Own how product is built and run: the product development lifecycle, the operating rhythm of planning, reviews, and metrics, and portfolio operations across teams. Program management. Own program and release management — keeping cross-team initiatives on track and dependencies, risks, and progress visible to leadership. Tooling and data. Own the product toolchain and the portfolio data and metrics, so teams and leaders share one trustworthy view of how we are doing. AI enablement and AI-accelerated PDLC. Own how AI is applied to the lifecycle itself — compressing the path from opportunity to validated, scoped work; standing up business cases with AI-assisted sizing and evidence; and sharpening portfolio prioritization. Design and research (UX). Lead product design, user research, and the design system — partnering with product and engineering from discovery through launch. What you’ll do Standardize the product development lifecycle and operating cadence so teams discover, build, and ship consistently — with AI embedded in how the org works. Use AI to accelerate funnel development — shortening the path from raw opportunity to validated, scoped, ready-to-build work. Build the business-case discipline — AI-assisted market sizing, evidence, and ROI so investment decisions are fast, consistent, and defensible. Own how the portfolio gets prioritized — a transparent, evidence-backed model for ranking work and reallocating capacity as the evidence changes. Lead program management across the portfolio and give leadership a clear, current view of progress and risk. Own the product toolchain and portfolio metrics; resolve friction so teams work from one source of truth. Lead and grow the UX team, and evolve a design system that keeps the experience coherent across products. Run the early-access and customer-advisory motion that brings clinician feedback into the product early. Build, coach, and retain a team spanning operations and design. What you bring 8+ years across product operations, program management, and/or design leadership, including running cross-functional operating models. Experience standardizing a product development lifecycle and operating cadence for multiple teams. Hands-on experience embedding AI into how product teams discover, build, and ship — and using it to speed up the funnel, business cases, and prioritization. Program and release management skill — you make dependencies, risk, and progress visible and keep initiatives on track. Design and research leadership — you have led or partnered closely with UX and owned or grown a design system. Fluency with product tooling and metrics, and a bias toward one source of truth. People leadership and clear, plain communication with product, engineering, design, and executives. Nice to have Background in healthcare, medical imaging, or another regulated domain. Experience with AI-assisted research, synthesis, or evaluation tooling in a regulated environment. Familiarity with quality management systems (QMS) and regulated software development. Job Description The Senior HR Enablement Specialist is a critical partner that supports the strategic execution of critical people initiatives for the collective HRBP team. They most often support VP and SVP HR Business Partners, ensuring consistent, high‑quality execution of HR programs and processes across complex business units and functions. In this role, you translate HRBP direction into strategic and operational delivery, enabling and executing cyclical HR enterprise processes, as well as organization-specific talent initiatives, preparing and synthesizing workforce insights, , executing & facilitating organizational design and change activities led by the HRBP, while ensuring consistent application of HR programs and enterprise standards. You will work within the frameworks established by HR Shared Services, Centers of Expertise, and the HR Product Operating Model, ensuring adherence to standards, applying judgement to navigate ambiguity and surfacing meaningful feedback when barriers or experience gaps arise. You need to have a deep understanding of your client talent priorities and nuances to refine, not deeply customize, delivery within your client’s structure, goals and limitations. This requires you to proactively, with limited guidance, adapt actions plans to reach desired outcomes. This role also requires growing digital and AI-enabled HR acumen, applying emerging tools to strengthen analysis, streamline delivery, and enhance HRBP support. This role is ideal for someone who excels at bringing structure to established processes, facilitating and supporting key HR discussions, aligning stakeholders, and ensuring accurate, reliable execution— knowing when to execute, when to facilitate, and when to redirect to the appropriate HR teams or expertise. title: Business Development Manager, Systems
jd_text: Gaming: Welcome to the world of land-based gaming. At Light & Wonder, it’s all about the games, and our Gaming team builds cutting-edge technology, products, and content for the most iconic casinos and operators across the globe. Position Summary The Mission: The Business Development Manager will be a key member of the North American Systems commercial team. This is a true hunting role responsible for identifying, developing, and winning new revenue opportunities across an assigned territory. The role will focus on competitive conversions, new customer acquisition, product penetration, and the expansion of Light & Wonder’s Systems hardware, software, services, and recurring-revenue solutions. The successful candidate will be highly visible in the market and spend significant time meeting customers in person, understanding their operational priorities, demonstrating differentiated value, and advancing complex opportunities from initial engagement through contract execution. This role is designed for a commercially driven, resilient business-development professional who enjoys opening doors, building executive relationships, creating opportunities where none previously existed, and competing to win. Job Summary: The Business Development Manager is responsible for generating incremental Systems revenue by building and converting a qualified pipeline of new business opportunities. Outcomes: The role will: Develop new customer relationships and expand Light & Wonder’s access to decision-makers and influencers. Identify competitive replacement opportunities and create strategies to displace incumbent providers. Increase penetration of priority Systems products and solutions. Create demand for integrated hardware, software, services, and recurring-revenue offerings. Lead opportunities from prospecting and discovery through solution development, negotiation, and close. Represent the voice of the market to Product Management, Commercial Strategy, Client Services, and other internal partners. Essential Job Functions: New Business Development Build and maintain a territory strategy focused on new customers, competitive conversions, underpenetrated accounts, and priority market opportunities. Proactively identify and pursue prospects rather than relying primarily on inbound leads or established customer demand. Develop relationships with senior customer leaders, operational decision-makers, technology stakeholders, and other key influencers. Consultative and Value-Based Selling Develop a detailed understanding of each prospective customer’s operating model, business priorities, technology environment, challenges, and decision criteria. Translate customer needs into an integrated Light & Wonder Systems value proposition. Conduct executive-level presentations, discovery sessions, product demonstrations, workshops, and commercial discussions. Pipeline Creation and Opportunity Management Build and maintain a healthy pipeline sufficient to achieve assigned revenue and booking targets. Establish clear milestones and mutual action plans for complex sales opportunities. Provide accurate forecasts and communicate changes, risks, or barriers early. Competitive Conversion Develop an informed understanding of competitive products, commercial models, customer relationships, strengths, and vulnerabilities. Build competitive displacement strategies that address both the business case for change and the customer’s implementation risk. Partner with internal teams to create effective migration, implementation, and adoption plans for customers moving from incumbent platforms. Cross-Functional Commercial Leadership Partner with Product Management, Commercial Strategy, Sales Engineering, Client Services, Operations, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders to develop customer solutions. Bring customer and market insight into product-roadmap and portfolio discussions. Coordinate internal resources around priority pursuits and establish clear ownership of deliverables. Territory and Market Development Monitor relevant market developments, competitor activity, customer investments, and regulatory or technology trends. Develop and maintain a structured territory plan that identifies priority accounts, whitespace opportunities, relationship gaps, and revenue potential. Participate in industry conferences, customer events, demonstrations, and networking opportunities. Track record of competitive displacement, greenfield sales, or significant product penetration. title: Enterprise Services Architect
jd_text: At Mitel, you will have the opportunity to help businesses connect, collaborate and provide better experiences for our customers. You will deliver valuable contributions in creating business success within our global organization utilizing your unique attributes, skills and experience. Please take a moment to look over this opportunity and if interested, feel free to send us your application. If this is not the right opportunity for you, you can also sign up for Job Alerts by creating an account. This will give you a profile that you can use for all future applications, and you will be notified whenever a new position that matches your criteria becomes available. About the Role We are seeking a strategic and technically astute Enterprise Services Architect to lead the design of Professional Services and Managed Services solutions for large enterprise customers, including net new customer acquisitions. This role bridges the gap between sales, delivery, and operations — translating complex customer needs into scalable, repeatable, and profitable service offerings. You will engage directly with enterprise customers to architect end-to-end services solutions that accelerate deployment, enhance adoption, and deliver long-term value. The ideal candidate blends technical depth, consultative experience, and business acumen to design services portfolios that drive customer success and organizational growth. Key Responsibilities Partner with enterprise sales, pre-sales engineers, and delivery teams to define and design tailored service solutions (Professional and Managed Services) for large, complex customer environments. Lead the services discovery process, identifying customer objectives, technical requirements, and operational constraints. Architect comprehensive services proposals that include deployment, migration, integration, adoption, and lifecycle management components. Design Managed Services models that include monitoring, proactive maintenance, optimization, and ongoing technical management. Build detailed Statements of Work (SOWs), service definitions, and solution blueprints that align with customer expectations and internal delivery capabilities. Collaborate with Product Management and Operations to standardize and scale repeatable service offerings while maintaining flexibility for customization. Provide subject matter expertise during customer presentations, executive reviews, and proposal negotiations. Ensure service solutions are technically sound, financially viable, and operationally deliverable. Serve as a trusted advisor to enterprise customers, guiding them through service transformation and managed services adoption. Maintain a deep understanding of industry trends, frameworks (ITIL, ISO, etc.), and emerging technologies to ensure service innovation and competitive differentiation. Qualifications 8+ years of experience in Services Architecture, Solution Architecture, or Professional Services design within enterprise technology. Proven track record designing complex Professional and Managed Services for large enterprise customers. Strong understanding of unified communications, collaboration, networking, or cloud infrastructure. Experience building detailed SOWs, service catalogs, and pricing models for enterprise-scale service delivery. Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with Sales, Engineering, and Delivery teams. Excellent communication, presentation, and customer-facing skills — comfortable interacting with both executives and technical stakeholders. Strong financial and business acumen with experience balancing customer value and delivery margin. Bachelor’s degree in related field or equivalent work experience Preferred: Experience in UC and CC, collaboration environments. Familiarity with ITIL frameworks, service lifecycle design, and managed service operations. Experience with automation, monitoring platforms, or service management tools (e.g., ServiceNow, LogicMonitor, PagerDuty). Technical certifications in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) or related enterprise systems. Master’s degree in Business or Engineering Attributes for Success Architect Mindset: Can see the big picture and design complex service ecosystems that work in the real world. Consultative Communicator: Excels at uncovering needs, shaping solutions, and gaining customer buy-in. Bridge Builder: Connects sales promises with operational realities to ensure customer satisfaction and delivery success. Innovator: Always seeking better, more scalable ways to deliver customer value. title: Senior Manager, Data Analytics
jd_text: Senior Manager of Data Analytics North - Remote (US) Let’s go North, together. Join our mission to build the largest suite of credit card processing and merchant services. It’s one simple payment platform backed by the most diverse payment companies. From credit card processing to back-office management, North points the way to smarter, faster, and just plain better payment solutions. Job Overview: In this role, you will lead the design and delivery of automated data pipelines, standard methodologies for data analytics, database architecture, and strategic insights drawn from the company's data. Outstanding attention to detail, sophisticated computational and programming skills, and the capacity to rapidly develop and act upon in-depth knowledge of our business, products, and processes is crucial for success in this role. You will be responsible for leading and developing a team spanning data engineering, business intelligence, and analysis to advance the enterprise data environment, including ownership of the operational health of the team's data integration infrastructure. This position will partner with Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Risk to improve customer acquisition, onboarding, customer service, and fraud detection. This role is responsible for surfacing the team's impact to leadership through clear reporting and KPIs, and for establishing the long-term strategy and technical architecture as well as the short-term scope for the ongoing evolution of the enterprise data platform. What You’ll Be Doing: Mentoring, motivating, coaching, and supporting a team of data engineers, business intelligence engineers, and business intelligence architects to achieve organizational objectives and goals Delivering and maintaining data services, interfaces, and real-time data pipelines Establishing strong CI/CD and GitHub practices for data pipelines, setting standards and mentoring the team toward more mature version control and deployment workflows Interacting directly with business and technology stakeholders to define future-state business capabilities and requirements, and translating those into detailed designs Maintaining the team's analytics and data integration platforms in partnership with the internal cloud team Managing the operational upkeep of that integration infrastructure, including starting and stopping services and installing and testing platform upgrades on the Ubuntu servers Partnering with platform architects to analyze the current environment, detect critical deficiencies, and recommend solutions for improvement Surfacing and communicating team accomplishments to leadership, including building KPIs and reporting that make team performance and impact visible What We Need From You: Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience 7+ years of experience in data engineering, business intelligence, or a related domain 4+ years of hands-on management experience with a track record of hiring and growing teams as well as providing coaching and mentoring Exceptional leadership skills, with a proven ability to operate in a fast-moving environment Hands-on approach to closing gaps in data infrastructure and technical execution Ability to code in SQL & experience with ETL solutions (Informatica IICS and Qlik Replicate) Prior experience with Snowflake, AWS, Qlik Replicate, Informatica IICS, and HubSpot What we offer: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that enables our teams to live a life well lived, both personally and professionally. Some of our perks include: Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage Flexible Paid Time Off 401(k) + Match Mental Health Support & Well-Being Program Paid Maternity & Paternity Leave Education Assistance Company-funded Lifestyle Spending Account Salary Range: $145,000 - $173,000 Pay within this range varies by work location and on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. We look forward to discussing your salary expectations and our full total rewards offerings throughout the interview process. Please note: North is a US-based company and no sponsorship is available for this position at this time. Who we are: North, and our family of companies, are committed to helping entrepreneurs grow their businesses. As an end-to-end payment solutions company, we provide everything business owners need to get paid, whether they serve customers in a physical storefront, online, or both. We pride ourselves on being large enough to offer customized solutions to our enterprise-level clients while remaining agile enough to take an award-winning, hands-on approach to personal service that our merchants won’t find anywhere else. Let’s go North, together! Our most important resource is our people. Join our diverse team of innovators and do-ers and make your mark on the future of payments technology. We're proud to offer benefits that help our team members further their overall well-being through unique initiatives that are both personally and professionally fulfilling. At North, we celebrate diversity and create an inclusive environment for everyone. We are an equal opportunity employer. title: Lead Exhibition Technical Engineer
jd_text: Privacy Notice for California Applicants and Employees Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. We are individuals who inspire creativity in people's lives through art and exploration, so that our combined imaginations can transform the world we live in. We create immersive and interactive experiences that transport audiences into fantastic realms of story and exploration. Our Vision is to be the world’s leading creative company, reimagining the paradigm of art and storytelling, to make a positive difference in the world. Provocative Playfulness: We celebrate the unexpected because it is the doorway to discovery. Job Description: Job Disclosures: Location: (On-Site) Grapevine, TX Job Summary: The Lead Exhibition Technical Engineer is a technologist that works in a unique and exceptional immersive arts exhibition covering areas of lighting, sound, video, projections, networking, show power, control & automation, interactive game mechanics, computer art installations, and animatronics. This role is responsible for repairs and preventive maintenance of exhibit technology, along with design and development of enhancements related to the functionality and overall experience of the exhibition. The ideal candidate should be proficient in redesigning or the rebuilding of problematic systems or installation of new systems. The Exhibition Technology team is tasked with operating and maintaining the exhibition daily, supporting special events, media events and contributing to new exhibit installations. Job Responsibilities: Maintenance & Operations: Conduct systematic daily inspections, routine cleaning, and comprehensive preventive maintenance across all exhibit technology, electronics, and interactive show components. Efficiently diagnose and resolve complex technical hardware and software issues, while accurately logging bug reports, repair histories, and maintenance schedules using the corporate CMMS database. Team Collaboration & Leadership: Partner closely with local exhibition staff, facility maintenance teams, and cross-site sister exhibition engineering groups to foster cross-functional knowledge transfer and collaborative problem-solving. Serve as a technical subject matter expert, authoring clear standard operating procedures (SOPs), guiding best practices, and training staff on operation of new show control systems and diagnostic tools. Technical Support & Integration: Guarantee high system availability for daily exhibit operations, special guest events, and media productions. Execute low-voltage wiring, device configuration, component replacement, and deployment of software, firmware, and media content updates across show control networks, theatrical/architectural lighting, Q-SYS audio, video, and micro-controllers. Project Development & Enhancements: Continuously observe visitor interactions to conceptualize and design technical enhancements that elevate the overall guest experience. Participate in the mechanical integration, physical fabrication, coding, and prototyping of custom interactive artwork, while thoroughly documenting as-built schematics, system topologies, and software version histories. Required Qualifications: Experience & Education: 3 to 5+ years of hands-on professional experience in emerging media technology, creative tech installations, software development, electrical engineering, or professional AV systems integration. Associate degree, technical institute certification, or equivalent practical industry experience required. Technical Skills & Domain Expertise: Deep technical proficiency in theatrical/architectural lighting (DMX/ETC systems), networked audio protocols (Q-SYS, Dante), visual programming environments (TouchDesigner, Max/MSP), micro-controllers and embedded systems (Arduino, Raspberry Pi, Teensy), low-voltage electronic schematics, and physical computing. Strong competence in reading and debugging code across languages such as Python, C/C++, JavaScript, and Node-RED, as well as working knowledge of Linux/Windows/macOS administration, networking principles, version control (Git), CAD/CAM software, and hands-on fabrication tools. Soft Skills & Safety Standards: Outstanding interpersonal communication, organizational, and self-management skills with the ability to lead work projects effectively under direction from management. Uncompromising commitment to workplace safety protocols, electrical codes, standard operating procedures, and OSHA compliance (OSHA 10 General Industry preferred). Work Environment and Physical Demands To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed must be representative of the knowledge, skills, minimum education, training, licensure, experience, and/or ability required. This job primarily operates in an indoor setting with exposure to noisy environments, dim lighting, strong visual effects including strobing lights, special effects, smoke machines and small and/or enclosed spaces. Outdoor settings may also be required for special events or as needed for maintenance and troubleshooting. This position may work at heights at times and equipment and training will be provided. Moving in different positions to accomplish tasks in various environments including small, enclosed spaces Remaining in a stationary position for prolonged periods Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands and/or fingers Positioning or moving objects up to 75 pounds Use of maintenance tools and cleaning equipment, includes use of cleaning agents and chemicals Use of lead free solder with smoke extraction required Use of access equipment such as ladders and aerial work platform Safe standards are required for work at heights Ability to operate and manipulate power tools, specialty lighting, fog machine, computers, rigging equipment, projectors and all other exhibit technical equipment as needed The employee will comply with company and OSHA standard workplace safety protocols. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Work Schedule: This is a full-time position that requires the ability to work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends and holidays. Supervisor Responsibilities: This position does not require supervisory responsibility. Travel This position does not require travel.
