title: Field Operations Manager
jd_text: Job Summary: FIELD OPERATIONS MANAGER Location: Austin, TX Division: Ticketmaster NA - Festivals & GA (Front Gate Tickets) Line Manager: Senior Field Operations Manager Contract Terms: Full-Time, 40 hours per week THE TEAM Front Gate Tickets is North America’s leading software and operations provider for the festival market. We provide technical solutions for e-commerce ticketing, access control, data management, and fan engagement. We partner and run on-site operations for over 200 festivals each year and are on a massive growth trajectory matched by no one in the industry. We do it for the fans! Front Gate is owned by Live Nation Entertainment and acts as Ticketmaster’s festival arm. We have two offices located in Austin, TX. The position will be working out of those offices. THE JOB The Field Operations Manager is responsible for coordinating and overseeing the execution of onsite client events and festivals operations in collaboration with multiple departments and clients. WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING Successfully deploy FGT equipment and services at locations around the world in collaboration with multiple stakeholders. Establish time-lines and equipment needs for installations and other on-site deliverables in collaboration with Client Operations Managers and clients. Execute in field, onsite festival and box office technologies and deployment in conjunction with Client Operations Managers and clients. Create, fulfill and ship packing lists for all venues, events and festivals. Maintain existing processes and develop new processes as needed to maintain maximum efficiency. Maintain inventory of festival assets, including ensuring dirty, dusty and grimy gear returned from festivals is kept in top shape, organized and cared for. Assess loss after each festival and coordinate with Operations and Client Account Managers for coverage of damage from client. Provide support and training on FGTs products and services at events and festivals. Execute other duties, projects and events as assigned. WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS) 5+ years' of operations experience. Strong Microsoft Office skills, specifically Excel. Background in ticketing and/or entertainment industry a strong plus. Ability to travel and work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends for extended periods of time. Moves equipment weighing up to 25 pounds. Pushing and pulling of rolling carts and cases weighing up to 100 pounds. Positions self to install and maintain equipment as necessary. Must be able and willing to setup equipment at remote locations which can be hot, dusty, rainy, wet and muddy over often rocky and uneven ground. Travel is required and a big part of this role. YOU (BEHAVIORAL SKILLS) Strong background in client and customer service. Excellent communication, problem solving, and presentation skills. Strong technical background, specifically systems administration, networking and installation. Excellent trouble-shooting skills, including identification, solutions and implementations. BENEFITS & PERKS Through our ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ program, we provide benefits across six key pillars: HEALTH : Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA) YOURSELF : Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days WEALTH : 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program FAMILY : New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support CAREER : Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment OTHERS : Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match LIFE AT TICKETMASTER We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company. Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision. We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you. Our work is guided by our values: Reliability - We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen. Teamwork - We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team. Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent. Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive. title: Senior Manager, Marketing Automations & Revenue Operations

title: Senior Product Manager
jd_text: Senior Product Manager North Hospitality - Remote Join the hospitality experts. Imagine delivering sophisticated hospitality technology, simplified payment processing, and award-winning support to some of the top restaurants in the U.S. North is seeking a highly detail-oriented and technically proficient Senior Product Manager to drive the execution of our product roadmap and oversee the delivery of innovative, high-impact solutions in the payments and fintech space. You will serve as the technical backbone of the product team, collaborating closely with multiple Agile engineering teams to translate strategic vision into actionable, detailed requirements and deliverables. Daily decisions include prioritization, value, timelines, risk management, and functionality for the Developer Experience Team’s product. The Product Manager is able to understand not only the business needs and value, but has an understanding of the technical and system aspects impacted by the projects and business needs. As the Senior Product Manager, you will dig deep into technical details, coordinate complex cross-functional initiatives, and ensure that our products meet the highest standards of quality, reliability, and customer value. You will be responsible for managing and optimizing workflows using Jira and other product management tools, and will play a key role in aligning internal and external stakeholders. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on technical complexity, is relentless about details, can drive order out from multiple competing priorities, and is passionate about building products for developers in FinTech. What you'll do: Technical Product Ownership: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for assigned product areas, from ideation through delivery and ongoing optimization, with a strong emphasis on technical requirements and system integrations. jd_text: As a company, we promote a culture of honesty and integrity, and value the trust it allows us to build with customers and employees alike. Our extensive experience, connections, and deep expertise across different sectors, industries, and transportation modes, means we can be counted on for process excellence that will save time and money. #INDEED Shift: First Shift Hours: 6:00 pm - 4:30 am ​Monday - Friday Position Summary: The Maintenance Mechanic is responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, repairing, and improving conveyor systems and material handling equipment in a warehouse and distribution environment. This role performs preventive and corrective maintenance activities on mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and facility equipment to ensure operational reliability and minimize downtime. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working with conveyor systems and industrial equipment, can independently perform routine troubleshooting and repairs, and is committed to maintaining a safe and efficient operation. The Maintenance Mechanic works closely with Operations, and other Maintenance staff to support equipment reliability and continuous improvement initiatives. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Equipment Maintenance & Repair Troubleshoot, repair, and maintain conveyor systems and material handling equipment. Diagnose and repair mechanical components including bearings, rollers, belts, chains, sprockets, motors, and gearboxes. Assist in troubleshooting basic electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic systems. Observe equipment operation and identify potential mechanical failures or performance issues. Remove, repair, or replace defective components to restore equipment functionality. Test equipment following repairs to verify safe and proper operation. Assist with installation and modification of conveyors and related equipment Preventive Maintenance Perform preventive maintenance activities according to established schedules and procedures. Inspect equipment for wear, damage, misalignment, lubrication deficiencies, and other maintenance concerns. Complete lubrication, belt adjustments, component replacements, and routine maintenance activities. Document maintenance findings and report equipment concerns to maintenance leadership. Support efforts to improve equipment reliability and reduce downtime. Facility & Equipment Support Assist with maintenance and repair of warehouse support equipment including dock equipment, fans, air compressors, and facility systems. Maintain cleanliness and organization of maintenance work areas, tools, and equipment. Support emergency equipment repairs and operational uptime initiatives. Documentation & Inventory Maintain accurate maintenance records and work order documentation. Record labor hours, repairs completed, and parts used. Assist with identifying replacement parts and inventory requirements. Communicate equipment issues and repair status to maintenance leadership. Safety & Compliance Follow all OSHA, Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), machine guarding, PPE, and company safety requirements. Report hazards, near misses, and unsafe conditions immediately. Ensure maintenance work is completed safely and according to established procedures. Maintain a clean and safe work environment. Qualifications Required 1–3 years of industrial maintenance, manufacturing, distribution, warehouse, facilities, or related maintenance experience. Experience working with conveyor systems: Working knowledge of: Bearings Belts and chains Motors and gearboxes Rollers and conveyors Basic pneumatics and hydraulics Ability to safely use hand tools, power tools, and standard maintenance equipment. Basic computer skills and ability to document work electronically. Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Preferred Experience in warehouse automation, distribution, or manufacturing environments. Basic electrical troubleshooting experience. CMMS experience (SAP, Maximo, Fiix, or similar systems). Bilingual (English/Spanish). Physical Requirements Regularly lift and carry up to 50 pounds. Stand, walk, bend, kneel, reach, and climb ladders for extended periods. Work in warehouse and industrial environments with varying temperatures. Ability to work overtime, weekends, and alternative shifts as business needs require. title: Technical Campaign Operations Manager
jd_text: Are you looking for a place where you can bring your passion for campaign execution quality, team capacity, campaign build standards, QA discipline, technical troubleshooting, documentation, and process improvement in a fast-paced environment where speed, accuracy, compliance, and consistency are critical? Welcome to Neighborly—the hub of service brands that connects customers to top-notch local experts who repair, maintain, and enhance homes and businesses. Our long-standing business, with over 40 years of experience, is focused on strategic innovation as we build the future of home and business services. Bring your ambition to the table as we unlock new doors together, taking your career to the next level. The Technical Campaign Operations Manager will coach and support campaign developers, QA specialists, and marketing automation team members while bringing in enough hands-on technical expertise to evaluate build approaches, troubleshoot issues, improve QA practices, and recommend practical process improvements. The ideal candidate understands how email and SMS campaigns are built, tested, personalized, triggered, measured, and launched. This role will partner closely with Strategy, Brand, Creative, Data, Analytics, MarTech, Product, Legal, and vendor partners to ensure each campaign is built on clear requirements, validated data, sound technical logic, compliant messaging practices, and scalable operational standards. Bring your experience and be empowered to innovate. As an Technical Campaign Operations Manager on the Marketing Automation team, a typical day for you will include: Manage, coach, and support a technical marketing operations team, overseeing workload prioritization, capacity planning, performance management, skill development, and day-to-day issue resolution. Ensure accurate and timely delivery of email and SMS campaigns, including intake, audience segmentation, personalization, testing, QA, deployment, monitoring, and launch readiness. Establish and improve campaign build standards, QA processes, documentation, automation, reusable templates, scalable frameworks, and operational best practices to enhance efficiency and quality. Collaborate with Data, Product, Analytics, Engineering, MarTech, Creative, Legal, and external vendors to align business requirements, validate data and technical dependencies, and mitigate launch risks. Maintain adherence to email and SMS regulations, consent management requirements, deliverability best practices, data governance standards, and internal review processes while minimizing defects and rework. Serve as the primary escalation point for technical and operational issues, driving root-cause resolution, performance optimization, testing initiatives, and ongoing improvements in team capabilities and campaign execution. Bring your skills and be inspired to achieve success. Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Communications, or a related field preferred; equivalent hands-on experience will be considered. 5+ years of experience in marketing automation, CRM, lifecycle marketing, email/SMS operations, campaign production, technical marketing operations, or a related digital marketing role. Hands-on experience building, QA’ing, deploying, or troubleshooting campaigns in marketing automation platforms such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, Responsys, Eloqua, HubSpot, Broadly, or similar systems. Strong working knowledge of email and SMS campaign execution, including campaign setup, segmentation, personalization, dynamic content, triggered journeys, audience logic, suppression rules, subscription groups, link tracking, rendering QA, and deployment readiness. Technical fluency with HTML, CSS, Liquid or similar scripting logic, dynamic content, personalization rules, reusable templates, QA tools, and email rendering best practices. Working knowledge of customer data structures, CRM/CDP environments, APIs, webhooks, event triggers, data feeds, consent fields, suppression logic, preference management, and marketing data workflows. Proven ability to troubleshoot technical campaign issues, evaluate root causes, partner with data and technology teams, document decisions, and communicate risks clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience managing campaign throughput, SLAs, production calendars, QA cycles, launch readiness, capacity planning, and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. Strong understanding of email and SMS compliance and deliverability considerations, including CAN-SPAM, TCPA, CCPA, unsubscribe requirements, consent management, opt-out processing, list hygiene, and sender reputation. Ability to translate business requirements into technical campaign requirements, identify missing inputs, clarify logic, document dependencies, and help the team move toward scalable execution. Work Environment & Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM CT. Hybrid work model Office locations: 500 E John Carpenter Fwy, Irving, TX 1010 N University Parks Drive, Waco, TX. Competitive Pay: Commensurate with experience. Benefits: Comprehensive benefits offerings available through Neighborly. jd_text: McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. The McKesson Pentest Team is seeking a Penetration Testing Engineer to help support and scale McKesson's Continuous Adversarial Testing (CART) program and strengthen the security posture of our enterprise application ecosystem. This role provides technical support for offensive security programs, focusing on AI-enabled security testing, web application penetration testing, cloud security assessments, vulnerability validation, and adversarial testing across large-scale application portfolios. The individual in this role will partner with a pentest lead, engineering, product, cloud, and security teams to identify complex attack paths, validate threats, and drive remediation efforts that reduce business risk. The position will play a key role in executing autonomous security testing capabilities, integrating CART outputs into security operations, and advancing McKesson's offensive security assessments. This role will also help shape the future direction of AI-assisted security testing, automation, and modern offensive security methodologies across the enterprise. This is a hands-on technical role for someone who can support the development of a new security program while also performing advanced technical testing, validating AI-generated findings, solving operational challenges, and supporting the long-term direction of McKesson’s offensive security capabilities. What You'll Do Work closely with a Lead Pentest Engineer to Implement McKesson’s Continuous Adversarial Testing program across large application portfolios. Support and help shape the first iteration of the CART operating model. Execute and refine repeatable onboarding processes covering application context, test accounts, authentication, authorization roles, test data, rate limits, WAF coordination, exclusions, maintenance windows, and emergency stop procedures. Perform human-in-the-loop reviewing, reproducing, validating, prioritizing, and communicating findings generated by autonomous testing platforms. Support the execution of continuous AI assisted penetration tests across high-priority enterprise web applications, including application onboarding, test orchestration, execution oversight, findings validation, and remediation coordination. Implement integrations between CART platforms and vulnerability management, engineering, reporting, and remediation workflows. Conduct AI-enabled web application, API, and cloud security assessments across enterprise environments. Perform penetration testing, adversarial assessments, and vulnerability validation activities against internally developed and third-party applications. Evaluate emerging autonomous security testing capabilities and recommend changes to CART strategy, tooling, and service delivery. Contribute to program documentation including; playbooks, runbooks, technical standards, training materials. Leverage automation and AI-assisted security tooling to scale testing coverage and improve assessment efficiency. Identify and validate complex attack paths involving authentication weaknesses, authorization flaws, business logic vulnerabilities, and multi-stage exploitation scenarios. Evaluate REST APIs, GraphQL APIs, cloud-native architectures, and modern authentication technologies. Partner with engineering teams to explain findings, prioritize remediation efforts, and validate fixes through retesting. Develop and maintain testing methodologies, automation workflows, and security assessment procedures. Contribute to incident investigations, threat modeling activities, and continuous security improvement initiatives. Basic Requirements 4+ years of cybersecurity, application security, penetration testing, offensive security, or related experience. Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience. Experience performing web application and API penetration testing. Experience validating security vulnerabilities, assessing exploitability, and distinguishing actionable findings from false positives. Experience assessing enterprise applications utilizing REST APIs, GraphQL APIs, authentication systems, and cloud-native technologies. Working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) security concepts. Experience documenting technical findings and communicating remediation guidance to engineering teams. Hands-on experience with Burp Suite Professional, Nuclei, Nmap, Metasploit, Postman, and Kali Linux tools. Preferred Skills/Experience Experience leveraging AI-assisted security tools and security automation platforms. Experience implementing, operating, or scaling continuous security testing, attack simulation, breach and attack simulation, or automated offensive security capabilities. Experience evaluating, validating, and triaging findings from automated or AI-assisted security testing platforms. Experience assessing AI-enabled applications, agent-based systems, LLM integrations, or AI security risks. Familiarity with DevSecOps, CI/CD security controls, and secure software development practices. Knowledge of OWASP Top 10, API Security Top 10, threat modeling, and secure design principles. Experience conducting red team, adversarial simulation, or attack path validation exercises. Knowledge of cloud security architecture and containerized environments. Experience performing cloud security assessments in AWS, Azure, and GCP environments. Experience creating custom security testing scripts and automation workflows. Experience developing proof-of-concept exploits and adversary emulation scenarios. Familiarity with security control validation and compliance frameworks. Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to security program maturity. Experience supporting regulated industries such as healthcare, finance, or other highly regulated environments. Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, OSWA, OSAI, HTB CWES, HTB CWEE, OSEP, GPEN, GWAPT or equivalent. Travel / Work Environment / Physical Requirements Limited travel may be required based on business needs. Hyrbid, two days a week in the office. title: Sr. Engineering Project Manager

jd_text: 7-Eleven is an iconic family of brands with over 86,000 locations, surpassing every retailer in the world. jd_text: Exemption Status: United States of America (Exempt) $132,323 - $186,576 - $240,828 “Pay scale information is not necessarily reflective of actual compensation that may be earned, nor a promise of any specific pay for any selected candidate or employee, which is always dependent on actual experience, education, qualifications, and other factors. MedImpact Healthcare Systems, Inc. is looking for extraordinary people to join our team! Why join MedImpact? Because our success is dependent on you; innovative professionals with top notch skills who thrive on opportunity, high performance, and teamwork. We look for individuals who want to work on a team that cares about making a difference in the value of healthcare. At MedImpact, we deliver leading edge pharmaceutical and technology related solutions that dramatically improve the value of health care. We provide superior outcomes to those we serve through innovative products, systems, and services that provide transparency and promote choice in decision making. Our vision is to set the standard in providing solutions that optimize satisfaction, service, cost, and quality in the healthcare industry. We are the premier Pharmacy Benefits Management solution! Job Description Summary The Principal, Digital Product Management leads the overall strategy, goals, and objectives for MedImpact Digital Products and Services. This position will be the leader of digital assets and will drive initiatives with the product management team through the entire product development lifecycle (from discovery to delivery) and build an environment conducive to forming a high-performing team. The position’s focus will be to create a more maneuverable and "next best action" type of experience where consumers/members can find the information and tools they need within only a few clicks and present relevant recommendations personalized to them and their family members and to improve affordability and health outcomes at a scale. Works with a range of internal partners and external partners, gathering their perspectives throughout product roadmap creation and evolution. Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned. This position is responsible for leading the strategy and execution of new product development, product enhancements, extensions and end-of-life to existing products and services from concept through deployment. Ensures products and services are successful, meet corporate operational excellence criteria and yield revenue to meet target goals. Leads the research, development and implementation of Digital Products and Services. Identifies, analyzes, monitors and suggests actions for products and services that materially contribute to overall mission and strategy of the company. Evaluates new product development opportunities and existing product enhancements/extensions based on a well-defined product criteria. Leads the conceptualization, design, product development and implementation of approved new and expanded products & services utilizing industry standard methodologies for product lifecycle management. Responsible for the execution of simultaneous products under development, from product concept and approval through deployment. This may include support of: product strategy definition and roadmap; development of marketing and product requirements documents with prioritized features and corresponding justification; prototype development; and development of strong voice of the customer and competitive intelligence. This position will interface with other areas within the company, including IT, Sales & Marketing, Operations, Finance/Analytics and Project Management. Provides product management oversight for assigned products and services, including annual strategic product planning; revenue and expense budgeting and forecasting; pricing; sales strategy development and facilitation; product positioning, packaging, and messaging; marketing and sales material development; product training, assessment, and support; RFP support; and product demonstrations. Serves as the primary subject matter expert for cross functional business units for product development and management of Digital Products and Services. Conducts market and competitive analysis by retrieving information from a variety of sources, including but not limited to proprietary databases, Internet, focus groups and other data sources. Utilizes information retrieved to conduct research and analysis and presents results to leadership and product teams. Completes all documentation throughout the product or project lifecycle, including creating business cases, business plans, business requirements, and product toolkits. Supervisory Responsibilities Manages assigned staff in the segment area. Responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of the unit. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems. Supports and enforces all company policies and procedures in a fair and consistent manner, taking corrective action whenever necessary. Client Responsibilities This is an internal and external client facing position that requires excellent customer service skills and interpersonal communication skills (listening/verbal/written). One must be able to; manage difficult or emotional client situations; Respond promptly to client needs; Solicit client feedback to improve service; Respond to requests for service and assistance from clients; Meet commitments to clients. Qualifications To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Education and/or Experience BA/BS Degree; 8+ years related experience and 8+ years of SME in respective area(s); (or equivalent combination of education and experience) If this role has supervisory responsibilities with at least 4+ years leading individual contributors and leaders of leaders; which may be substituted with an appropriate mix of leadership experience and 5 years of MedImpact experience plus an appropriate external leadership training program and internal mentorship with a seasoned leader (VP+ level) that must completed within 12 months in new position. Computer Skills To perform this job successfully, an individual should have knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Project and a working knowledge of systems platforms and new technologies. Certificates, Licenses, Registrations Product Management Certification (e.g. AIPMM, PDMA, Pragmatic Institute) preferred. Project Management Professional and Certified Scrum Master certification preferred. Other Skills and Abilities Previous new product development, product management, and sales/marketing experience in the health information technology field required. Prior pharmacy benefits management, disease management, healthcare or managed care environment experience strongly preferred. Experience in more than one of the following disciplines a plus: Technology Management, Product Marketing, Product Price Management, Finance, Operations. Subject matter expertise in product and project lifecycle management and methodologies, continuous quality improvement, and change management. Knowledgeable in marketing, including market research, market sizing, targeting, pricing, marketing communications, sales training, and product launch. Thorough knowledge of IT systems, applications, databases, architecture, and software development lifecycle, computer engineering. General knowledge of finance, including ability to read and understand financial data such as product income statements, ROI analysis, net-present value analysis. General knowledge of operations, including scheduling, procurement, manufacturing, test engineering and quality systems preferred. Knowledge and experience with Agile product and project management methodologies a must. Clear track record for achieving goals and deliverables that meet revenue goals. Reasoning Ability Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form. Mathematical Skills Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations. Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry. Language Skills Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public. Competencies To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies: Business Acumen Directing Others Organizational Agility Conflict Management Drive for Results Political Savvy Customer Focus Innovation Management Strategic Agility Decision Quality Managerial Courage Physical Demands The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to sit and talk or hear. The employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Remote work is not an option for these purposes. title: Principal Engineer & Manager, Private Cloud Platforms
jd_text: Company Overview At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future. Department Overview The Core Platform and Services, Infrastructure team is responsible for the development and operations of critical cloud and on-premise infrastructure and platform services, in support of Motorola Solutions' public and hybrid cloud-based Software as a Service (SaaS) solutions for public safety customers. This team is part of Motorola Solutions’ Software Enterprise division, which offers secure, reliable and efficient team communications, workflow and operational intelligence solutions for mission critical public safety and enterprise markets throughout the world. Job Description The On-Premise Infrastructure Engineering team is responsible for: Design and implementation of local continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines within dedicated on-premise environments. Development and operation of common platform services—centered on RedHat OpenShift and Kubernetes —that are leveraged by our software solutions. Physical and Virtual Infrastructure: Managing the full stack, including Networking, Storage, and Compute , to ensure the reliability and security of environments where our services run. Monitoring and support for these internal platform services to ensure 24/7 availability for our customers. As a Manager, Platform Engineering on this team, you will be a hands-on leader responsible for developing services, tools, and processes that support our engineering teams. We are looking for a technical lead who is motivated by automation and infrastructure-as-code , but possesses the deep foundational knowledge required to manage bare-metal and virtualized on-premise stacks . You will be working on a results-oriented team where you are expected to lead by example—balancing people management with active technical contribution. Your efforts will help shape the engineering culture and best practices across Motorola Solutions’ Software Enterprise organization. Responsibilities will include: Technical Leadership: Act as a hands-on guide for the team, participating in architectural design and troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues. On-Premise Operations: Lead the deployment and maintenance of RedHat OpenShift and Kubernetes clusters in private data center environments. Infrastructure Design: Direct the implementation of L3/L4 networking (load balancers/firewalls) and software-defined storage solutions. Reliability & Performance: Define and meet strict scalability, availability, and security goals for local environments. Collaboration: Rapidly build and evolve major platform features in collaboration with Product Management and other engineering stakeholders. Governance: Assist in reviews and audits conducted at various points in the software life cycle to ensure compliance and security. Qualifications: Hands-on Expertise: Deep technical knowledge of Linux Administration and container orchestration (Kubernetes/OpenShift) is mandatory. Experience: Bachelor's degree with 5+ years of experience in Network Engineering , Platform Engineering , or Systems Architecture . Networking/Storage: Proven experience with Layer 3/4 Networking design, firewall management, and on-premise storage protocols. Automation Skills: Solid coding and scripting skills (Python, Shell) to automate data center operations. Agility: Ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving, and agile environment with a strong level of curiosity. Strong level of curiosity and interest to learn Excellent communications skills and the ability to present complex topics to nontechnical audiences Self motivated and able to maintain focus in a pressured environment Primary Skills (Must-Have Hands-On Knowledge) These are the core competencies the Manager will use daily to lead the team and troubleshoot the environment. Container Orchestration: Expertise in RedHat OpenShift (OCP) and upstream Kubernetes cluster design, deployment, and management in a non-cloud environment. Linux Mastery: Advanced Linux Administration (RHEL preferred), including performance tuning, kernel parameters, and system security. On-Prem Networking: Deep understanding of Layer 3/4 Networking , including BGP, Load Balancing (NGINX, HAProxy, or F5), and Firewall management. Automation & Scripting: Proficiency in Python and Shell scripting to automate manual data center tasks and infrastructure provisioning. Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Experience with Ansible or Terraform (specifically for on-premise providers like VMware or Bare Metal). Version Control & CI/CD: Git/GitOps workflows and managing on-premise CI/CD instances (e.g., GitLab or Jenkins). Nice-to-Have Skills (Preferred) These skills will help the candidate excel but are not strictly required for the initial "hands-on" technical baseline. Storage Engineering: Experience with Software Defined Storage (SDS) such as Ceph , Rook , or traditional SAN/NAS (NetApp/Dell EMC). Virtualization: Deep experience with VMware vSphere or KVM hypervisors. Identity Management: Integration with Active Directory , LDAP, and SSSD for centralized authentication. Observability: Implementing on-premise monitoring stacks using Prometheus, Grafana , and ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana). Certifications: * Certified Kubernetes Administrator ( CKA ), Red Hat Certified Engineer ( RHCE ) or Architect ( RHCA ) Security: Experience with air-gapped environments and hardening standards (CIS Benchmarks/STIGs). This position is subject to working in high security areas governed by the US Department of Justice's "Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Security Policy" and therefore requires successfully passing a more stringent fingerprint background check administered by Motorola Solutions Inc. customers. Target Base Salary Range: $150,000 - $170,000 USD Consistent with Motorola Solutions values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Pay within this range varies and depends on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate. #LI-RS1 Basic Requirements Bachelor's degree with 5+ years of experience in Network Engineering, Platform Engineering, or Systems Architecture with strong expertise in Container Orchestration, Advanced Linux Administration, On-Prem Networking, Automation & Scripting, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Version Control & CI/CD. Must be able to obtain background clearance as required by government customer. Travel Requirements Under 10% Relocation Provided None Position Type Experienced Referral Payment Plan Yes Our U.S. Benefits include: Incentive Bonus Plans Medical, Dental, Vision benefits 401K with Company Match 10 Paid Holidays Generous Paid Time Off Packages Employee Stock Purchase Plan Paid Parental & Family Leave and more! title: Senior Computer Vision Engineer
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><h3>About the Team</h3> <p>The Counter Intrusion MSE team develops systems that provide force protection capabilities, monitoring the perimeter of secure areas, land or sea, for approaching people, vehicles, and vessels. We live in a world where security officers are increasingly overwhelmed by sensor data feeds. Our products leverage advanced sensor fusion and autonomy to seamlessly render activity in the environment to Lattice's common operating picture. This relieves operators of our system from a ton of burden and allows our customers to get more done with fewer personnel. Increasingly, Counter Intrusion MLEs are working on projects to bring customers' existing legacy security systems into the Lattice ecosystem. Key to this effort is building scalable software solutions so that we can service many customers without requiring bespoke software for each one. The Counter Intrusion team is responsible for the development, testing, deployment, and sustainment of our family of systems. We work closely with other teams from product, engineering, sales, logistics, operations, and mission success.</p> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to apply the latest research to solve our toughest problems. This role will be responsible for owning the whole machine learning stack for the Counter Intrusion team. You will design and train multi-sensor object detection models for perception on edge compute devices that push the boundaries of what's possible with our sensors. You will develop learning algorithms to optimize the behavior of autonomous systems. You will also be responsible for the end-to-end design, implementation, and performance of the ML stack, including the infrastructure for data collection and training. Your work will directly impact Anduril's ability to deliver cutting-edge defense technology, with the opportunity to identify and develop novel ML applications across our product portfolio.</p> <h4>Responsibilities</h4> <ul> <li>Propose and prototype innovative solutions to solve real-world problems, leveraging the latest state-of-the-art techniques in the field</li> <li>Develop and maintain core ML pipelines</li> <li>Train and deploy deep learning models for real-time applications</li> <li>Collaborate cross-functionally with camera, systems and labeling teams</li> <li>Curate datasets for evaluating performance and comparing performance trends over time</li> <li>Provide technical mentorship to other junior ML engineers</li> </ul> <h4>Required Qualifications</h4> <ul> <li>MS or PhD in Machine Learning, Robotics or Computer Science, with emphasis on Computer Vision</li> <li>BS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or related field</li> <li>6+ years of experience developing, benchmarking and optimizing ML algorithms on large-scale datasets</li> <li>Strong Deep Learning and CV background</li> <li>Proficiency in C++ development in a Linux environment</li> <li>Experience with Python development and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX and TensorFlow</li> <li>Experience deploying models with TensorRT and ONNX</li> <li>Optimize on-device inference and vision kernels across CPU/GPU/NPU</li> <li>Track record of developing and deploying CV models from R&amp;D to production</li> <li>Experience writing and maintaining automated continuous integration tests</li> <li>Knowledge of system profiling and tuning for latency, memory and power efficiency</li> <li>Ability to conduct experiments, ablation studies and create highly detailed reports</li> <li>Eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance</li> </ul> <h4>Preferred Qualifications</h4> <ul> <li>Experience in one or more of the following:</li> <ul> <li>Object Detection, Object Tracking, Instance Segmentation, Semantic Segmentation, Semantic Change Detection, Depth Estimation, Model Pruning and Compression</li> </ul> <li>Experience in one or more of the following:</li> <ul> <li>Visual Odometry, SLAM, Multi-view Geometry, Camera Models, RGB-D and LIDAR Sensor Fusion, Optical Flow</li> </ul> <li>Experience troubleshooting and analyzing remotely deployed software systems</li> <li>1 year of experience in a technical leadership role</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">US Hourly Range Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.&nbsp;</span><em><span data-contrast="auto">For more information, <a href="https://www.anduril.com/careers">Explore Our Benefits</a>.</span></em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <div class="RichText column1"> <h3 class="detailElios"><strong>Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams</strong></h3> <p class="detailElios">Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.</p> </li> <li><strong>Please always verify communications:</strong> <ul> <li>Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will <em>only</em> come from an <code>@anduril.com</code> address.</li> <li>Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. title: Agent Operator
jd_text: McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care. What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you. Role Summary The Agent Operator is accountable for what Sierra AI agents know and how they behave. This role tunes agent prompts, intents, conversation flows, and the knowledge they retrieve so that agents respond accurately, consistently, and in the McKesson voice across email, chat, and voice. This is a hands-on operator role inside the Agentic Service Experience pillar. The Tuner adjusts the agent every day; reading transcripts, testing changes, curating the agent-facing knowledge base, and shipping iterations in partnership with Sierra and McKesson Technology. They translate the AI Agent Product Manager's prioritized backlog into actual agent behavior and translate quality findings from the AI Performance & Quality Analyst into prompt, flow, and knowledge changes. This is a new role created as part of CxO's agentic service operating model and will help shape how agent tuning and knowledge curation scale through FY27 and beyond. Key Responsibilities AI Knowledge Authoring Author and structure prompt-aware content for AI agents. Write knowledge so agents respond accurately and empathetically without hallucinating. Decide where the agent needs no additional content, where it needs context, where it can pull data from upstream systems, and where it needs detailed instructions. Tailor knowledge accordingly. Incorporate knowledge from across NAPS. Pull domain expertise from SMEs across service delivery teams into the agent knowledge base so agents respond to real customer scenarios, not just documented ones. Author in the McKesson voice. Ensure agent responses are brand-aligned, empathetic, and appropriate for healthcare and pharmaceutical customers. Partner with brand, communications, and Responsible AI partners on tone and standards. AI Information Architecture Ensure content is relevant, accurate, current, non-conflicting, and succinct. Identify gaps in content that cause agents to provide wrong answers or fail to help and fix them quickly. Optimize knowledge for retrieval. Clean up metadata, improve vector match probabilities, and decide how to chunk knowledge so retrieval is accurate and efficient on latency and cost. Treat the knowledge base as a system the agent reasons over, not a document library. Maintain knowledge freshness. Establish review cadences, last-verified dates, and removal protocols. Stale knowledge in an agent KB becomes a confident wrong answer; manage it accordingly. AI Performance Tuning Analyze failed AI conversations to identify knowledge gaps. Read transcripts, listen to calls, and read latency and accuracy logs to see where the agent “got lost” in the knowledge base. Update documentation or metadata to improve future performance and validate the fix worked. Optimize retrieval accuracy and response crafting. Use working knowledge of the Sierra tech stack to ensure responses are crafted according to segmentation requirements and decision logic across customer groups and channels. Feed back to content owners. Provide feedback to the human-facing KB owners and content standards teams when their standards or content are hindering agent performance, and partner on resolution. Product Thinking and Experimentation Provide feedback to product and engineering. Inform the AI Agent PM and McKesson Technology on prompt improvements and platform enhancements needed for authoring effective agent knowledge. Operate in an agile fashion to adapt to a rapidly changing AI ecosystem. Experiment with knowledge approaches. Lead use case evolution by experimenting with options to decide how much deterministic knowledge is necessary versus where to depend on LLM reasoning. The right answer is different for different intents, customer groups, and risk levels. Minimum Requirement Degree or equivalent and typically requires 7+ years of relevant experience. Education Bachelor's degree Critical Skills 7+ years of experience in Technical Writing, Information Architecture, Conversation Design, Knowledge Management, or Product Operations. 1+ year of demonstrated hands-on work with AI knowledge for a deployed conversational or agentic AI system. Demonstrated experience authoring structured content for technical or digital systems with the ability to author in a defined brand voice and translate ambiguous human guidance into precise, machine-actionable content. Analytical mindset with attention to precision and clarity; able to read transcripts, latency, and accuracy logs to diagnose where the agent failed and why. Excellent collaboration skills with both technical (product managers, engineers, data scientists) and non-technical stakeholders (frontline supervisors, SMEs, Legal, brand). Experience working in environments with evolving requirements and limited established processes. This role is shaping how the work gets done, not following an established playbook. Preferred Qualifications Experience working with leading LLMs (e.g., Claude, GPT-4, Gemini) and Gen AI concepts including RAG, agentic AI, chain-of-thought prompting, decision flows, and AI reasoning. Direct experience with the Sierra platform or a comparable agentic AI platform deployed at enterprise scale. Systems thinking: ability to identify downstream implications of knowledge gaps and judgment around edge cases, ambiguity, and exception handling. Understanding of semantic precision in the AI context. Experience managing knowledge bases or content systems (e.g., KM platforms, CMS tools) Contact center, customer service, or BPO domain experience in healthcare, life sciences, or regulated industries. Prior experience as a contact center agent, trainer, QA analyst, or knowledge base owner before moving into AI. Familiarity with responsible AI principles and risk considerations for regulated customer interactions. Familiarity with SQL, Python, or JSON is a plus. What Success Looks Like in Year One Agent accuracy, tone consistency, and hallucination rates meet or exceed McKesson's published targets across go-lives. A structured, tagged, and current agent knowledge base is in place, with documented change control and a working synchronization process with the human KB of record. A documented tuning backlog is being worked on a predictable cadence, with each change traceable to a transcript, QA finding, or prioritized roadmap item. The AI Performance & Quality Analyst reports that observed quality issues are being triaged and resolved through a clear feedback loop. The AI Agent PM has a reliable partner for translating roadmap priorities into shipped agent improvements. SMEs across NAPS report that the agent reflects their domain accurately and that the process for updating agent knowledge works. This role is a hybrid position . The selected candidate is expected to work on-site at our Fort Worth office a minimum of two (2) days per week , with the remaining days worked remotely. Specific in-office days may be designated based on team needs and business priorities. McKesson complies with all applicable U.S. immigration laws and regulations. The Company does not provide employer support or sponsorship for any immigration related employment benefit for this role. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a fulltime basis without the need for employer support or sponsorship now or in the future. This includes having the legal right to work in the United States without the need for McKesson support or sponsorship for any immigration related employment authorization (e.g., H1B, O1, E3, H1B1, TN, F1 OPT, F1 STEM OPT, F1 CPT, etc.) now or in the future. If you will require McKesson to provide immigration support or sponsorship now or in the future, you should not apply for this position We are proud to offer a competitive compensation package at McKesson as part of our Total Rewards. title: Branch General Manager
jd_text: Your Impact at Lowe’s As the Branch General Manager (BGM), you will be a key member of the leadership team, coaching and training associates, delegating, following up on daily tasks, managing performance, and ensuring adequate department coverage managing the daily operations of the Branch. This role includes building and supporting a branch culture, in partnership with key stakeholders, that is aligned to the Lowe’s mission and behaviors where employees are engaged and inspired. This leader is also responsible for maintaining a strategic view of branch talent needs, recruiting, and developing talent. The Branch General Manager drives the execution of operations strategies, analyzing relevant data to inform branch specific strategies, supporting customer service, proactively addressing branch needs, and acting as the Lowe’s brand ambassador for the community. How We Support You As an industry leader, we invest in the people and technology needed to grow and win as a team. Grow Your Career: We foster a culture that embraces continuous learning, empowering you to develop your skills. From lateral moves and promotions to a new career field, we can help you shape (and own) your future. Culture of Belonging: Our teams enjoy a positive work environment where leaders support and respect you, and associates genuinely appreciate each other. Financial Future: We invest in you – own part of the company with our optional Employee Stock Purchase Plan, or participate in our matching 401k plan. Bonus Potential: When we win, you win. We award front line workers discretionary and profit-sharing bonuses when we succeed. Health and Wellbeing : We offer paid time off for vacations, holidays and sick time, as well as access to top-tier medical, dental and vision insurance. For information about our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit https://talent.lowes.com/us/en/benefits . Your Day at Lowe’s In this role, the BGM is responsible for hiring, training, coaching, motivating, and driving engagement of warehouse, driver, and branch associates. In addition, the BGM partners with sales teams in the field and the support team members to achieve business goals. The BGM manages the flow of products both in and out to provide the highest level of customer service. The BGM also works closely with cross-functional partners in HR, Asset Protection, and Sales to execute the Lowe’s Pro Supply business strategy within his/her Branch. Key Responsibilities Influences overall business results by building and maintaining cross-functional partnerships with Human Resources, Safety & Asset Protection, Sales and Support Teams Actively identifies barriers to performance and uses available cross-functional resources to help diagnose issues and remove barriers Leverages financial reports and business data to support decisions that positively impact key branch metrics Creates a climate that supports training and development by identifying employees' training needs, supporting enterprise-wide and branch-level training initiatives, removing obstacles, and providing access to developmental resources Promotes continuous improvement by seeking feedback and addressing opportunities on own leadership and performance Minimum Qualifications 5 years of experience in leading Associates in warehouse, distribution center or large retail environments Minimum of 3 years of experience managing P&L Experience building and maintaining cross-functional relationships in a matrixed environment Experience with software applications such as Microsoft Office and/or a Warehouse Management System Preferred Qualifications Experience in recruiting, developing and retaining effective teams. Experience in managing resources, time and budgets Experience in working cross functionally, identifying, and resolving significant process improvement opportunities. Experience taking a lead role in a corporate-led initiative or leadership experience in another Lowes Supply Chain network facility. Bi-lingual skills, if applicable to the facility Schedule Requirements Available to work a set schedule that may be changed by management based on the facility's needs. May be asked to work mornings, afternoons, nights, and/or weekends based on the facility's needs. Working Conditions Environmental factors vary by location. You may be working in both inside and outside weather conditions. Exposure to varying climates, including extreme heat or cold, wet, damp, humid, windy, or drafty conditions, is possible. You may be exposed to constant or intermittent noises in addition to moving or shaking objects and equipment. Lifting methods vary based on role, weight, and volume. Associates must follow guidelines, limiting single lifts to 70 pounds. Team lifts are used minimally starting at 70 pounds or when needed. Powered equipment should be used as required, with proper training or assistance from a trained coworker. About Lowe’s Lowe's Companies, Inc. (NYSE: LOW) is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week, with total fiscal year 2025 sales of more than $86 billion. Lowe's employs approximately 300,000 associates and operates over 1,700 home improvement stores, 530 branches and 130 distribution centers. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe's supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com . title: Project Manager, Enterprise PMO / Special Projects
jd_text: 7-Eleven is an iconic family of brands with over 86,000 locations, surpassing every retailer in the world. We revolutionize convenience, restaurants and fuel through cutting edge innovation — working hard to be the customer's first choice. 7-Eleven empowers our employees to "activate awesome" and make a meaningful impact in their stores and communities every day. If you're ready to grow, lead and make a difference, come join our team and help shape the future of convenience. This position is part of the Enterprise PMO responsible to provide project and program management for key strategic and operational initiatives at 7-Eleven involving cross functional teams and budgets up to $10MM+. The project manager is responsible to develop and execute PMO projects to ensure cross functional alignment, drive and manage the teams to meet strict deadlines and achieve financial goals. Responsibilities include financial and project governance, project execution excellence and reducing risks for SEI leveraging project management principles and tools. Duties and Responsibilities include but are not limited to: Ensures that program scope and business objectives are clearly documented and agreed to for complex, cross-functional projects. Identify and organize the appropriate cross-functional teams to achieve project goals. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop detailed project plans, identifying the proper work streams owners and cross-work stream dependencies. Coach teams to ensure the project team works together efficiently and effectively. Work collaboratively with business owners to define initial budget and resources required. Manage and analyze on-going financials to ensure project is tracking to budget. Understand the details of the project plan to effectively manage the dependencies and adjust plans as necessary. Drive accountability and project progress according to the aligned-on project plan. Identify and document project risks and issues, escalating when appropriate and developing mitigation strategies to minimize project impacts. Through regular cadence of reporting, ensure visibility and transparency on project progress milestones, financial governance, issues and risks. Focus on driving results, finding cost saving opportunities and efficiencies in the project life cycle while leveraging project best practices. Ability to effectively facilitate and lead meetings of varying size and purpose In addition to the skills above, the Project Manager needs to be proficient and demonstrate the following leadership competencies: Ability to effectively build relationships to influence stakeholders and teams through indirect leadership, working across organizational lines and varying levels of the organization, including VP/SVP level. Demonstrated ability to communicate key project points and adjust communications as needed based on audience, making the complex simple to understand. Develop an understanding of company vision, strategy, and key initiatives. Achieve detailed understanding of functional area of the project and related processes to be able to challenge assumptions and thinking and provide thought leadership. Ability to solve problems by assessing the situation, leveraging data where applicable, identifying root cause and developing potential solutions. Ability to operate in environments with ambiguity and ability create clarity. High level of agility and adaptability; ability to quickly learn details of new business functions and operate in various project methodologies Identify dependencies and impacts of project changes across other key initiatives Contribute to continuous improvement of PMO processes and maturity Manage collaboration and communication with other teams, both internal and external, to ensure teams have what they need and can work efficiently. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Education: Bachelors/4-Yr Degree, MBA/Master’s preferred Experience: 5-10 years’ experience leading teams and/or projects, setting strategic direction and execution plans, Program Management and project governance. Familiarity with project governance and PMP ideologies. PMP not required but preferred. Strong analytical skills and process improvement viewpoint. Strong Word/Excel/PowerPoint skills mandatory. Excellent verbal & written communication skills required. Effectively interact & influence internal & external stakeholders at all levels. title: Product Marketing Manager – Life Sciences Analytics & Real-World Data
jd_text: Ready to transform healthcare with powerful data, trusted insights, and real-world results? At Truven, we’re not just working with healthcare data, we’re changing how the industry uses it to improve lives. We are seeking a data-driven and commercially minded Product Marketing Manager focused on MarketScan®, Truven’s flagship healthcare analytics and real-world data platform serving the Life Sciences market. You will act as the critical link between our Product, Sales, and Marketing teams, translating complex healthcare analytics and data capabilities into compelling value propositions that resonate with biopharmaceutical companies, medical device manufacturers, and research organizations. The ideal candidate combines strong B2B product marketing experience with an understanding of healthcare analytics, Life Sciences buyers, and go-to-market execution. This individual will help shape product positioning, drive commercial growth, improve competitive differentiation, and equip sales teams to win in an increasingly competitive healthcare data and analytics market. If you have a deep understanding of the Life Sciences landscape and a proven track record of driving product growth, we want you on our team. About MarketScan MarketScan® is Truven’s flagship healthcare analytics and real-world data platform, delivering one of the industry’s most trusted sources of healthcare claims, patient, provider, and treatment insights. MarketScan enables Life Sciences organizations, medical device companies, research organizations, and healthcare stakeholders to better understand patient populations, generate evidence, evaluate outcomes, and make more informed commercial and clinical decisions. As the Product Marketing Manager for MarketScan, you will own positioning, messaging, market intelligence, and go-to-market strategy for one of Truven’s most strategic growth portfolios. You will work closely with Product Management, Sales, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership to accelerate growth within the Life Sciences market while helping customers unlock the value of real-world data and healthcare analytics. How You Will Contribute Drive Market Growth Increase MarketScan’s footprint within the Life Sciences segment by effectively positioning and differentiating our data and analytics solutions. Partner with commercial teams to drive awareness, engagement, pipeline growth, and customer adoption. Own Market Positioning & Messaging Define and evolve MarketScan positioning, messaging, and value propositions across key Life Sciences buyer segments. Translate complex healthcare analytics and data capabilities into compelling narratives that resonate with commercial, clinical, research, and business stakeholders. Provide Market Intelligence Monitor the Life Sciences landscape and adjacent markets. Gather actionable insights on market trends, competitor movements, customer needs, and regulatory changes to inform our product and marketing strategies. Lead Competitive Intelligence & Win/Loss Analysis Develop and maintain competitive intelligence programs focused on market trends, competitors, positioning, and differentiation. Conduct win/loss analysis to understand buying criteria, competitive threats, customer decision-making, and opportunities to improve sales effectiveness. Define Segmentation & Buyer Personas Define and maintain deep, actionable buyer personas across Life Sciences and research-focused audiences. Segment the market to identify high-value targets and tailor our approach to address their specific pain points and goals. Drive Go-to-Market Excellence Partner with Product Management to develop go-to-market strategies and launch plans for new MarketScan products, capabilities, enhancements, and innovations. Coordinate cross-functional activities and measure adoption and business impact. Enable Sales Success Serve as a strategic partner to Sales and GTM teams. Develop messaging frameworks, competitive battlecards, presentations, sales enablement materials, and customer-facing content that improve sales effectiveness, shorten sales cycles, and increase win rates. Improve Product Adoption Accelerate the uptake of new features and existing products among current Life Sciences clients through targeted lifecycle marketing, customer communications, and value-driven messaging. Deliver Life Sciences Market Insights Act as the voice of the market and customer, helping internal stakeholders better understand buyer needs, industry dynamics, and emerging opportunities within healthcare analytics and real-world data. What You Will Bring 8+ years of B2B product marketing experience, preferably supporting healthcare analytics, healthcare data, Life Sciences technology, SaaS, or Real-World Data solutions. Proven success driving product positioning, go-to-market strategy, competitive differentiation, sales enablement, and revenue growth. Experience partnering closely with Product Management, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing teams to drive business outcomes. Deep understanding of the full marketing and sales funnel – you know what it takes to partner across product management, sales, and marketing functions to generate demand, nurture intelligently, and drive revenue outcomes. Ability to analyze ambiguous market signals, customer insights, competitive dynamics, and qualitative data where evaluation of intangibles is required . Ability to provide thought leadership on market trends, buyer needs, and competitive strategy, and contribute to broader company-wide initiatives. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a talent for making complex concepts accessible. Strong executive presence with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, facilitate strategic discussions, and represent Truven internally and externally. Strong analytical skills to interpret market data and translate it into actionable business strategy. A “figure-it-out” mindset: you move fast, proactively solve problems, and bring positive momentum, especially when priorities shift. Preferred Qualifications Experience working with Life Sciences organizations, including biopharmaceutical companies, medical device manufacturers, contract research organizations, or healthcare research firms. Experience with Real-World Data (RWD), Real-World Evidence (RWE), healthcare claims data, healthcare analytics, or evidence generation solutions. Experience developing competitive intelligence and win/loss programs. Experience supporting enterprise sales organizations and strategic account initiatives. Experience launching new products, solutions, or technology capabilities within healthcare markets. What We Offer A team connected by a bigger purpose - Truven offers a unique opportunity to be part of a mission-driven organization, dedicated to transforming healthcare through trusted analytics and data-driven solutions. A culture rooted in collaboration and kindness – We believe great work starts with mutual respect and genuine teamwork. It's not just about what you achieve, it’s about how you get there. We know that solving big, complex challenges is easier (and more fun) when you’re surrounded by smart, motivated people who support each other and work toward common goals. A place to build and grow your career – We believe that learning never stops, curiosity should be celebrated, and every challenge is a chance to grow. Here, you won’t just build skills, you’ll build a career that evolves with you. A total rewards package that reflects our values – We believe in taking care of our people and their families, so they can bring their best selves to work. We provide a comprehensive and competitive benefits package, annual bonus plan, paid time off, remote work flexibility and more. If you’re inspired by the opportunity to use data and analytics to drive real change in healthcare, Truven offers a chance to do just that. Here, your work will help clients make informed decisions that improve care, reduce costs, and support healthier communities—locally and globally. Join us and be part of a team that’s redefining what’s possible in healthcare through insight, integrity, and innovation. title: Global Technical Marketing Specialist - Food Safety
jd_text: It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing! As a key member of Neogen’s Global Portfolio team, the Global Technical Marketing Specialist - Food Safety serves as the technical content and scientific integrity lead for assigned product portfolios. This role translates scientific evidence, product performance data, and customer applications into credible, customer-focused content that supports portfolio growth, commercialization, customer adoption, lifecycle management, and launch excellence. Translate complex scientific, technical, application, and product performance data into clear, customer-relevant materials for internal and external audiences. Partner with Portfolio Management, Field Application Scientists, R&D, Scientific Affairs, Regulatory, Quality, Technical Services, Sales, and Regional Marketing to develop technically accurate and commercially effective content. Develop technical materials that support commercialization, customer adoption, product positioning, differentiation, and lifecycle management. Ensure technical messaging is consistent across products, applications, markets, and customer-facing channels. Documentation Ownership and Scientific Integrity Own and maintain core technical documentation for assigned products, including product instructions, equipment manuals, technical bulletins, application guides, training materials, validation reports, customer case studies, and scientific white papers. Ensure assigned technical documentation meets established standards for accuracy, scientific integrity, consistency, usability, and quality. Verify that technical materials align with approved product claims, validation data, intended use, workflow requirements, and product limitations. Support document review, revision control, and harmonization across global markets and functions. Establish and maintain consistent standards for technical writing, formatting, and content quality. Collaborate with Regulatory, Quality, Scientific Affairs, and other applicable functions to support appropriate review and approval of technical materials. Technical Enablement, Product Positioning, and Launches Partner with Portfolio Managers to ensure scientific evidence and technical content support portfolio strategy, product positioning, differentiation, pricing, and growth initiatives. Provide technical marketing support for product launches, commercialization activities, and launch readiness. Develop launch-related technical materials, including training presentations, workflow diagrams, performance summaries, frequently asked questions, application guides, and technical comparison materials. Support training for Sales, Technical Services, distributors, and regional marketing teams to strengthen product knowledge and messaging consistency. Equip customer-facing teams with credible technical information regarding product performance, workflow advantages, applications, and differentiation. Contribute technical expertise to launch planning, launch reviews, and post-launch optimization activities. Develop technical comparison tools, performance summaries, and evidence-based differentiation materials. Monitor competitor claims, product updates, workflows, and supporting technical content to identify potential market risks and opportunities. Partner with cross-functional teams to translate competitive and benchmarking information into positioning, training, and sales enablement materials. Contribute to customer evidence generation, case study development, and scientific storytelling for campaigns and strategic initiatives. Represent Technical Marketing on cross-functional product development, portfolio planning, commercialization, and launch teams as required. Support technical onboarding and training for distributors and channel partners. Maintain global consistency of technical materials while supporting appropriate adaptation for regional markets and customer applications. Provide technical input into product roadmap planning, claims support, customer education strategies, and portfolio initiatives. Perform other duties as assigned. Five or more years of professional experience in technical marketing, applications, technical services, scientific affairs, product management support, or another related scientific or technical function. Experience developing technical or scientific content for internal or external audiences. Experience developing or supporting customer-facing technical documentation, training materials, validation summaries, application materials, or scientific communications. Demonstrated ability to interpret scientific or technical information and translate it into clear, audience-appropriate communication. Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with scientific, technical, commercial, regulatory, quality, or marketing stakeholders. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines. Ability to collaborate effectively with teams located across multiple regions and time zones. Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required. Preferred Qualifications Advanced degree in Microbiology, Food Science, Biotechnology, Chemistry, or a related scientific discipline. Seven or more years of experience in technical marketing, applications, technical services, scientific affairs, product management support, or a related field. Experience within food safety, food microbiology, diagnostics, laboratory testing, or a related industry. Knowledge of food safety testing workflows, microbiological testing, laboratory instrumentation, and customer applications. Experience supporting global product portfolios or working with international teams. Experience supporting new product launches, commercialization initiatives, or product lifecycle management. Ability to communicate complex scientific information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong attention to detail and commitment to scientific accuracy. Ability to evaluate technical data and identify commercially relevant insights.
