Role Overview The Biologics Payer Audit & Accreditation Specialist supports two closely related compliance functions within Biologics by McKesson: PBM/payer audit management and specialty pharmacy accreditation. This role is intentionally designed to be flexible. The successful candidate will bring demonstrated depth in either PBM audit management or specialty pharmacy accreditation, and will develop working proficiency in the second discipline through structured onboarding and mentorship from the respective functional owners. On the audit side, the Specialist supports the intake, tracking, research, and response of PBM audit requests (including desk, field, real-time, and prescription validation reviews), assists in the preparation of audit appeals, and helps identify operational and documentation gaps that create recoupment risk. On the accreditation side, the Specialist supports the maintenance of URAC and ACHC accreditation across Biologics sites, including policy and SOP review, evidence collection and submission, performance measure reporting, RFI response coordination, and survey readiness activities. The position requires working knowledge of specialty pharmacy operations, pharmacy claims adjudication, PBM provider manuals and state pharmacy audit regulations, and/or accreditation standards and evidence requirements. This position requires excellent written and verbal communication, strong documentation discipline, attention to detail, and consistent follow-up. This is a work-from-home position with approximately 15% travel. Key Responsibilities The weighting below reflects the expected steady-state distribution of work. Assignment weighting may flex based on the incumbent's background, business need, and accreditation or audit cycle timing. PBM / Payer Audit Support and Risk Mitigation Supports intake, logging, tracking, and timely response of PBM audit requests across all Biologics sites, ensuring adherence to contractual and regulatory response deadlines. Researches audit findings, gathers supporting documentation, and drafts audit responses and appeals under the direction of the audit function owner. Assists in the analysis of audit findings and discrepancy trends by payer, site, drug, and discrepancy type to identify recurring root causes. Maintains audit trackers, dashboards, and reporting to support visibility for Operations, Quality, Finance, and Legal stakeholders. Supports interpretation and application of state pharmacy audit statutes, PBM provider manual terms, and contractual audit limitations. Partners with Operations to recommend workflow and documentation changes that reduce audit exposure and recoupment risk. Accreditation and Continuous Quality Improvement Supports URAC and ACHC accreditation maintenance, renewal application submission, and ongoing standards compliance across accredited sites. Assists with gap analysis between current-state policies, SOPs, and operational practice versus applicable accreditation standards. Coordinates and uploads accreditation evidence, tracks required performance measure reporting, and supports RFI response development and submission. Supports survey readiness activities, including mock audits, staff readiness materials, documentation review, and follow-up on corrective actions. Assists with maintenance of accreditation documentation repositories, licensure and credentialing records, and version control. Supports continuous quality improvement initiatives, including quality improvement projects, corrective and preventive action (CAPA) tracking, and effectiveness monitoring. Cross-Functional Support, Documentation, and Reporting Serves as a coordination point between Payer Audit, Accreditation, Quality, Operations, and Compliance stakeholders. Prepares summaries, reports, and presentation materials for functional leadership and governance committees. Maintains accurate, traceable, and audit-ready documentation in accordance with internal standards and regulatory requirements. Supports development and delivery of staff-facing education and job aids related to audit readiness and accreditation standards. Minimum Requirement Degree or equivalent and typically requires 4+ years of relevant experience. Education 4-year undergraduate college degree preferred; an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience will be considered. Certified Pharmacy Technician (CPhT) preferred. Critical Skills 4+ years of combined experience in specialty pharmacy, pharmacy operations, PBM, or pharmacy regulatory and payer compliance. AND at least one of the following: 2+ years of PBM audit management and/or PBM auditor experience, including audit response, appeals, and recoupment defense; OR 2+ years of specialty pharmacy accreditation experience (URAC and/or ACHC), including standards interpretation, evidence submission, and survey support. Working knowledge of pharmacy claims adjudication, claim rejections, and associated resolutions. Demonstrated experience maintaining structured documentation, traceability, and corrective action follow-through. Knowledge of pharmacy systems, pharmacy operations, and pharmacy workflow. Specialized Knowledge & Skills Specialty pharmacy experience strongly preferred. Working knowledge of state pharmacy audit statutes and PBM provider manual audit provisions a plus. Experience with accreditation management platforms (e.g., AccrediNet) or document control systems (e.g., MasterControl) a plus. Experience with pharmacy management systems and reporting/analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Excel) a plus. Community oncology, rare disease, or limited distribution drug experience a plus. Ability to effectively manage internal and external stakeholder expectations in terms of service and issue resolution. Ability to develop collaborative internal and external relationships and partnerships. Expected Competencies Detail-oriented with strong documentation and organizational discipline. Able to communicate effectively with pharmacists, pharmacy staff, operations leaders, auditors, and surveyors. Good problem-solving and decision-making skills. Strong interpersonal and written communication skills. Self-motivated and results-oriented; requires limited direction or direct supervision. Effectively manages multiple workstreams with competing deadlines. Team player with the ability to manage timelines and goals. Strong analytical skills. Ability to operate in a fast-paced, dynamic, regulated business environment. Proficient in Microsoft Office; technologically savvy. BUSINESS LICENSE ANALYST Indirect Tax | Position Description POSITION SUMMARY The Business License Analyst supports McKesson’s U.S. business license and related business tax compliance across a complex, multi-entity and multi-jurisdictional environment. A primary purpose of this position is to support practice management licensing and compliance needs, in addition to regular business license responsibilities. The role researches requirements; prepares registrations, renewals, returns, and payments; maintains accurate compliance records; and partners with internal teams and government agencies to resolve issues. The Analyst also supports audits, practice management activities, acquisitions, operational changes, and process improvements. Position Responsibilities • Research and apply state and local statutes, ordinances, regulations, agency guidance, forms, and filing instructions to determine licensing and related business tax requirements. • Prepare and submit accurate and timely license applications, renewals, amendments, closures, business tax returns, supporting schedules, and payments. • Determine filing requirements by analyzing legal entities, business activities, locations, products and services, revenue streams, sourcing, and jurisdictional thresholds. • Maintain the business license compliance system and complete records of account numbers, filing frequencies, due dates, payments, licenses, applications, returns, correspondence, and workpapers. • Monitor deadlines and notices, resolve account issues with licensing and taxing authorities, and promptly escalate potential late filings, penalties, missing information, or compliance exposure. • Coordinate with third-party business license administrators to communicate requirements, provide data and documentation, monitor filing and renewal activities, resolve issues, and confirm timely completion. • Prepare clear, organized, and audit-ready workpapers documenting data sources, calculations, research, conclusions, approvals, filings, and payments. • Partner with Tax, Legal, Finance, Accounting, FP&A, Real Estate, Facilities, Regulatory, IT, and business operations as necessary to obtain information and implement practical compliance solutions. • Support acquisitions, dispositions, reorganizations, new affiliates, facility openings and closures, and operational changes by identifying and coordinating licensing and business tax requirements. • Maintain knowledge of assigned businesses, develop and follow standard operating procedures and controls, and identify opportunities to improve compliance through technology, automation, data analytics, and approved AI tools. • Support practice management by coordinating business license requirements for managed practices, maintaining visibility to practice-specific obligations, and helping implement consistent licensing processes across practice operations. • Participate in special projects and perform other duties as assigned. Knowledge and Skills • Knowledge of U.S. state and local business licensing requirements • Strong research, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to interpret complex requirements and produce supportable conclusions. • Exceptional organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage numerous legal entities, jurisdictions, deadlines, and supporting documents accurately. • Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with government agencies and tax and non-tax stakeholders. • Ability to work independently, prioritize competing demands, meet deadlines, identify risks, and escalate uncertainty appropriately. • Ability to coordinate effectively with third-party business license administrators and support practice management stakeholders, priorities, and compliance needs. • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint. • Ability to use technology, automation, and approved AI tools responsibly, with appropriate review and validation of outputs. • Experience in a multi-entity, multi-state environment is preferred; distribution, healthcare, pharmacy, or similarly regulated industry experience is a plus. Experience and Education • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Legal Studies, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. • Two to four years of relevant experience in tax, business licensing, legal or regulatory compliance, accounting, finance, or a related business environment. • Experience preparing filings, managing recurring deadlines, researching requirements, reconciling data, or maintaining compliance records. Drive the expansion & activation of new channels and implanters in the Cardiovascular and Neurology market. Gain a deep understanding of awareness initiatives and customer programs to ensure alignment of materials, programs, solutions, data, and resources that support strategy and activity. title: Global Finance Planning & Analysis Leader
jd_text: At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration. From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time. The Global Finance Planning & Analysis Leader role will serve as the central point of enterprise financial integration for Lummus, responsible for consolidating performance across all business units into a coherent, decision‑ready view of the company. The position is not purely reporting and analysis, it is designed to create constructive tension across Business Finance, challenge assumptions, and ensure financial outputs reflect the true economic performance of the enterprise. This individual will partner closely with Finance and our Executive Leadership Team to drive rigor, accountability, and performance improvement, while owning the development of clear, high‑quality board‑level reporting that tells a consistent and credible story of Lummus’ trajectory. K ey Responsibilities: Role mandate Act as the single point of accountability for enterprise wide FP&A consolidation across Lummus Translate distributed business finance inputs into a unified, decision grade view of performance Create and sustain productive tension with Business Finance leads to drive accuracy, transparency, and accountability Enterprise consolidation & performance visibility Own the roll up of total Lummus performance, including forecasts, budgets, and long range plans Analyze actuals and leverage them in driving the narrative of forward looking projections Ensure consistency of assumptions, methodologies, and definitions across business units Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and areas where performance narratives do not align with underlying data Constructive challenge & performance pressure Serve as an independent voice that challenges business finance submissions and underlying assumptions Drive alignment between reported performance and operational realities Elevate issues early and ensure they are addressed before reaching executive or board levels Board reporting ownership Own the end to end creation of all board level financial materials Translate complex financial data into clear, concise, and decision oriented narratives Ensure consistency between board materials, monthly business reviews, and internal reporting outputs Planning & forecasting rigor Lead enterprise planning processes with a focus on transparency, comparability, and accountability Drive continuous improvement in forecasting accuracy and insight quality Embed a forward looking, scenario based view of performance Stakeholder partnership Partner with the CFO and senior leadership team to shape the financial narrative and priorities Coordinate closely with Business Finance leaders while maintaining independence of judgment Partner across the Finance Leadership Team Build credibility as a trusted , but challenging , counterpart to the business Key Qualifications & Experience 1 0 + years of progressive experience in finance, with at least 5 years in a senior FP&A leadership role (Senior Director or Director level). Experience in a publicly traded, multinational corporation with complex financial operations and transactions . Proven ability to lead FP&A in a fast-paced, high-growth environment . Strong track record of executive-level business partnership , influencing C-suite decision-making with data-driven insights. Deep expertise in financial modeling, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management frameworks . Experience supporting investor relations, earnings reports, and board-level financial discussions . Strong grasp of US GAAP, IFRS, SEC reporting, and SOX compliance . Proficiency in enterprise financial planning tools (e.g., Hyperion, SAP, Anaplan, Workday Adaptive Planning). Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Preferred Qualifications MBA is a strong plus . Experience working with private equity-backed or high-growth companies is a plus. Prior experience in corporate development, M&A, and capital markets is an advantage. Competencies & Leadership Attributes Strategic thinker with a hands-on approach to execution. Strong business acumen with the ability to connect financial metrics to business strategy. Ability to manage complexity , thrive in ambiguity, and drive clarity in decision-making. High executive presence with the ability to communicate complex financial information to non-financial stakeholders. Passion for team development, mentorship, and fostering a high-performance finance culture . Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus Equity/Stock options (if applicable post potential IPO ) Comprehensive healthcare, retirement, and executive benefits Professional development opportunities Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future. We license process technologies in clean fuels, renewables, petrochemicals, polymers, gas processing and supply lifecycle services, catalysts, proprietary equipment and digitalization to customers worldwide.

title: Senior Marketing Manager, Loyalty Analytics
jd_text: 7-Eleven is an iconic family of brands with over 86,000 locations, surpassing every retailer in the world. We revolutionize convenience, restaurants and fuel through cutting edge innovation — working hard to be the customer's first choice. 7-Eleven empowers our employees to "activate awesome" and make a meaningful impact in their stores and communities every day. If you're ready to grow, lead and make a difference, come join our team and help shape the future of convenience. About this opportunity: 7-Eleven is seeking a strategic, analytical and results-oriented Senior Manager of Loyalty Analytics to lead the analytics function supporting our loyalty programs within the Marketing organization. This leader will manage a team of analysts (in US and India) responsible for translating customer, transaction, campaign and loyalty data into clear insights and actionable recommendations that improve member engagement, campaign effectiveness, personalization and program economics. The successful candidate will combine big-picture strategic thinking with the ability to dive deeply into data, identify the business story behind the analysis, and influence decisions across the organization. The role requires strong executive communication, cross-functional leadership, and the ability to drive clarity and results in a dynamic environment. Key Responsibilities: Lead the development of strategic insights and recommendations that improve loyalty member acquisition, engagement, retention, frequency and incremental sales. Translate complex customer, transaction and campaign data into clear business narratives, opportunities and recommended actions. Identify emerging customer trends, behavioral shifts and program opportunities across 7Rewards and Speedy Rewards. Evaluate customer behavior across loyalty lifecycle stages, segments, categories and programs. Own the loyalty measurement framework, including program KPIs, executive scorecards and recurring performance reporting. Manage the team's data infrastructure, data pipelines, platforms, and ensure consistency, accuracy, and integrity of all data being collected. Establish consistent methodologies for measuring campaign incrementality, customer engagement, offer effectiveness, sales impact, and return on investment. Partner with stakeholders for enterprise-wide critical initiatives to monitor Loyalty program performance and explain variances between actual and planned results. Closely monitor strategic initiatives and communicate outcomes, opportunities and recommend actions to leadership. Lead customer segmentation and behavioral analysis to support more relevant and personalized customer experiences. Partner with CRM and Marketing teams to strengthen audience selection, campaign design, test-and-learn plans and post-campaign measurement. Advance predictive and advanced analytics capabilities that inform customer strategy and marketing decision-making. Build strong relationships across Marketing, CRM, Merchandising, Finance, Digital Product, Operations, Technology, Data Science and other business functions. Lead, coach and develop a team of loyalty analytics professionals. Establish clear priorities, roles, operating rhythms, and standards for analytical quality. Manage multiple initiatives simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail, quality and business impact. Ensure the team balances recurring reporting requirements with strategic, high-value analytical work. Required Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Finance, Marketing, Business, Computer Science or a related field. Master degree is preferred Five or more years of relevant experience in customer analytics, loyalty analytics, marketing analytics, business intelligence, strategy or a related discipline. Demonstrated experience analyzing customer, transaction, campaign or loyalty program data. Strong understanding of customer segmentation, campaign measurement, incrementality, experimentation and return-on-investment analysis. Experience developing executive-level presentations and communicating complex analytical findings to non-technical audiences. Demonstrated ability to build relationships, influence stakeholders and drive action across multiple business functions. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to convert ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches. Experience managing multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with SQL and modern data platforms used for large-scale customer and transaction analytics. Experience with visualization and business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau. Familiarity with Python, R, Databricks, Spark or comparable advanced analytics technologies. Experience building KPI dashboards, customer segmentation frameworks, forecasting models or campaign measurement solutions. Familiarity with retail merchandising, fuel, convenience, consumer packaged goods or franchise business models. Analytical, data-driven, motivated and decisive thought leader with an appropriate perspective on the big picture and attention to detail. Outstanding communication skills with demonstrated ability to develop written materials and present to executive audiences. Comfort operating amid ambiguity in a dynamic environment and managing priorities across multiple teams, initiatives and projects. title: Principal Power Consultant (Technical Advisory/Lender’s Engineering)
jd_text: At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration. From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time. We are seeking a Principal Power Consultant with an engineering and technical background to join our U.S. Power Project Services team. This role focuses on providing technical advisory and due diligence services to investors, lenders, and project developers in support of M&A transactions and project financings across the power sector. This role is ideal for professionals with prior exposure to power asset acquisitions, divestitures, or financing transactions, combined with experience in power generation, EPC execution, plant engineering, operations, asset management, or technical consulting. It is well suited for candidates who can quickly integrate into active assignments, contribute meaningfully with limited ramp-up, and, within a short period, take the lead on less complex engagements. What You Will Do Technical Due Diligence & Advisory Evaluate new build and operating power assets, including technology selection, plant design, EPC and key project contracts, construction schedules, capital cost estimates, operations and maintenance strategies, cost structures, equipment condition, and plant performance. Perform reviews of technical reports, engineering documentation, and project contracts, rapidly synthesizing complex information into clear, defensible, and decision-relevant conclusions for independent engineer reports. Identify key technical risks, assess their potential impact on project value, and evaluate mitigation strategies. Prepare technical due diligence reports, independent engineer reports, and lender advisory deliverables. Project Execution & Leadership Contribute immediately to live due diligence assignments and progressively take ownership of discrete workstreams or smaller engagements within the first several months. Lead or support technical due diligence scopes under tight transaction timelines. Coordinate inputs from multidisciplinary teams and synthesize findings into clear, concise client deliverables. Conduct site visits, lead technical discussions, and interview plant personnel and project stakeholders. Manage multiple concurrent assignments while maintaining high standards of quality and responsiveness. Client Interaction Present technical findings and recommendations to investors, lenders, and developers. Translate complex technical issues into clear, structured insights that support decision-making. Build credibility as a trusted advisor through both technical depth and clarity of communication. Business Development Support proposal preparation and contribute to the positioning of new opportunities. Provide technical input into marketing efforts and client engagement activities. Contribute industry knowledge and market insights to business development efforts. What We Are Looking For Core Experience Experience in power generation or energy infrastructure, with backgrounds such as EPC execution or construction management, plant engineering or operations and maintenance, OEM or technology providers, or technical advisory/lender’s engineering. Exposure to multiple phases of the project lifecycle, including design, construction, commissioning, and operations. Technical Capabilities Strong understanding of conventional power generation systems, including gas turbines, boilers, steam turbines, generators, and balance of plant equipment. Familiarity with renewable technologies such as solar PV and/or wind, battery energy storage systems (BESS), hydrogen-fired generation, or carbon capture is beneficial. Ability to assess equipment condition and operational performance, O&M practices and long-term cost structures, and capital expenditure requirements for asset reliability. Experience reviewing EPC contracts, O&M agreements, and long-term service agreements. Analytical & Consulting Skillset Strong technical writing skills, with demonstrated experience preparing clear, concise, and defensible technical due diligence reports, independent engineer reports, lender advisory reports, feasibility studies, or other client-facing technical deliverables. Demonstrated ability to review and synthesize large volumes of technical, engineering, and contractual documentation into clear written conclusions for client-facing deliverables. Ability to quickly identify material issues and key value drivers based on incomplete or evolving information. Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, transaction-driven environment with minimal onboarding. Interpersonal & Leadership Attributes Strong interpersonal skills and ability to engage effectively with clients, developers, and multidisciplinary teams across geographies. Demonstrated ability to take ownership of workstreams and contribute to team delivery with increasing autonomy. Comfortable working in environments where priorities shift quickly and deliverables are time-critical. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Engineering required; advanced degree or MBA is a plus. Typically 7+ years of professional experience, including a minimum of five (5) years within the power generation or energy infrastructure sector. Prior consulting or transaction advisory experience is advantageous but not required. Relevant experience may include construction management and commissioning with an EPC contractor; operations and maintenance, reliability, or asset management of power generation facilities; or engineering roles with direct exposure to project delivery, equipment evaluation, or plant performance. Location & Travel Based in Houston, TX; remote work may be considered. Travel is an integral part of the role, typically 10–30%, including occasional international assignments. Site visits are generally short duration, usually 1–5 days. title: Lead Data Scientist

jd_text: We're seeking someone to join our team as a Program Manager to serve as the operational leader and chief integrator for major workplace and real estate transformation programs, ensuring complex initiatives are governed effectively, delivered efficiently, and aligned with executive priorities. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including IT, engineering, product management, and business stakeholders, to gather integration requirements, define project scope, and prioritize initiatives. Develop and maintain a comprehensive integration roadmap, outlining key milestones, timelines, and resource requirements for integration projects. Oversee the selection and implementation of integration tools, platforms, and technologies, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and industry best practices. Manage all aspects of integration project delivery, including project planning, resource allocation, risk management, and stakeholder communication. Monitor and track integration project performance, identifying risks, issues, and dependencies, and taking proactive measures to mitigate potential impacts. Establish and maintain strong relationships with technology vendors, partners, and external stakeholders to support integration efforts and drive innovation. Provide regular updates and reports to senior management on integration projects, including progress against milestones, budget, and resource utilization. Stay current on emerging trends and technologies in integration and recommend opportunities for continuous improvement and optimization. Determine appropriate staffing and resources to achieve goals and objectives. Define annual Key Performance Indicators aligned with corporate goals. Direct and mentor leaders on performance, career development, onboarding, succession planning, employee relations, and other people-management responsibilities. Own employee satisfaction and retention and support initiatives that strengthen team performance. Direct and influence change management initiatives to drive improvements and efficiencies cross-functionally. Prepare and manage budget as assigned; analyze variances and initiate corrective actions to maximize operational performance. May lead projects and perform other duties as assigned. We are excited to speak to someone with... Bachelor's Degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field; Master's degree preferred. Eight (8) plus years experience in software integration, with a proven track record of managing and delivering complex integration initiatives. Three (3) plus years leadership responsibility with strong team management skills and the ability to motivate and develop others. Deep understanding of integration technologies, protocols, and standards, including APIs, ETL, messaging queues, and middleware. jd_text: Job Description For over 130 years, we have pioneered groundbreaking science. Today, we are driven by continuous innovation to develop breakthrough medicines, vaccines and technology. Our singular focus is to empower those who care for animals, helping them manage their vital responsibility with confidence. Because when it comes to animal health, no one sees it like we do. POSITION SUMMARY AND SCOPE The Level O1 Machine Operator is the foundation of the production line. This position operates a laser, laser/ink-jet, or E.I.D. marking station to mark, label, and package Livestock Identification tags in strict accordance with SOPs, work instructions, and customer requirements. Success in this position is measured by safe behavior, right-first-time quality, accurate real-time documentation, and consistent attainment of the required daily output for the assigned machine. The O1 Operator is expected to know the standard, run to the standard, and stop and escalate immediately when anything deviates from it. This role is the entry point into a defined operator progression (O1 → O2 → O3 Production Line Lead), and demonstrated mastery of O1 duties is the prerequisite for advancement. RESPONSIBILITIES Production Execution Operates a laser, laser/ink-jet, or EID (Electronic Identification Device) marking station to mark Livestock Identification tags per SOP, and performs labeling and packaging of finished product to specification. Maintains the required and acceptable daily output as determined by the assigned job and machine, and communicates immediately to the Line Lead when the target is at risk. Verifies materials, work orders, and packaging components against the production order before running, and confirms all packaging is available and correct. When the workstation is shut down, takes prompt action to secure help in correcting the malfunction and returning the workstation to production in the shortest time possible. Performs basic troubleshooting, setup verification, and cleaning activities within current training and qualifications; never operates outside of qualified tasks. Quality and Traceability Conducts required quality checks at the defined frequency and stops production immediately when nonconforming product is identified. Verifies print and marking quality, EID programming, label accuracy, and customer requirements on every order. Watches for wrong materials, incorrect EID programming, traceability discrepancies, product mix-ups, equipment abnormalities, missing documentation, and safety concerns — and stops production and notifies the Line Lead, Supervisor, Technician, or Quality Technician the moment these conditions are observed. Maintains traceability records and ensures suspect product is never allowed to continue down the line while an issue is unresolved. Documentation Completes all production documentation accurately and in real time, including startup sheets, downtime logs, production records, scrap documentation, and quality records. Records downtime accurately with the correct reason so losses can be analyzed and eliminated. Teamwork, Safety, and Housekeeping Performs all assigned tasks in accordance with safety procedures and work instructions; wears all required PPE, including safety glasses, steel-toe safety footwear, gloves, and other PPE required for the assigned area. Maintains safe work practices and immediately reports unsafe behaviors and conditions; stops the job for any unsafe condition, without exception. Assists with onboarding and cross-training of employees using approved training methods and SOPs when qualified to do so. Maintains housekeeping in the assigned area and participates in 5S, Lean Manufacturing, and continuous improvement initiatives. Follows established conduct, procedures, and safety rules for the area. Performs other duties as assigned. EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS High School Diploma or equivalent required. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE Experience operating a computer, including operating a mouse, retrieving a file, and the demonstrated ability to learn new basic computer skills. Ability to accurately enter and retrieve production information using manufacturing systems, production databases, and electronic documentation systems; ability to learn and utilize SAP, MES, Galaxy, or other production-related software systems as required. Proficiency in basic math skills — counting, handling numbers, addition, and subtraction — sufficient to perform production calculations, quantity verification, traceability reconciliation, and inventory counts. Good manual dexterity; ability to safely handle production materials, packaging components, livestock identification tags, trays, pallets, and related equipment. Ability to read, comprehend, and follow SOPs, Work Instructions, Job Sheets, Production Orders, Quality and Traceability Records, and Customer Requirements. Ability to identify, communicate, and escalate safety, quality, equipment, and traceability issues in a timely manner. SKILLS Attention to detail and a quality-focused mindset. Strong safety awareness. Basic troubleshooting skills. Effective communication skills. Ability to maintain accurate, real-time production documentation. Reliability, punctuality, and ownership of the assigned workstation. Willingness to learn, cross-train, and support continuous improvement initiatives. PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS AND SAFETY Ability to perform physical tasks, including lifting, carrying, pushing, and pulling materials weighing up to 30 pounds throughout the shift. Ability to stand for extended periods and perform repetitive tasks with sustained attention to detail. Responsible for wearing and maintaining required PPE, including safety glasses and steel-toe safety footwear, and complying with all site safety requirements while performing assigned duties. #MSJR The salary range for this role is: $39,200 - $61,800 This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. jd_text: We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 31 Oct 2026 Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. A Day in the Life The Global Cyber & Information Security Office protects the systems, data, products, and digital capabilities that support Medtronic’s mission. Within this organization, the Identity & Access Management (IAM) function is responsible for the strategy, governance, architecture, and delivery of enterprise identity services that enable secure access for employees, contractors, partners, applications, devices, and other digital identities across a complex global environment. The Director of Identity and Access Management (IAM) position is designated as remote within the United States. Team members located in Minnesota are expected to follow the organization's hybrid work model, which includes an on-site presence four days per week and one remote workday per week. The Director of Identity and Access Management (IAM) role provides strategic and operational leadership for Medtronic’s enterprise Identity & Access Management program. The Director will establish and execute the IAM strategy, oversee identity governance and privileged access capabilities, modernize identity services, and partner across the enterprise to reduce risk while enabling secure business operations and digital transformation. Primary Responsibilities Define and execute the enterprise Identity and Access Management strategy, roadmap, and operating model aligned with cybersecurity, technology, and business priorities. Lead the end-to-end IAM portfolio, including workforce identity, identity governance and administration, privileged access management, authentication, authorization, and identity lifecycle services. Establish and maintain IAM architecture standards, policies, controls, and governance processes across global business and technology environments. Drive modernization of identity services through capabilities such as single sign-on, multifactor authentication, conditional access, role-based access controls, and least-privilege access models. Partner with technology, business, compliance, audit, privacy, and security stakeholders to integrate identity controls into enterprise processes and platforms. Oversee identity-related risk management, control remediation, audit responses, and incident response activities involving access misuse, credential compromise, or unauthorized access. Develop service management, vendor management, financial planning, performance metrics, and continuous improvement practices for IAM products and services. Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team while establishing clear accountability, delivery expectations, and operational excellence standards. Required Qualifications 10+ years of experience with a bachelor’s degree or 8+ years of experience with an advanced degree 7+ years of managerial experience Leadership experience in Identity and Access Management, cybersecurity, infrastructure security, or a closely related discipline within a large, complex organization. Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-scale Identity and Access Management transformation initiatives across multiple business units, regions, and technology environments. Experience developing and implementing Identity and Access Management strategies, governance frameworks, and operating models that support business objectives and risk management requirements. Strong expertise in identity governance, authentication, authorization, privileged access management, access certification, identity lifecycle management, and least-privilege principles. Experience communicating technical risk, investment priorities, and program outcomes to executive leadership and key stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field. Professional certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC), Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), or comparable identity and cloud security certifications. Experience with enterprise Identity and Access Management platforms, Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM), and Cloud Infrastructure Entitlement Management (CIEM) solutions. Experience implementing phishing-resistant authentication, conditional access, zero-trust access models, device trust, and modern authorization frameworks. Experience supporting regulated industries with complex compliance, privacy, security, and audit requirements, including healthcare, medical technology, or similarly regulated environments. This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI-enabled, specialty-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care. A Culture of Excellence When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500+ passionate problem-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes: Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work 2025 Globee Business Awards: Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year” 2025 Black Book Awards: Ranked #1 EHR in 11 Specialties Florida Venture Forum: Venture-Backed Company of the Year We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started. Ready to modernize medicine with us? Job Description Summary: The Manager, CS Reporting and Analytics leads a team responsible for delivering reporting, dashboards, and analytics that provide visibility into Customer Success performance . This role oversees the development and maintenance of operational metrics, reporting frameworks, and analytical insights that support decision-making across the Customer Success organization . The Manager partners with CS leadership to ensure reporting solutions align with business needs and support operational efficiency and performance improvement . Role & Responsibilities Oversee analysts who design, develop, and deliver operational reporting, dashboards, and analytics that support Customer Success leadership. Ensure operational metrics and reporting frameworks provide visibility into CS performance . Oversee development of dashboards and reports using systems such as Salesforce, BI tools, and operational data platforms . Ensure timely delivery of recurring KPI reporting and analytical insights . Validate reporting accuracy and data integrity . Manage and develop a team of Business Operations Analysts responsible for CS reporting and analytics . Provide guidance and prioritization for analytics projects and reporting initiatives . Coach analysts on analytical techniques, reporting best practices, and stakeholder engagement . Support professional development and performance management of analysts . Ensure team workload is aligned to organizational priorities . Partner with Customer Success leadership and operational teams to translate business needs into reporting and analytics solutions . Work with CS Operations, Professional Services, Account Management, and Support leadership to define reporting needs . Translate operational questions into analytical requirements . Ensure reporting solutions support operational decision-making and performance management . Improve reporting processes, operational metrics, and analytics capabilities . Identify opportunities to improve reporting automation and reporting workflows . Standardize KPI definitions and reporting methodologies . Ensure reporting processes support operational scaling . Communicate reporting results and operational insights to leadership . Present reporting outputs and trends to CS leadership . Provide insights and recommendations based on operational data . Ensure leaders understand the meaning and implications of performance metrics . Skills & Requirements Bachelor's degree (Management Information Systems, Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Statistics) . A Master's is a plus, but not required . 2+ years of experience leading an R&A team supporting implementation, CS, or similar teams required. 5+ years of experience in analytics, reporting, or operations analysis. Advanced skills in Salesforce, Microsoft Excel, or Google Sheets (Logical formulas, Lookups, Pivot Tables) . Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Domo, and Databricks. Experience working in SaaS or technology organizations . Experience supporting Customer Success or services organizations . title: Project Manager
jd_text: Job Description At DPR, roles and responsibilities are more than describing a job title—they are a commitment to building great things together. The job description(s) below defines core responsibilities and the scope of the role and is a starting point. Every employee is expected to lead from where they are, take ownership of outcomes, and always act in the best interest of the team, customer, project and organization. As a purpose-driven organization on a journey to be most admired, we rely on trust, shared leadership, open communication, disciplined action and a deep respect for the individual to drive exceptional performance. Success is not just about what we build, but who we build and how we build it: with integrity, enjoyment, uniqueness and an ever-forward mindset. Job Summary: Manages construction project individuals to deliver high-quality results and foster professional growth. Provides full project leadership with accountability for end-to-end project delivery, representing the project team and resolving complex execution, stakeholder, and risk-related issues. Oversees the successful delivery of construction project(s) by providing advanced knowledge of construction activities, methodologies, and industry standards. Manages and develops the full project team, including project engineers and assistant project managers, through coaching, feedback, and performance oversight. Manages and coordinates multidisciplinary project teams, contractors, and stakeholders to ensure project requirements, timelines, and quality standards are consistently met. Ensures efficient project execution by monitoring team progress, analyzing project performance, identifying and resolving both routine and complex issues, owning project financials, contract administration, risk management, and complex stakeholder negotiations to achieve financial targets and mitigate risk. Key Responsibilities: Leads, manages, and develops a team of construction project individuals by establishing expectations, supporting individualized development plans, facilitating training opportunities, and reinforcing continuous skill growth to achieve exceptional performance and encourage talent development. Oversees end-to-end project execution by collaborating with project teams, monitoring progress, and addressing escalated, complex issues to ensure timely completion, while maintaining consistent field presence, leading participation in safety meetings including stretch and flex, and demonstrating fluency in high-risk activities to actively drive safe, planned, and controlled project outcomes. Oversees and approves procurement of project-related materials, equipment, and specialty trade subcontractors as needed, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with SPW work sequences and field requirements. Communicates project status, risks, and changes to stakeholders, leveraging advanced knowledge and experience in project management. Evaluates project performance, identifies areas for improvement, and implements corrective actions. Reviews comprehensive project documentation for compliance, reporting, and future reference. Partners with the Superintendent to lead implementation of project-specific quality and safety programs, ensuring teams and trade partners uphold DPR’s safety standards and proactively identify and address potential risks to maintain an incident-free work environment. Education Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in construction management, engineering, architecture, a related field, or equivalent experience required. Work Experience: 7 years of experience in construction engineering, project engineering, or a related field required. 1 - 2 years of experience in a managerial capacity preferred. Certifications and Licenses: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) 30-Hour Construction certification preferred. OSHA 30 program completion within 6 months of hire is required. DPR Construction is a forward-thinking, self-performing general contractor specializing in technically complex and sustainable projects for the advanced technology, life sciences, healthcare, higher education and commercial markets. Founded in 1990, DPR is a great story of entrepreneurial success as a private, employee-owned company that has grown into a multi-billion-dollar family of companies with offices around the world. Working at DPR, you'll have the chance to try new things, explore paths and shape your future. Here, we build opportunity together—by harnessing our talents, enabling curiosity and pursuing our collective ambition to make the best ideas happen. We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work by our talented teammates and leading news organizations like U.S. News and World Report, Forbes, Fast Company and Newsweek. Explore our open opportunities at www.dpr.com/careers .

title: Data Analyst
jd_text: We Could Use Someone Like You in Our Crew. Job Title: Data Analyst Overview: We are seeking a dedicated Data Analyst focused on the reporting and analytics side of operations. In this role, data tells a story—we are looking for someone who doesn't just deliver numbers, but uncovers deep daily insights and provides actionable suggestions to drive informed decision-making. You will drill into core issues, help with forecasting, and deliver timely analysis to ensure critical operational opportunities and risks are never overlooked. What You’ll Do Daily Reporting & Analysis: Produce daily reports, dashboards, and ongoing insights that go beyond baseline figures to highlight trends, risks, and opportunities. KPI & SLA Monitoring: Maintain vigilant KPI and SLA watching to safeguard productivity, accuracy, and operational consistency. Forecasting & Capacity Planning: Build robust forecasting models and capacity insights to support strategic staffing and operational planning. Staffing Heat Maps & WFM Integration: Develop staffing heat maps and leverage workforce management (WFM) principles to optimize coverage and resource allocation. Root Cause Analysis & Process Improvement: Apply a proactive mindset to investigate root causes behind operational inefficiencies and recommend actionable solutions. What We’re Looking For Advanced Google Sheets Expertise: Highly proficient with Pivot Tables, Lookups, and complex data manipulation formulas. BI & Reporting Tools: Hands-on experience with Zendesk Explore (Tableau experience is a plus). Workforce Management (WFM): Direct experience with WFM concepts, staffing heat maps, and scheduling analytics. Communication: Proven ability to clearly translate and communicate complex data concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Data Integrity & Discipline: Strong command of KPI monitoring with the discipline to maintain accuracy, consistency, and clarity across all reports. Schedule & Availability Working Days: Monday through Friday. Core Hours: Flexible start time, with a mandatory requirement to work until 2:00 PM PST (e.g., 5:00 AM – 2:00 PM PST). Commitment: Starting at 40 hours per week, with potential for increased hours based on operational needs. You will become the product expert, informing customers of specifications, features, promotions, and financing options to close a sale. Your exceptional consulting services help ensure that customer needs are met before leaving the store. If in the Pro Department, focus on external accounts and outside sales and services Monitor inventory levels to support sales, working with vendors and other stores to find merchandise and order replacement stock Perform price reviews by pricing policies and ensure maintenance of pricing and documentation Support all checkout functions, call buttons, departmental pages, or requests for assistance Train associates in the department by conducting on-the-job training on the Sales floor and coaching around development needs Complete other duties as assigned Minimum Qualifications High School Diploma or GED 1 year experience in customer-facing sales or 6 months of Lowe’s retail experience (Or 3 years of external experience in customer-facing sales or 18 months of Lowe’s retail experience if education requirement is not met) 1 year of experience in sales or customer service in a sales environment with required sales goals or metrics Able to Read, write, and perform basic arithmetic (addition and subtraction) Able to stand and sit for prolonged periods Minimally lift 25lbs unassisted or over 25lbs with or without an accommodation Obtain sales-related licensure or registration if required by law in your state (Lowe's will support and fund this requirement) Preferred Qualifications 1 year of experience in completing customer sales orders 1 Year Experience promoting product related services and plans such as installation, delivery, credit financing, or extended protection plan 2 years of experience designing customized products for customers using 20/20 or Computer-Aided Design System Professional certification related to the department being considered Bi-lingual skills Lowe's commitment to growth and teamwork extends to the community as well. title: Special Events LN Venues, Logistics Manager - Toyota Music Factory
jd_text: Job Summary: WHO ARE WE? Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com . WHO ARE YOU? Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! THE ROLE The Special Events Logistics Manager provides administrative support to the Sales Department, including Senior Sales Manager, Sales Managers and Logistics team; performs special projects as delegated by the Director of Sales. The Logistics Manager is responsible for execution, servicing and detailing of assigned events once booked by the Special Events Department. They are to ensure a smooth and efficient process of an event from the SEO to the actual operation of the function. This position works closely with the Special Events Team in contract negotiations and servicing groups while being a liaison between Special Events and Operations team. WHAT THIS PERSON WILL DO I. Essential Functions Responsible for execution, servicing and detailing of assigned events once booked by the Special Events Department Provides administrative support and assistance to the Special Events Sales Team Distribution of all internal and external correspondence Maintains all departmental files Assists department team members with Information Systems support Distribution of all internal and external correspondence Maintains departmental files. Assists all department team members with Information Systems support. Coordinate all aspects of operational set-up and break down of events (equipment needs, rental needs, and station set-up) Coordinates with Production department on all production aspects needed for an event Liaison between client and LN Team Members throughout Event. Must maintain a neat, clean and well-groomed appearance (specific venue standard) Conduct Event Pre-Shift with Operations Managers and communicate event specifics at Team Member Pre-Shift Assures seamless transition for Client from Sales Department to Operations Manager during Event Handle all aspects of the Special Event once the special event order (SEO) has been distributed Client interaction; conducts site inspections and walk through with clients as requested by SM/DOS Assist Sales Manager(s) as requested with special needs by the client Participate in meetings such as the SEO Meeting and Production Meeting Due to the nature of the hospitality industry; you may be required to work varying schedules to reflect the business needs of the venue Maintain files in proper order after the (SEO) has been distributed II. Accounting Functions Process all deposits and payments in a timely manner Track status of payments made for all events with Sales Mangers Follow up on all accounts receivable and provide monthly update to Director of Sales and Business Manager Verify Deposit / Payments tracking schedules with Sales Manager Proper execution and completion of all post event paperwork: Party Recap Sheet, Captain’s Report and Receipts Responsible for proper settlement or payment on night of event with client and entering billing information into POS to generate a final guest check Manage staff hours to ensure we are not exceeding our budget Follow up on all accounts receivable and provide monthly update to Director of Sales and Business Manager III. Staff Functions Maintain supply of digital and print sales kits and collateral materials Update sales kit inserts and menus as needed. Collect and update digital content for event marketing Generate a competitive analysis report on a quarterly basis Special projects as assigned by Director of Sales Distribution of final contracted SEO’s to appropriate parties Train all staff with regards to the proper techniques and etiquette for service Produce weekly banquet summary for all events – includes number of team members and their time to scheduled and verify staffing was handled by Operations Manager WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) Minimum one year in a customer service capacity Working knowledge of computers (Excel, Word, databases) Basic Mathematical skills Entry-level knowledge of restaurant and music hall operations, food preparation and restaurant reservation procedures. Written and verbal communication skills; time management skills. Ability to prioritize and organize and work in a fast-paced, high volume environment. BENEFITS & PERKS Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits: HEALTH : Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA) YOURSELF : Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days WEALTH : 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program FAMILY : New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support CAREER : Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment OTHERS : Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. title: Project Manager II
jd_text: Nelnet Business Services (NBS), a division of Nelnet, Inc., provides payment technology and education services to more than 1,200 higher education institutions, nearly 12,000 K-12 schools, and millions of individual students, families, and supporters across the globe. Our culture of service enables us to form long-lasting and trusted partnerships, while our focus on creativity and innovative solutions empowers our customer communities to thrive. The Project Manager plans, coordinates, and delivers projects that support business objectives. This role establishes project scope, schedules, deliverables, resource needs, and governance while maintaining visibility to progress, risks, issues, and decisions. The position partners with project sponsors, functional teams, and other stakeholders to align expectations, remove barriers, and support timely, high-quality outcomes. The Project Manager applies consistent project management practices and adapts the approach to the size, complexity, and needs of each initiative. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: · Manage projects through the full project lifecycle, including initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, delivery, and closeout. · Develop and maintain project plans that define scope, objectives, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, resources, and timelines. · Coordinate cross-functional project teams and clarify roles, responsibilities, priorities, and expectations. · Monitor project performance and communicate progress, risks, issues, decisions, and changes to sponsors and stakeholders. · Identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, and dependencies, escalating items that require leadership action. · Facilitate project meetings, decision-making, and follow-up by preparing agendas, documenting outcomes, and tracking commitments. · Manage changes to project scope, schedule, resources, and deliverables through established governance and approval processes. · Coordinate project budgets, resource needs, vendor activities, and related administrative requirements, as applicable. · Maintain accurate project documentation and reporting to support transparency, accountability, and informed decisions. · Promote continuous improvement by applying lessons learned, effective practices, and appropriate project management tools and methods. CRM implementation and go forward strategy post-launch Annual compensation range for this role is $85,000-$110,000 depending on experience. This position offers a hybrid work option. Nelnet values flexibility and understands the importance of work-life integration. Our hybrid work environment allows associates living within 30 miles of an office location to work remotely for part of the week, while also fostering collaboration and team connection through in-office presence three days per week. Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. To be considered, candidates must already be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship. Preferred: · Project management certification such as PMP or CAPM. Preferred: · Experience using project management tools and established project management methods. · Experience coordinating budgets, resources, vendors, or change activities. title: Scientific Services Veterinarian- Dallas Territory
jd_text: Job Description: Title : Scientific Services Veterinarian Location: Dallas, TX Workstyle : Remote Must be willing and able to travel to fulfill the roles and responsibilities of the position. Territory coverage may be adapted for business needs after hire. May be required to travel overnight 3+ nights each week. Ability to travel (50-75% including nights and weekends) and able to work from home effectively when not traveling. Mars does not sponsor visas for this role. This position is not eligible for relocation benefits The ROYAL CANIN Scientific Services Veterinarian (SSV) plays a pivotal role in elevating Royal Canin’s brand presence by strategically influencing diet recommendations through expert training, education, partnership, and ongoing support. SSVs collaborate closely with internal Royal Canin stakeholders to drive key activities and initiatives that contribute to achieving annual objectives for the Therapeutic Business Unit. Externally, SSVs engage with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and veterinary professionals to enhance Royal Canin’s reputation within the broader veterinary community, leveraging these relationships to increase brand recommendations and expand the path of influence. As an essential member of a collaborative, team-based approach, the SSV is instrumental in growing Royal Canin’s market share within veterinary hospitals and strengthening brand awareness across the industry. The SSV role requires a high degree of flexibility and a strong commitment to travel to successfully fulfill all responsibilities. Territory coverage may be adjusted post-hire to align with evolving business needs. Candidates must be prepared to travel extensively—up to 50–75% of the time—including overnight stays of three or more nights per week, with occasional travel during nights and weekends. When not traveling, the ability to work productively and independently from a home office is essential. What are we looking for? Doctorate in Veterinary Medicine (or VMD) with an active license in at least one state. Minimum of 3 years’ experience as a veterinary practitioner, including internships, co-ops, and/or residency, with a preference for small or companion animal practice. Exceptional scientific communication and presentation skills, capable of engaging diverse audiences effectively. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, PowerPoint, Teams, and OneNote. Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision. Willingness and ability to travel extensively—up to 75% within the assigned territory—with eligibility for a company vehicle; travel may include airline, train, or other modes of transportation. Flexibility to travel during nights and weekends, with the capability to independently manage travel arrangements. What will be your responsibilities? Collaborate with Field Sales Teams: Partner closely with field sales teams within the assigned geography to educate key recommenders, driving increased recommendations, market share, and sales growth across the region. Drive Nutrition Category Growth: Cultivate and leverage relationships with specialty referral hospitals to expand nutrition category sales within surrounding general practices. Support Strategic Accounts: Strengthen strategic accounts by building relationships with regional medical leadership and participating in high-impact events that advance the Royal Canin veterinary diet business. Develop KOL Networks: Establish and nurture a network of Key Opinion Leader (KOL) Royal Canin advocates and potential speakers within the territory, supporting veterinary operations, marketing, corporate communications, and scientific communications initiatives. Deliver Best-in-Class Training: Provide exceptional Royal Canin nutrition education to veterinarians, technicians, and hospital staff, ensuring the highest standards of knowledge and education are delivered. Foster Business Growth: Contribute to the overall growth of the veterinary business unit through effective collaboration and joint business planning with regional and strategic account sales teams. Offer Technical Expertise: Serve as a trusted technical resource, delivering expert support and guidance as needed. Represent Royal Canin: Act as a Royal Canin spokesperson at key veterinary conferences and events, enhancing brand presence and business outcomes. Provide Nutritional Consultations: Offer expert nutritional case consultations to support veterinary partners and clients. Manage Territory Coverage: Adapt to territory and regional coverage requirements as needed; anticipate travel 3–4 days per week, with one day allocated for remote home office work. Support Field-Based Teams: Provide comprehensive support to field-based teams, requiring both local and air travel as part of the role. Fulfill Additional Duties: Perform other responsibilities as assigned to support business objectives. What can you expect from Mars? Work with over 130,000 diverse and talented Associates, all guided by The Five Principles. Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today. Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University. An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, if eligible, including variable pay & general allowances (depending on the position and employee’s work schedule). Subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable policies and plans then in effect, and depending on the position offered and the employee’s work schedule (i.e., part-time schedule), eligible employees are automatically enrolled in a 401(k) plan, as well as participate in Company-sponsored medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance plans for the employee and the employee’s eligible dependents, and may be eligible to take up to 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Healthcare sales experience supporting: Long-Term Care (LTC) Skilled Nursing Facilities (SNF) Home Health Hospice Durable Medical Equipment (DME) Wound Care Rehabilitation or Extended Care providers Healthcare distribution sales experience. title: Data Product Owner
jd_text: Marathon Health is a leading advanced primary care provider, partnering with employer and union plan sponsors to improve health for millions of Americans. With nationwide onsite, nearsite, and network health centers, and virtual primary care, Marathon delivers a value-based model that enhances the healthcare experience for members and providers, while driving meaningful cost savings for plan sponsors. Marathon is proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work®, reflecting the company's commitment to building an inclusive, high-trust culture where all employees can thrive. Learn more at marathon.health ABOUT THE JOB The Data Product Owner leads several cross-functional scrum teams responsible for delivering outcome-based data solutions to the business. This role is defined by the problems it solves , not the technology it uses. Whether the right answer is a Tableau dashboard, a Snowflake Cortex agent, a Python-based insight package delivered as a Streamlit portal, or a reusable component of our semantic model, the Data Product Owner is accountable for choosing the approach that best achieves the desired outcome and for guiding their teams to build it. Our stakeholders are primarily internal, though some solutions serve external audiences, and their needs evolve quickly. This person must be comfortable operating in an environment where both Technology and Product direction change, treating that change as a normal condition rather than a disruption. A major part of the mandate is enablement: building the foundational pieces — starting with a well-structured semantic model — that let stakeholders and teams across the organization build their own solutions, inside and outside of Technology. The ideal candidate is fluent in leveraging AI to accelerate how these solutions get designed, built, and maintained. ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES Own the product vision, roadmap, and prioritized backlog for a portfolio of outcome-based data solutions serving internal and external stakeholders. Lead multiple scrum teams day to day — including backlog grooming, sprint planning, prioritization, and removing blockers — while keeping teams focused on measurable outcomes over outputs. Take direction from the Director of Business Intelligence on analytics and reporting outcomes, and from the Technical Product Manager on technical and product execution, reconciling their input into a single prioritized backlog. Proactively surface conflicts in priority or direction early, and drive them to resolution rather than letting teams stall. Translate stakeholder goals into clearly defined problems, success metrics, and acceptance criteria, and validate that delivered solutions actually move those metrics. Select the right delivery approach for each problem (e.g., Tableau, Snowflake / Cortex agents, Python / Streamlit portals) based on the outcome and the audience, rather than defaulting to a preferred technology or pattern. Leverage AI and modern tooling to accelerate discovery, prototyping, development, and iteration across the teams. Build and steward foundational, reusable components — especially the semantic model — so that stakeholders and other teams can reliably build their own solutions against a trusted, governed layer. Establish and support self-service enablement, including documentation, patterns, and guardrails, so users can create their own solutions with confidence. Partner closely with Product leaders and internal stakeholders who depend on these solutions, keeping all parties aligned on priorities, tradeoffs, and delivery status. Anticipate and absorb change from both Technology and Product, adjusting priorities and communicating impacts without losing delivery momentum. Ensure solutions meet quality, security, and compliance expectations appropriate to internal and external use. Track adoption, usage, and business impact, and use those insights to continuously refine the portfolio. Define success metrics and business outcomes for all major initiatives and hold teams accountable for measuring realized value after delivery. Ensure solutions follow established release, change management, and production readiness processes. QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus a minimum of 7 years proven experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or similar role delivering data, analytics, or BI products, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Demonstrated success leading Agile / Scrum teams, ideally more than one team concurrently. Strong background in data and analytics, with the ability to reason about data products end to end (source to consumption). Experience in healthcare, population health, benefits administration, or related regulated industries preferred. Experience working with data governance, data quality, and master data initiatives preferred. DESIRED ATTRIBUTES Hands-on familiarity with Snowflake, including Cortex agents, Cortex Analyst / search services, and semantic views. Experience with modern analytics and delivery tools such as Tableau, Python, and Streamlit (or comparable frameworks for building lightweight portals and insight packages). Practical fluency in leveraging AI / LLMs to build, accelerate, or augment data solutions. Strong grasp of semantic modeling and the value of a reusable, governed foundation that enables self-service. An outcome-first, technology-agnostic mindset: chooses the right tool for the job and lets go of tools that no longer fit. Highly adaptable and calm amid shifting Technology and Product priorities. Diplomatic and decisive: builds trust with multiple stakeholders and makes clear prioritization calls when direction conflicts. A builder-and-enabler orientation: as motivated by helping others create solutions as by delivering their own. Curiosity and a habit of continuous learning as the tooling landscape evolves. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, comfortable working with both Product leadership and non-technical business users. Experience managing product backlogs in Azure DevOps or similar tools. Awareness of data governance, security, and privacy considerations (experience handling sensitive or regulated data such as PHI is a plus). Comfort selecting and working across a range of delivery technologies rather than specializing in a single one. Experience operating in an environment of frequent change and ambiguity. Track record of translating business needs into prioritized, outcome-driven work and measuring results. Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a matrixed structure, taking direction from multiple leaders while managing competing priorities. Pay Range: $110,000 - $140,000/yr The actual offer may vary dependent upon geographic location and the candidate’s years of experience and/or skill level. We are accepting applications for this position until a candidate has been selected. To apply to this position and learn more about open jobs at Marathon Health, visit our careers page.
