title: Sr Project Manager
jd_text: Job Description At DPR, roles and responsibilities are more than describing a job title—they are a commitment to building great things together. The job description(s) below defines core responsibilities and the scope of the role and is a starting point. Every employee is expected to lead from where they are, take ownership of outcomes, and always act in the best interest of the team, customer, project and organization. As a purpose-driven organization on a journey to be most admired, we rely on trust, shared leadership, open communication, disciplined action and a deep respect for the individual to drive exceptional performance. Success is not just about what we build, but who we build and how we build it: with integrity, enjoyment, uniqueness and an ever-forward mindset. Job Summary: Leads all aspects of project delivery from preconstruction through closeout, ensuring projects meet DPR Construction’s standards for safety, quality, schedule, and financial performance. Oversees project teams and partners with clients, designers, and trade partners to achieve strategic goals and operational excellence. Partners with the Senior Superintendent as a unified project leadership team, sharing responsibility and accountability for project execution, field integration, and overall team performance. Establishes and maintains dependable project controls processes that keeps the team in alignment with the Prime Agreement (schedule, document control, cost management), project success goals and allows for early detection of issues so they can be mitigated. Develops and implements project execution plans, manages risk, and ensures alignment with DPR’s values and best practices. Supports the development of future leaders by mentoring project managers and engineers. Promotes a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement across all project phases. Key Responsibilities: Oversees the full project lifecycle from business award through final completion, ensuring delivery of scope, budget, schedule, safety, and quality objectives. Manages and directs project teams, including project managers, project engineers, and field operations staff, ensuring alignment with project execution plans and organizational standards, while setting expectations for consistent field presence, reinforcing leadership participation in safety meetings including stretch and flex, and overseeing team fluency and engagement in high-risk activities to drive safe, planned, and controlled outcomes across the project. Builds and maintains relationships with clients, designers, and trade partners to promote collaboration and resolve challenges proactively. Reviews and approves major project decisions, including budgets, contracts, and schedule adjustments, in coordination with project executives and senior leadership. Leads project risk management and mitigation planning, ensuring compliance with DPR’s operational and safety standards. Mentors and develops team members by providing ongoing coaching, delivering structured performance feedback, and guiding individualized development and training plans, strengthening leadership capability and long-term talent growth within DPR’s management framework. Drives continuous improvement initiatives by identifying lessons learned and implementing process enhancements to strengthen project delivery. Education Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in construction management, engineering, architecture, or a related field, or equivalent experience required. Work Experience: 7-10 years of experience in construction project management, including 5 years in a leadership capacity required. Experience managing large, complex commercial, healthcare, life sciences, or advanced technology projects required. Certifications and Licenses: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) 30-Hour Construction certification preferred. OSHA 30 program completion within 6 months of hire is required. DPR Construction is a forward-thinking, self-performing general contractor specializing in technically complex and sustainable projects for the advanced technology, life sciences, healthcare, higher education and commercial markets. Founded in 1990, DPR is a great story of entrepreneurial success as a private, employee-owned company that has grown into a multi-billion-dollar family of companies with offices around the world. Working at DPR, you'll have the chance to try new things, explore paths and shape your future. Here, we build opportunity together—by harnessing our talents, enabling curiosity and pursuing our collective ambition to make the best ideas happen. We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work by our talented teammates and leading news organizations like U.S. News and World Report, Forbes, Fast Company and Newsweek. Experience in Strong ability to apply statistical models, forecasting techniques, and workforce analytics methodologies. Advanced proficiency in Excel, SQL, and data visualization tools (PowerBI, Tableau) Excellent communication and storytelling stills, with proven ability to translate data insights into actionable recommendations for senior leaders. Strong analytical mindset with expertise in project management, stakeholder management, critical thinking and problem solving Principal Accountabilities Partner with HR, Finance, Technology, and business leaders to understand workforce challenges and translate them into data and reporting needs. Lead complex workforce analyses using statistical models and advanced analytics to assess key HR metrics, forecast trends, and support strategic decision making. Transform data findings into clear, compelling narratives that drive strategic decision making. Ensure data integrity by leading quality efforts, verifying analysis, and maintaining high standard of precision Identify opportunities to enhance data systems and reporting capabilities, working closely with Technology and other stakeholders Mentor and provide technical guidance to analysts. title: IT Infrastructure Specialist
jd_text: 7-Eleven is an iconic family of brands with over 86,000 locations, surpassing every retailer in the world. We revolutionize convenience, restaurants and fuel through cutting edge innovation — working hard to be the customer's first choice. 7-Eleven empowers our employees to "activate awesome" and make a meaningful impact in their stores and communities every day. If you're ready to grow, lead and make a difference, come join our team and help shape the future of convenience. The Deskside Support Technician provides advanced technical support for Windows and Macintosh desktops, laptops, and mobile devices, ensuring reliable endpoint services for internal users. The role troubleshoots and resolves hardware, software, application, peripheral, and connectivity issues from the network drop through the end-user device. Responsibilities include supporting iOS and Android devices, mobile device enrollment and configuration, VPN, wireless connectivity, printers, docking stations, and other endpoint technologies. The technician collaborates with IT teams to resolve escalated issues, maintain documentation and asset records, and deliver a professional, customer-focused support experience, excluding security patching and update management. KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITES : Provide Tier 1/Tier 2 deskside support for Windows and macOS desktops, laptops, peripherals, and enterprise applications, resolving hardware, software, and connectivity issues. Support iOS and Android smartphones and tablets, including device setup, configuration, troubleshooting, connectivity, and corporate access. Deliver White Glove support to senior leaders and executives, providing priority response, proactive assistance, and a high-touch customer experience. Troubleshoot LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, remote access, and Microsoft 365 services, including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint, while escalating complex issues to specialized IT teams. Manage endpoint provisioning, onboarding, imaging, refreshes, hardware replacement, asset tracking, ITSM documentation, SLA compliance, knowledge-base updates, and continuous support process improvements. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: EDUCATION: Associates/2 Yr Degree YEARS OF RELEVANT WORK EXPERIENCE: 2+ years YEARS OF MANAGEMENT EXPERIENCE: NA CERTIFICATIONS / LICENSES: An Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred; equivalent relevant IT certifications and professional experience may be accepted in lieu of a degree. Relevant certifications include CompTIA A+/Network+/Security+, Microsoft Endpoint Administrator, Microsoft 365/Azure Fundamentals, ITIL 4 Foundation, Apple Certified Support Professional/IT Professional, Jamf certifications, and HDI Desktop Support Technician. SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS : Microsoft 365 & Enterprise Applications: Proficiency with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, and enterprise software applications. Endpoint Management & Deployment: Hands-on experience with Windows and macOS deployment, imaging, software installation, configuration, and troubleshooting. Mobile Device Management: Experience with Microsoft Intune and Jamf for device enrollment, configuration, application deployment, compliance, and support of iOS, Android, and macOS devices. Networking & IT Infrastructure: Working knowledge of LAN/Wi-Fi connectivity, VPN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Cisco networking technologies, and endpoint-to-network troubleshooting. Technical Problem-Solving & IT Service Management: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, customer-service orientation, ITIL practices, incident management, documentation, and ability to resolve and escalate complex technical issues. title: Systems Engineer
jd_text: Who We Are Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. What We Offer Salary: $120,000.00 - $165,000.00 Location: Austin,TX You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . As a Systems Engineer, you’ll design, integrate, and optimize complex systems that drive the semiconductor industry forward. Your expertise in systems thinking and problem-solving is essential as you collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop advanced solutions to intricate processes and writing system specifications. You’ll be responsible for analyzing requirements, defining system architectures, conducting thorough testing, and ensuring seamless integration of subsystems. Additionally, you’ll identify and mitigate risks, confirming that our systems meet the highest quality standards and exceed customer expectations. Role Responsibilities: Complete definition and design of complex components, modules, and sub systems. Contribute to the system engineering specification both within the field of expertise and broaden into other disciplines. Ensure designs meet market requirement specifications (MRS). Coordinate with project marketing and management to understand sub system requirements. Lead architecture brainstorming meetings and drive the systems process to down select to a final architecture of a subsystem Conduct detailed engineering analysis of sub systems using vast knowledge of design concepts and functional requirements in field of technical expertise and broaden into other disciplines. Assist in creating concepts for architectural design approaches. Evaluate architectures to provide recommendation for best system solution approach Build and qualify prototypes of new designs, or procure entire subsystems from outsourced suppliers and test for compliance with detailed specifications Identify and troubleshoot a variety of difficult engineering problems in field of technical expertise, including serviceability and manufacturability. Support System Integration during the assembly and final testing of new product designs. Perform and coordinate tests against internal and industry-accepted reliability specifications. Make suitable design or operational changes as required. Support system engineering projects that have a substantial mix of electrical, mechanical, physics, algorithms and software design, and understand the underlying system implications. Provide remote and onsite support to field support personnel as required. In this role, you'll partner with local business owners and healthcare providers, helping them navigate products, improve operational efficiencies, and maximize the value of their partnership with McKesson. Success in this position comes from building trusted relationships, providing exceptional customer support, and serving as a reliable resource for customers. Current Need We are seeking a dedicated and relationship-focused Field Service Representative (FSR) to support Post Acute Care customers throughout the Sacramento, California territory. Candidates must reside within the Sacramento metropolitan area, including Sacramento, Roseville, Elk Grove, Folsom, Rocklin, or surrounding communities within the territory. This field-based role is responsible for strengthening customer relationships, supporting onboarding and product utilization initiatives, identifying sales opportunities, and reinforcing the value of McKesson's products and services within customer locations. The ideal candidate will excel at building trust with customers, providing consultative support, and developing long-term business relationships. Position Description The Field Service Representative (FSR) serves as a trusted partner to Tier 1 and Tier 2 customer locations, conducting regular in-person customer visits and supporting key business initiatives. This role works closely with customer decision-makers including Administrators, Owners, Executive Directors, Directors of Nursing, and Business Office Managers to strengthen customer engagement, promote adoption of McKesson solutions, support new customer onboarding, and identify opportunities to grow business within existing accounts. The FSR collaborates with Sales Managers and National Account Managers to drive customer satisfaction, improve formulary compliance, support product conversions, and capitalize on incremental sales opportunities. Compensation and Career Growth This role is designed for professionals in the earlier stages of their sales, customer relationship, or healthcare services career who are looking to develop their skills in a field-based environment. We are seeking candidates with approximately 2-5 years of relevant experience who are eager to build customer relationships, learn the healthcare industry, and grow their careers with McKesson. Base salary of $75,200 annually Target sales incentive opportunity of $12,000 annually , paid on a quarterly basis Total target compensation of $87,200 annually Participation in McKesson's vehicle program, including either a monthly automobile allowance of $668 or a company-provided vehicle with fuel card Comprehensive benefits package and opportunities for career advancement within McKesson Key Responsibilities Conduct scheduled customer visits to assigned PAC customer locations throughout the territory. Build trusted relationships with customer owners, operators, and key decision-makers. Reinforce McKesson's value proposition and ensure customers are maximizing the benefits of their partnership. Support new customer onboarding through training, presentations, and ongoing account support during implementation. Educate customers on product offerings, formulary updates, and product conversion initiatives. title: Manager, Operations
jd_text: Make a Difference At MTM Transit, you’re not just part of a team—you’re at the heart of a movement to remove community barriers nationwide. What will your job look like? The Manager, Operations will play a key role in the management, training, and development of staff and implementation of short and long-term strategic processes. The Manager, Operations will oversee all aspects of the operations staff, primarily the drivers, maintenance, and dispatch staff to ensure that the daily operations and needs of the client are effective, efficient, and are completed based on contractual requirements. The Manager, Operations will strive to ensure the safest and highest quality transportation experience for our passengers while operating within the budget of the contract. This position will be onsite daily at our Austin, Texas location What you’ll do: Oversight of Drivers, Dispatchers, and operations employees and their daily performance, to ensure safe, efficient, effective operation, including scheduling, expenditures, attendance and discipline Perform monthly Safety meetings Training, retraining and updates to policies, procedures and safety guidelines updates, information, and system upgrades as needed Perform additional duties as assigned or required Monitor performance of direct reports and provide coaching and guidance What you’ll need: years] Transit management experience within a large location Previous experience working with senior citizens or persons with disabilities Experience supervising hourly personnel in a passenger transportation environment Experience training in a classroom and behind the wheel setting Must possess a valid driver’s license Skills: Strong problem-solving skills Ability to understand and administer discipline Knowledge of basic safety and training procedures Map reading, two-way radio communication and driving experience preferably in a demand responsive service environment title: IB Temporary - Medical Information Specialist
jd_text: Company Overview ImmunityBio is a vertically integrated commercial stage biotechnology company developing next-generation therapies that bolster the natural immune system to defeat cancers and infectious diseases. The Company’s range of immunotherapy and cell therapy platforms, alone and together, act to drive and sustain an immune response with the goal of creating durable and safe protection against disease. Designated an FDA Breakthrough Therapy, ANKTIVA is the first FDA-approved immunotherapy for non-muscle invasive bladder cancer CIS that activates NK cells, T cells, and memory T cells for a long-duration response. The Company is applying its science and platforms to treating cancers, including the development of potential cancer vaccines, as well as developing immunotherapies and cell therapies that we believe sharply reduce or eliminate the need for standard high-dose chemotherapy. These platforms and their associated product candidates are designed to be more effective, accessible, and easily administered than current standards of care in oncology and infectious diseases. Why ImmunityBio? • ImmunityBio is developing cutting-edge technology with the goal to transform the lives of patients with cancer and develop next-generation therapies and vaccines that complement, harness and amplify the immune system to defeat cancers and infectious diseases. • Opportunity to join a publicly traded biopharmaceutical company with headquarters in Southern California. • Work with a collaborative team with the ability to work across different areas of the company. • Ability to join a growing company with professional development opportunities. Position Summary The IB Temporary - Medical Information Specialist will be accountable for aligning, implementing, and integrating systems, tools, technologies, and processes for Medical Information and Medical Communications from an operations perspective, as it relates to inquiries from a global contact center processing Medical Affairs Information requests for ANKTIVA (nogapendekin alfa inbakicept-pmln) with Bacillus Calmette-Guérin (BCG) for the treatment of adult patients with BCG unresponsive nonmuscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC) with carcinoma in situ (CIS) with or without papillary tumors, global Investigator site inquiries, and patient/caregiver Inquiries about eligibility into our Clinical Trial programs. The role will ensure professional standing and integrity with patients, caregivers, and healthcare professionals through high-quality and aligned medical information and communication. Essential Functions Responds and/or resolves escalated inquiries from unsolicited consumers, health care professionals and other external customer requests for medical and safety information received via telephone, website/e-mail, and/or letter in the ImmunityBio call center. Composes and updates standard response documents (SRDs), seeks Medical | Legal | Regulatory approval for new SRDs; researches and writes custom responses; and supports the development of medical information standard operating procedures (SOPs). Provides labeled and unlabeled efficacy, safety, and related scientific information responses in accordance with regulatory requirements, industry standards and client. Identifies, documents and reports adverse events, special situation events and product complaints in an accurate, clear, and concise manner to Pharmacovigilance. Reviews and confirms eligibility for current clinical trial programs, and if applicable, connects patient/caregiver with appropriate clinical trial contact. Creates compelling and impactful medical materials for patients, healthcare providers (HCPs), and population health decision makers, including field medical decks, evidence submissions, and medical response documents. Participates in Promotional Review Committee and Medical Review Committee as a medical reviewer and supports clinical operations across ImmunityBio’s oncology portfolio. Formulates and provides accurate responses utilizing approved labeling and company standard responses, published literature and other data. Assists with writing custom medical information responses utilizing this data. Documents, triages, and fulfills all medical information enquiries in an accurate, comprehensive, and timely fashion. Troubleshoots issues with the medical information database vendor, as needed. Generates medical information metrics and reports, as required by leadership. Adheres to company privacy policies, ensuring any confidential information or personal data and Data Privacy regulations Comply with the Company’s health and safety policies. Performs other activities as assigned. Education & Experience An advanced scientific degree (PharmD, MD, or PhD) required 2+ years of industry experience in a pharmaceutical Medical Affairs setting required 2+ years of Medical Information and Medical Communication Operations experience required Experience with Veeva Vault Promomats is strongly preferred Experience with medical information databases is strongly preferred Professional experience in call center operations, Medical Information Inquiry tracking, Standard Response Letter writing, and medical operations policies required. Prior experience in Oncology (Prostate, Bladder Cancer, Lung Cancer, Glioblastoma, Colo-Rectal Cancer) is a plus. Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion and show good judgement, compassion, honesty, integrity, and trust building behaviors in all dealings is essential and required. Knowledge of HIPPA and other federal guidelinesExcellent verbal and written communication skills, as the position will interface with key opinion leaders, patients, caregivers and senior leadership team members within ImmunityBio. An ability to effectively communicate, collaborate and deliver an excellent work product in a fast-paced, and rapidly changing and dynamic environment. Working knowledge of medical terminology, pathophysiology, pharmacology, regulations and industry standards. Excellent customer-service orientation to talk with patients and caregivers interested in clinical trials managed by ImmunityBio. Self-motivated, with initiative and the ability to take ownership of and follow through on tasks. Ability to multi-task and shift priorities quickly while working under tight deadlines. Proficient in Microsoft Office computer applications. Working Environment / Physical Environment This position will work remotely Regular work schedule is Monday – Friday, within standard business hours. Flexibility is available with manager approval Possible travel up to 1 day a month. The specific rate will depend on the successful candidate’s qualifications, prior experience as well as geographic location. National Market (all markets unless identified as Premium) $6,154.00 (entry-level qualifications) to $6,769.00 (highly experienced) bi-weekly Premium Market (Premium markets include Los Angeles, San Diego, San Francisco, New York City, Chicago, & Boston) $7,115.00 (entry-level qualifications) to $7,827.00 (highly experienced) bi-weekly The application window is anticipated to close on 60 days from when it is posted or sooner if the position is filled or closed. These tools help us reach qualified applicants and improve the efficiency of our recruitment outreach. No preference is given to applicants sourced or identified by AI tools. One of several key positions in the GFCD Operations function, this position will be responsible for driving business solutions, managing GFCD and International Compliance initiatives that drive strategic change, improve operational efficiency, optimize processes, and deliver continuous improvement through innovative solutions. Collaborate with senior executives and stakeholders across the globe to define the scope of effort, deliverables, dependencies, resource requirements and timing. Create and manage plans to successfully deliver the scope of the initiative. Develop, manage and facilitate governance routines as needed for execution. Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders to ensure successful execution. Lead cross-functional teams to successfully implement initiatives on time, managing risks, escalating issues when needed and clearly defining roles and responsibilities. Synthesize large amounts of information and conduct detailed analysis and documentation of current business operations and processes. Identify areas for improvement and develop viable solutions to optimize operations, streamline processes, enhance efficiency and further mitigate risks. Create and present clear, concise senior executive presentations of current state operations, proposed solutions/recommendations and progress. Identify and propose new initiatives to management. Additional Responsibilities: Partner with senior leadership to manage regulatory exams, audits, and audit Issues as they arise on the team. Team Lead for two offshore team members in India. Responsible for managing offshoring governance meetings with senior stakeholders, reporting, inter-affiliate agreements, business continuity plans, invoicing, supporting new joiners in India and hiring in India. Qualifications: Proven success leading and driving global, high profile, complex, cross functional business solutions. Collaborative with strong interpersonal skills to effectively interact and work with cross functional teams at all management levels across the globe. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously while delivering on time. Excellent leadership and executive level influencing skills. Ability to operate under pressure, with urgency, prioritize work accordingly and manage to tight deadlines. Strong decision-making skills and the ability to demonstrate sound judgement. Demonstrated ability to drive change across large, global, matrixed organizations. Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities; ability to quickly ramp up on content areas. Outstanding attention to detail, accuracy and quality. Ability to develop well-structured, visually compelling PowerPoint presentations for senior executive audiences. Ability to work autonomously and initiate and prioritize own work. Highly motivated, proactive, organized and positive individual. Outstanding communication (written and verbal) and executive level presentation skills. Ability to pivot frequently, adapt to change and create order from ambiguity. Ability to balance regulatory requirements with the best interests of the Bank and its customers. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint, Word, Excel, SharePoint). Proven success managing regulatory exams, internal audits and open Issues. 5-7 years’ experience of transformation management or change management experience and/or; 5+ years of financial industry, consulting, financial crime compliance experience and/or; 5+ years of reengineering and/or process improvement experience; 3+ years of team lead and/or people management experience. Additional skills a plus Experience working in a large international organization is preferred. Banking and/or consulting experience preferred. 4-year university degree preferred. ACAMS certification a plus. Experience interfacing with banking regulators and enforcement staff preferred. Understanding of an effective financial crimes risk management framework a plus. undefined The typical base pay range for this role is $122,000 to $166,000 depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and location. title: Concrete Project Manager - Traveler
jd_text: Job Description At DPR, roles and responsibilities are more than describing a job title—they are a commitment to building great things together. The job description(s) below defines core responsibilities and the scope of the role and is a starting point. Every employee is expected to lead from where they are, take ownership of outcomes, and always act in the best interest of the team, customer, project and organization. As a purpose-driven organization on a journey to be most admired, we rely on trust, shared leadership, open communication, disciplined action and a deep respect for the individual to drive exceptional performance. Success is not just about what we build, but who we build and how we build it: with integrity, enjoyment, uniqueness and an ever-forward mindset. Job Summary: Manages Self-Perform Work (SPW) construction project individuals to deliver high-quality results and foster professional growth. Oversees the successful delivery of SPW construction projects by providing advanced expertise in self-perform construction activities, to ensure successful project execution in alignment with standards and methodologies. Manages and aligns SPW workers, subcontractors, and external partners to ensure project requirements, schedules, and quality standards are consistently achieved. Ensures efficient project execution by actively managing SPW team productivity, monitoring progress, analyzing project performance, identifying and resolving both routine and complex issues, and managing project budgets, forecasts, contracts, and cost controls to achieve financial targets and mitigate risks. Cultivates a collaborative and inclusive team environment by modeling positive leadership behaviors, fostering open communication, and actively promoting organizational values and frameworks to enhance team engagement, professional growth, and project success. Key Responsibilities: Leads, manages, and develops a team of construction SPW project individuals to achieve exceptional performance and encourage talent development. Oversees end-to-end execution of self-perform work scopes by collaborating with SPW project teams, monitoring progress, and addressing escalated, complex issues to ensure timely completion. Oversees and approves procurement of SPW-specific materials, equipment, and specialty trade subcontractors as needed, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with SPW work sequences and field requirements. Communicates SPW project status, risks, and changes to stakeholders, leveraging advanced knowledge in SPW means and methods. Evaluates SPW project performance, identifies areas for improvement, and implements corrective actions. Reviews comprehensive SPW project documentation for compliance, reporting, and future reference, while actively managing project costs and forecasting to support financial control and informed decision-making. Education Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in construction management, engineering, architecture, a related field, or equivalent experience required. Work Experience: 7 years of experience in construction engineering, project engineering, or a related field required. 1 - 2 years of experience in a managerial capacity preferred. Certifications and Licenses: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) 30-Hour Construction certification preferred. OSHA 30 program completion within 6 months of hire is required. DPR Construction is a forward-thinking, self-performing general contractor specializing in technically complex and sustainable projects for the advanced technology, life sciences, healthcare, higher education and commercial markets. Founded in 1990, DPR is a great story of entrepreneurial success as a private, employee-owned company that has grown into a multi-billion-dollar family of companies with offices around the world. Working at DPR, you'll have the chance to try new things, explore paths and shape your future. Here, we build opportunity together—by harnessing our talents, enabling curiosity and pursuing our collective ambition to make the best ideas happen. We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work by our talented teammates and leading news organizations like U.S. News and World Report, Forbes, Fast Company and Newsweek. Explore our open opportunities at www.dpr.com/careers .

title: Full Time - Receiver/Stocker - Overnight
jd_text: Your Impact at Lowe’s As a Receiver/Stocker, you help keep the store clean, safe, and ready for customers by accurately receiving freight, stocking shelves, and organizing merchandise and top stock. You’ll unload deliveries, handle equipment and hazardous materials safely, and make sure your area is prepped for daily success. This role is physical and fast-paced, requiring safe lifting practices and attention to detail. You’ll spend most of your shift on your feet, working mornings, afternoons, evenings, or overnight depending on store needs. And when a customer or teammate needs help, you’ll be there with a friendly, professional attitude. How We Support You Whether you need a part-time position or a place to plant yourself and grow, Lowe’s is ready to support your goals. As a Lowe’s associate, you’ll gain access to many benefits beyond competitive pay and flexible schedules. Make your well-being a priority with multiple top-tier health insurance options. Explore educational opportunities with Lowe’s tuition assistance program. Take charge of your financial future with a company-matching 401(k) and optional Employee Stock Purchase Program. Gain extra savings with a 10% Associate Discount. Learn new trade skills with our Track to the Trades program. For information about our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit https://talent.lowes.com/us/en/benefits . Your Day at Lowe’s You’ll keep shelves stocked and backrooms organized by unloading freight, moving products to the sales floor, and maintaining a clean, safe workspace. You may also assist customers in locating or loading products. Most shifts are physically active, and scheduling may include morning, evening, or overnight hours based on store needs. Key Responsibilities Deliver SMART customer service by assisting customers, answering questions, and offering support during projects Stock merchandise by unloading freight, down-stocking, organizing shelves, and setting up pallets Support store operations by verifying deliveries, completing dock prep, and using equipment like pallet jacks and forklifts Maintain a safe, clean environment by following proper procedures for hazardous materials, equipment use, and housekeeping Operate store equipment including scanners, Zebra phones, balers, and other tools as needed Pitch in as a team player to complete other assigned tasks Additional responsibilities for Pro Fulfillment Stores include: Use the Orders App to pick and stage Flatbed Delivery orders Load delivery orders, ensuring quality, accuracy, and safe loading practices Rotate orders by delivery date and resolve customer order issues Proactively communicate with customers to ensure delivery satisfaction Execute Delivery Readiness best practices Minimum Qualifications High school diploma or GED or equivalent years of experience in lieu of education requirement, if applicable Preferred Qualifications 3 months Experience operating forklift/power equipment such as lifts, order pickers, and similar equipment 6 months Experience in a warehouse performing inventory handling and stocking Lowe’s commitment to growth and teamwork extends to the community as well. To better equip our stores and serve our communities, we actively seek and encourage bilingual, military, and veteran talent to apply and join our team. Travel Requirements This role does not require regular travel, but occasional travel may be needed for meetings, training sessions, or to support nearby stores. Working Conditions Environmental factors vary by location. You may be working in both inside and outside weather conditions. Exposure to varying climates, including extreme heat or cold, wet, damp, humid, windy, or drafty conditions, is possible. title: Associate State Product Manager - Personal Lines
location: United States - Remote / 100298 / Associate State Product Manager - Personal Lines
jd_text: If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care. Ideal candidate would demonstrate: Strategic and critical thinking capabilities An ability to generate clear, data-driven insights Excellent communication skills P&C industry experience preferred in State Management #LI-KP1 #LI-Remote Job Description Summary The Associate State Manager supports the development and execution of state-specific business strategies designed to drive the Personal Lines portfolio toward top and bottom-line performance goals aligned with enterprise objectives. Working under the oversight of a State Manager, this role assists in implementing processes related to financial planning, rate reviews, market development, and communication. The Associate State Manager contributes to strategic alignment by providing analytical insights, preparing planning documents, and coordinating initiatives that support pricing, underwriting appetite, product structure, and distribution strategies. This position plays a key role in supporting operating plans that achieve P&L objectives, including combined ratio, revenue growth, regulatory management, and legal compliance. The Associate State Manager ensures execution through detailed analysis, project coordination, and collaboration with cross-functional partners. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, curiosity, and the ability to translate data into actionable insights that help maintain state strategies as relevant, competitive, and profitable. Job Description Key Responsibilities: Support State Manager in executing state strategies by assisting with financial planning, rate reviews, and market development initiatives. Prepare and analyze reports on product performance, pricing, underwriting trends, and market dynamics to identify risks and opportunities. Assist in developing planning documents and review materials for monthly and quarterly state performance meetings. Integrate competitive intelligence into recommendations that inform pricing and product positioning. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Marketing, Operations, Claims, Pricing, Underwriting, Legal, IT, Product Development) to ensure timely execution of initiatives. Coordinate and track project timelines to support speed-to-market for updates and enhancements. Communicate findings and recommendations effectively to State Manager and stakeholders, adjusting approach based on audience. Develop foundational knowledge of assigned state markets and competitor strategies to support decision-making. Participate in professional development and mentorship opportunities, building skills for future leadership roles. May perform other responsibilities as assigned. Reporting Relationships: Reports to Sr State Product Manager – Personal Lines or State Product Manager – Personal Lines. Individual contributor role. T ypical Skills and Experiences: Education: Bachelor’s degree in insurance, actuarial science, mathematics, risk management, economics, finance, accounting, business administration or related field preferred. License/Certification/Designation: Progress toward or completion of CPCU, AU CIC, INS ARM, Actuarial exams or similar designations preferred. Experience: Six years of experience in underwriting or product preferred. Cross-functional experience from other areas and experience with data analysis preferred. Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Knowledge of core business functions and detailed knowledge of commercial lines insurance products and pricing architecture, state regulations, underwriting procedures and standard methodologies. Solid understanding of financials, trend analysis and competitor data. Proficiency in analytical tools, relational databases, data visualization techniques, query-based language and/or statistical software experience preferred. Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing to present information, communicate and influence internal and external partners at all levels. Must be skilled in the use of related systems and analytical tools. Ability to work towards results, deal with ambiguity, solve problems, learn on the job, make quality decisions, see trends and patterns within data. Ability to lead projects, opposing priorities, timelines and resources to complete work. Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence. The CoverMyMeds Field Reimbursement Manager (FRM) is responsible for managing an assigned territory focused on supporting Reimbursement and Patient services by providing assistance with patient reimbursement challenges for a specific drug (including Benefit Investigation, Prior Authorization, Claims Assistance, and Appeals) and educating the office on Payer landscape and services available through both remote interaction and on-site training. Reporting to the Manager, Talent Delivery, the Talent Advisor is a consultative, hands-on recruiter supporting high-volume hiring for entry-level warehouse and operations roles . You’ll partner closely with Hiring Managers to translate workforce needs into strong candidate pipelines, moving quickly from sourcing and screening through selection and offer execution. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment where speed, service, and process discipline matter, this role is an opportunity to directly impact the frontline teams that keep operations running every day. What You’ll Do (Responsibilities) Own full cycle recruiting for entry-level warehouse and operations positions, from sourcing strategy through offer execution. Consult with Hiring Managers, HR partners, and business leaders to align hiring goals, timelines, and selection criteria. Execute an effective selection process using the right recruiting strategy, tools, and candidate experience approach. Guide Hiring Managers on structured interviewing and support selection discussions to promote consistent and legally compliant practices. Influence hiring process flow to improve timeliness against service level expectations (SLAs) and reduce friction in the funnel. title: Sr. Manager, Corporate Strategy (Pharmaceutical)
location: Irving, TX, USA - 6555 North State Highway 161 (P001)
jd_text: McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care. What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you. This role is a hybrid position. The selected candidate is expected to work on-site at our Las Colinas (Irving, TX) office a minimum of two (2) days per week, with the remaining days worked remotely. Specific in-office days may be designated based on team needs and business priorities. About the Role: The Senior Manager, Segment Strategy - Generics is an analytical individual contributor role within the strategy team, supporting the development of frameworks, models, research and strategy recommendations that enable the evaluation and execution of key strategic initiatives for our Generics business within our North America Pharmaceutical Distribution (NAPD) segment. Reporting to the VP, Product Strategy & Strategic Initiatives, this position operates as a key strategic partner to our Generics organization. Success in this role is defined by the ability to translate complex dynamics into insights, collaborate well across multiple groups / functions, and ensure strategic work leads to practical, executable outcomes. What You'll Do: Strategic Analysis & Insight Own end-to-end analytical workstreams within larger strategic initiatives — from problem structuring and hypothesis development through analysis and synthesis of findings — with guidance from initiative leads on framing and prioritization. Build rigorous fact bases on market structure, competitor strategies and economics, customer segments, and channel dynamics across the pharmaceutical distribution value chain. Synthesize complex quantitative and qualitative information into clear, well-structured storylines; consistently deliver the “so what,” not just the analysis. Identify implications of your own workstream for the overall initiative, and flag issues and opportunities to initiative leadership proactively. Value Chain & Financial Analysis Build and maintain financial models that translate market shifts — reimbursement changes, sourcing dynamics, customer mix evolution, competitive moves — into quantified P&L implications for the business, with review from senior team members. Develop working knowledge of how each participant in the pharmaceutical value chain — manufacturers, distributors, PBMs, payers, and pharmacies — earns, protects, and seeks to expand its economic position. Track and analyze legislative, regulatory, and policy developments — including drug pricing reform, PBM transparency requirements, and reimbursement policy changes — and support the assessment of their financial and competitive implications. Support scenario and sensitivity analysis: pressure-test the assumptions that matter most and help bound the range of plausible outcomes. Problem Solving & Collaboration Participate actively in team problem solving; step up to lead portions of problem-solving sessions with the team and with business partners. Challenge assumptions constructively and take intellectual risks to generate new ideas; bring curiosity about how the distribution business actually works economically. Manage your own time and workplan effectively; know how and when to seek input; control the quality of your own work product. Communication & Stakeholder Support Prepare well-written, logical, concise documents and executive materials with minimal guidance; lead with key messages. Present analysis and recommendations with confidence to initiative teams and, with preparation, to senior business audiences. Build collaborative working relationships with business, finance, sourcing, commercial, and functional partners; project credibility and reliability. Team & Function Contribution Coach newer team members on analytical craft, modeling standards, and story lining; provide constructive upward feedback. Contribute to strategy function-building efforts — recruiting, knowledge capture, analytical tooling, and ways of working. Basic Requirements: Degree or equivalent and typically requires 4+ years of relevant experience. 4+ years of progressive experience in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, finance, market / business intelligence or comparable analytically intensive roles. Exposure to healthcare, generics pharmaceutical services, or distribution businesses strongly preferred; genuine interest in the economics of the pharmaceutical value chain is essential. Demonstrated advanced financial modeling capability — building models from a blank sheet that connect market dynamics to P&L outcomes. Track record of structuring ambiguous problems, executing rigorous analysis, and producing executive-ready synthesis and deliverables. Experience working effectively in cross-functional teams and managing multiple deliverables under time pressure. Additional Skills/Experience: Structured Problem Solver: Formulates clear hypotheses and structures workstreams well with light guidance; handles complex analyses with little oversight and moves efficiently from data to insight. Financial Modeling & P&L Literacy: Builds financial models as strategic tools — not to forecast with false precision but to identify the assumptions that matter and quantify the implications of strategic choices. Synthesis & Story Lining: Distills complex information into clear, logical storylines; writes and charts at near executive-ready quality; consistently answers “so what.” Value Chain Curiosity: Demonstrates genuine intellectual curiosity about how distribution, sourcing, pharmacy, PBM, and payer economics actually work — and is building working fluency in them. Collaborative Teammate: Is a reliable, helpful, and proactive teammate; builds trust with partners across the business; coaches junior colleagues and is open to coaching from others. Communication: Writes clearly and concisely; presents with confidence in familiar settings; listens well and tailors style and tone to the audience. title: Manager, Strategic Planning
jd_text: 7-Eleven is an iconic family of brands with over 86,000 locations, surpassing every retailer in the world. We revolutionize convenience, restaurants and fuel through cutting edge innovation — working hard to be the customer's first choice. 7-Eleven empowers our employees to "activate awesome" and make a meaningful impact in their stores and communities every day. If you're ready to grow, lead and make a difference, come join our team and help shape the future of convenience. The Manager of Strategic Planning will be a key partner in shaping the strategic narrative of 7-Eleven and supporting executive leadership in driving growth and reinforcing market leadership. This role centers on transforming complex business performance, market trends, and strategic initiatives into executive-, board-, and stakeholder-ready narratives that inform decision-making and inspire action. Working across functions, the Manager will synthesize internal and external insights into actionable recommendations, executive communications and presentation materials that support strategic decision-making and stakeholder alignment. The role requires exceptional ability to translate executive discussions and complex business topics into clear, compelling storylines and presentation materials for senior leadership, Board members, and key stakeholders. KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITES : Executive Presentation Development: Partner with senior leadership to shape, structure, and translate strategic discussions, business priorities, and complex topics into presentations for senior leadership and the Board. Strategic Storyline Development: Identify key messages, structure complex business issues, and develop persuasive storylines that support leadership communication and decision-making. Executive Communications & Decision Support: Develop executive briefing materials, strategic recommendations, and discussion documents that support leadership decision-making and alignment around key business priorities. Strategic Planning Support : Support strategic planning initiatives through analysis of business performance, market trends, and strategic priorities, translating insights into actionable recommendations for leadership. Cross-Functional Strategic Partnership: Partner with business units and functional leaders to align priorities, shape strategic narratives, and support the communication of key business objectives. Market & Competitive Insights: Analyze industry trends, competitive dynamics, consumer trends, and other market developments to identify opportunities, risks, and key insights that inform strategic planning. Executive & Stakeholder Presentations: Support the development of selected presentations for investors, executive leadership, Board, and external stakeholders, ensuring clear and consistent communication of the company's strategy and performance. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: EDUCATION: Bachelors/4 Yr Degree YEARS OF RELEVANT WORK EXPERIENCE: 5+ years YEARS OF MANAGEMENT EXPERIENCE: 2+ years CERTIFICATIONS / LICENSES: N/A SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS : Executive Presentation Development: Advanced PowerPoint skills, including storyline development, information hierarchy, visual communication, and executive presentation design. Strategic Problem Structuring: Ability to structure ambiguous business issues, identify key messages, and develop recommendations that support executive decision-making. Executive Storytelling: Exceptional ability to synthesize complex topics into clear, concise, and compelling executive-level narratives. Business Acumen: Strong understanding of internal business processes, strategic priorities, and performance drivers. Analytical Skills: Demonstrated ability to analyze data, identify insights, and develop data-driven business recommendations. Financial Acumen: Strong understanding of financial metrics. Executive Presence & Stakeholder Management: Ability to work effectively with senior executives, navigate ambiguity, and influence stakeholders through clear communication and sound judgement. Collaboration: Ability to work collaboratively across multiple teams and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization. Industry Experience: Experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, or strategic planning roles, preferably within retail, restaurants, consumer products, or other consumer-facing industries. Leadership Experience: Experience leading projects, mentoring team members, or managing cross-functional initiatives. Education: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Finance, Economics, or a related field; MBA preferred. title: Business Unit Relationship Sourcing Manager
location: Dallas, Texas, United States of America
jd_text: We're seeking someone to join our Global Supplier Services (GSS) team as a Business Unit Relationship Manager, VP providing execution, coordination, and enablement support to the Business Unit Relationship Sourcing Lead. This role plays a critical part in ensuring consistent, timely, and high quality delivery of sourcing services to the business by supporting intake, coordinating sourcing activity, maintaining lifecycle visibility, and enabling effective execution across initiatives. In the Corporate Services division, we empower our businesses by creating collaborative workplace solutions and commercial services that enhance the employee and client experience, while optimizing the value of our sourcing and third-party lifecycle to enable the Firm to do-and-win business. Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world. What you'll do in the role: - Act as the primary day to day execution and coordination support for the Business Unit Relationship Sourcing Lead - Support intake, clarification, tracking, and routing of sourcing demand across Technology, Professional Services, Non IT, and other spend categories - Assist in managing sourcing workflows, priorities, and follow ups across active initiatives - Prepare materials for business unit discussions, leadership updates, and decision forums - Track key milestones across renewals, negotiations, and sourcing initiatives to ensure momentum and follow through - Maintain visibility into the business unit sourcing pipeline, active initiatives, and upcoming demand - Support consistent application of Global Supplier Services policies, governance, and sourcing standards - Identify execution risks, issues, or bottlenecks and escalate as appropriate - Assist with commercial summaries, analyses, dashboards, and business unit level reporting. What you'll bring to the role: - Experience in sourcing, procurement, vendor management, commercial management, or business operations - Strong organizational, coordination, and follow through skills with attention to detail - Ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast paced, matrixed environment - Clear and effective communication skills, with comfort interacting with business and functional stakeholders - Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with sourcing or contract management tools is a plus - Experience within financial services or a large enterprise environment preferred - Exposure to Technology, Professional Services, or enterprise vendor ecosystems preferred - Experience supporting senior stakeholders or relationship managers preferred The position’s work location will be 1445 Ross Ave, Dallas, TX 75202 at a future date. The role may begin remotely until the office location becomes available. In-Person interviews will be required for the role. title: Area Sales Manager, Ambulatory Care, Upstate New York
jd_text: McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care. What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you. McKesson Medical-Surgical is seeking an exceptional Area Sales Manager to lead our Ambulatory Care sales team throughout Upstate New York , supporting a territory that spans from Albany west through Syracuse, Rochester, and Buffalo and surrounding markets . This is more than a sales leadership role. It is an opportunity to guide a high-performing team through continued growth, change, and evolution within an increasingly dynamic healthcare landscape. We are looking for a true leader, not simply a manager . The ideal candidate will possess the executive presence, emotional intelligence, healthcare industry expertise, and business acumen necessary to inspire teams, navigate change, and drive performance across a geographically dispersed territory. This leader will inherit a team that includes both highly tenured, successful sales professionals and newer team members who are actively developing their skills and careers. Success in this role requires a leader who can honor what has worked, introduce fresh ideas and new approaches, accelerate development, and foster a culture of continuous learning and growth. As healthcare continues to evolve, this leader will play a critical role in helping team members understand changing market dynamics, embrace new technologies, leverage AI-enabled tools, and execute with consistency and excellence. The successful candidate will be a strategic thinker, skilled coach, change agent, and culture builder with a passion for developing people and driving sustainable business growth. Location Requirement To support effective territory leadership and regular field engagement, candidates should currently reside within the Upstate New York territory and be willing to travel extensively throughout the territory on a regular basis. Preferred locations include: Albany Syracuse Rochester Buffalo Key Responsibilities Lead, coach, and develop a geographically dispersed sales team, supporting both tenured high performers and developing talent while fostering accountability, engagement, and continuous growth. Guide the team through evolving healthcare market dynamics, organizational change, and business transformation while maintaining clarity, focus, and performance. Develop and execute territory strategies that drive sales growth, profitability, customer retention, and market share. Drive consistent execution across the region through clear expectations, effective communication, coaching, and disciplined performance management. Maintain an active field presence through regular travel, customer engagement, and ride-alongs to strengthen relationships and provide real-time coaching. Build executive-level customer relationships and leverage market intelligence, customer insights, and business analytics to identify opportunities and deliver effective solutions. Use financial acumen and key performance metrics to evaluate territory performance, inform decisions, and drive profitable growth. Champion continuous improvement and the adoption of innovative technologies, data, and AI-enabled tools that improve team effectiveness and customer outcomes. Travel Requirements 75% Travel Frequent travel throughout Upstate New York is required. Regular overnight travel should be expected. Significant field-based leadership, coaching, customer engagement, and team development activities are essential components of the role. Minimum Requirements 9 years of relevant experience 1 year of direct or indirect leadership Valid driver's license 7-year Motor Vehicle Record check completed as part of pre-employment screening Compensation Base Salary: $165,000 - $175,000 Management Incentive Plan: 20% of annual base salary Sales Incentive: $59,000 target Auto Program: Company vehicle with fuel card or monthly auto allowance of $668 Eligible for McKesson Long-Term Incentive Program Critical Preferred Qualifications Demonstrated healthcare industry experience required, preferably within medical distribution, medical-surgical, ambulatory care, post-acute care, physician office, or related healthcare markets. Proven success leading sales teams through change, transformation, growth, and evolving market conditions. Strong track record of coaching and developing both experienced and emerging sales talent while fostering engagement, accountability, and performance. Deep understanding of healthcare market dynamics, customer needs, and industry trends, with the ability to translate insights into effective sales strategies. Demonstrated ability to drive results across geographically dispersed teams through disciplined execution, strategic planning, and strong financial acumen. Growth-minded leader who embraces continuous learning, innovation, technology, and AI-enabled tools to improve business outcomes and team effectiveness. Executive presence with exceptional communication, relationship-building, and influencing skills. Must reside within the Upstate New York territory, preferably Albany, Syracuse, Rochester, or Buffalo. Education Bachelor's Degree required Working Conditions Frequent automobile and air travel Regular walking and standing Significant field-based customer and team engagement activities Traditional office and remote work environments We are proud to offer a competitive compensation package at McKesson as part of our Total Rewards. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. The pay range shown below is aligned with McKesson's pay philosophy, and pay will always be compliant with any applicable regulations. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered. For more information regarding benefits at McKesson, please click here. Our Total Target Cash (TTC) Pay Range for this position: $168,000 - $280,000 Total Target Cash (TTC) is defined as base pay plus target incentive. title: Sr. Electrical Project Manager-1
jd_text: Job Description At DPR, roles and responsibilities are more than describing a job title—they are a commitment to building great things together. The job description(s) below defines core responsibilities and the scope of the role and is a starting point. Every employee is expected to lead from where they are, take ownership of outcomes, and always act in the best interest of the team, customer, project and organization. As a purpose-driven organization on a journey to be most admired, we rely on trust, shared leadership, open communication, disciplined action and a deep respect for the individual to drive exceptional performance. Success is not just about what we build, but who we build and how we build it: with integrity, enjoyment, uniqueness and an ever-forward mindset. Job Summary: Oversees the successful delivery of Self-Perform Work (SPW) projects by leading scope, schedule, cost, and quality management across multiple related scopes, multiple projects and teams, or a single large scale/complex scope. Applies advanced technical expertise and field management experience to plan and execute complex SPW operations—including concrete, drywall, framing, and other trades—ensuring alignment with DPR Construction’s standards of safety, quality, and operational excellence. Leads and develops SPW project teams to drive high performance, innovation, and continuous improvement in self-perform delivery. Engages in resource strategy, partner relationship management, and business unit objectives to advance DPR’s capabilities as a whole and contribute to excellent project execution. Key Responsibilities: Leads SPW project execution from preconstruction through closeout, ensuring all scope, schedule, and cost objectives are achieved. Oversees project planning, resource allocation, and cost management to maintain operational efficiency and profitability. Manages and mentors SPW project teams, including project managers, project engineers, and superintendents, to promote professional growth. Collaborates with design and general contracting teams to coordinate SPW scopes and resolve technical and logistical challenges. Reviews and approves project budgets, forecasts, and procurement strategies for materials, labor, and equipment. Ensures adherence to DPR Construction’s safety and quality programs through regular site engagement and performance monitoring. Regularly assess processes and practices to look for ways to improve performance. Develops best practices and ensures team adherence to those best practices to strengthen SPW operations. Education Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in construction management, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience required. Work Experience: 10–12 years of experience in construction operations, project management, or field supervision required. 5 or more years of experience managing Self-Perform Work (SPW) projects or trades such as concrete, drywall, or framing required. Certifications and Licenses: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) 30-Hour Construction certification preferred. OSHA 30 program completion within 6 months of hire is required. DPR Construction is a forward-thinking, self-performing general contractor specializing in technically complex and sustainable projects for the advanced technology, life sciences, healthcare, higher education and commercial markets. Founded in 1990, DPR is a great story of entrepreneurial success as a private, employee-owned company that has grown into a multi-billion-dollar family of companies with offices around the world. Working at DPR, you'll have the chance to try new things, explore paths and shape your future. Here, we build opportunity together—by harnessing our talents, enabling curiosity and pursuing our collective ambition to make the best ideas happen. We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work by our talented teammates and leading news organizations like U.S. News and World Report, Forbes, Fast Company and Newsweek. Explore our open opportunities at www.dpr.com/careers .

jd_text: 7-Eleven is an iconic family of brands with over 86,000 locations, surpassing every retailer in the world. We revolutionize convenience, restaurants and fuel through cutting edge innovation — working hard to be the customer's first choice. 7-Eleven empowers our employees to "activate awesome" and make a meaningful impact in their stores and communities every day. Job Description The Senior Strategic Planning Analyst supports high priority strategic initiatives that inform executive decision making and long-term business planning at 7-Eleven. This role enables CEO and Board level discussions by translating complex internal and external inputs into structured analyses and clear narratives that support enterprise direction. The position strengthens the Strategy team’s enterprise-wide efforts by combining analytical rigor with executive ready storytelling. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating in ambiguity, synthesizing complex data into clear insights, and supporting senior stakeholders through decision ready outputs in high visibility settings. This is not a traditional corporate strategy role. While the team partners closely with senior leadership, it does not run enterprise planning processes and instead operates in an internal advisory capacity, supporting leadership through analytical insights, competitive intelligence, and executive ready materials that inform enterprise discussions and decision making. Key Responsibilities Develop executive ready presentations that translate analysis into structured narratives for senior leadership and Board audiences. Conduct research and strategic analysis on macroeconomic trends, competitive dynamics, customer behaviors, and retail technology. Frame ambiguous business questions into structured analyses that support enterprise-wide initiatives and Board updates. Synthesize complex data and external signals into concise executive summaries for senior leadership. Present analytical outputs directly to senior stakeholders on a day-to-day basis. Partner with cross functional teams to gather intelligence and reflect an integrated enterprise view. Lead competitive intelligence deep dives and track market share, business model shifts, and emerging disruptors. Support preparation of materials during high intensity reporting cycles such as earnings, Board meetings, and Monthly Business Reviews. Serve as an analytical thought partner to senior leadership by distilling complex concepts into clear narratives. Improve knowledge management processes to strengthen insight accessibility and organizational agility. Qualifications 3 to 5 years of experience in corporate strategy, management consulting, investment banking, or strategic planning within retail, CPG, or technology sectors. Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Economics, or a quantitative field. Advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills with demonstrated ability to independently develop Board or C suite ready materials. Strong executive communication skills with experience drafting structured summaries for senior audiences and presenting to senior stakeholders. Strong business acumen with the ability to identify implications and translate analysis into decision ready outputs. Experience working with market or consumer insights and competitive analysis. Comfortable operating in fast paced reporting environments with multiple concurrent deadlines and high intensity deliverable cycles. Experience utilizing LLM based tools for research and insight generation, coupled with a growth-oriented mindset and willingness to take on complex analytical challenges. Preferred Qualifications Master’s degree in business, Finance, Economics, or a quantitative field. Familiarity with investor relations processes or earnings preparation cycles. Strong grasp of key retail performance metrics such as comp sales, margins, and store level economics. Experience working with external data or intelligence platforms such as Bloomberg, Placer.ai, or AlphaSense. title: Medical Writer - Remote US
jd_text: It’s More Than a Career, It’s a Mission. Our people are the foundation of our success. By joining our growing team at Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI), a subsidiary of McKesson, you will have the opportunity to become part of one of the largest community-based cancer programs to advance oncology treatments and improve outcomes for cancer patients across the globe. We look for mission-driven candidates who have a desire to advance the fight against cancer and make a difference in the lives of patients diagnosed with cancer every day. Our Mission People who live with cancer – those who work to prevent it, fight it, and survive it – are at the heart of every decision we make. Bringing the most innovative medical minds together with the most passionate caregivers in their communities, we are transforming care and personalizing treatment. Through clinical excellence and cutting-edge research, SCRI is redefining cancer care around the world. Our Medical Writer will have the overall responsibility for researching, writing, and editing a variety of documents across multiple therapeutic areas. The Medical Writer will work in conjunction with other Sarah Cannon Research Institute departments and Sponsors, as appropriate, for the effective preparation and timely delivery of contracted material. This is a remote position based in the US; relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not available. Job duties include and are not limited to: Write clinical documents associated with submissions to regulatory authorities, including but not limited to Clinical Study Protocols, Informed Consents, and Clinical Study Reports Serve as the Medical Writing representative on assigned project teams, providing timelines for Medical Writing deliverables and Medical Writing input into other departmental deliverables Responsibility for Medical Writing document version control for study deliverables created by the Medical Writing department Identify any potential project challenges, including changes in project plans or timelines or out-of-scope requests and suggest possible solutions to the Project Manager and Sponsor Perform literature searches/reviews as necessary to obtain background information and training for development of clinical documents Serve as the primary Sponsor point of contact for clinical document writing on an assigned project Ensure Medical Editing review of draft and final documents before external distribution, which includes both copyediting and content review. Other duties as assigned Qualifications include: Bachelor's Degree required, Master's Degree preferred 3+ years' work experience as a Medical Writer, preferably within the clinical research industry Experience with oncology clinical trials Thorough understanding of GCP and ICH guidelines Advanced user experience with all Microsoft Office products Adherence to SCRI SOPs and applicable guidance documents About Sarah Cannon Research Institute Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI) is one of the world’s leading oncology research organizations conducting community-based clinical trials. Focused on advancing therapies for patients over the last three decades, SCRI is a leader in drug development. In 2022, SCRI formed a joint venture with former US Oncology Research to expand clinical trial access across the country. It has conducted more than 850 first-in-human clinical trials since its inception and contributed to pivotal research that has led to the majority of new cancer therapies approved by the FDA in the past decade. SCRI’s research network brings together more than 1,300 physicians who are enrolling patients into clinical trials at more than 200 locations in 20+ states across the U.S. Please click here to learn more about our research offerings. We care about the well-being of the patients and communities we serve, and that starts with caring for our people. That’s why we have a Total Rewards package that includes comprehensive benefits to support physical, mental, and financial well-being. Our Total Rewards offerings serve the different needs of our diverse colleague population and ensure they are the healthiest versions of themselves. For more information regarding benefits through our parent company, McKesson, please click here . As part of Total Rewards, we are proud to offer a competitive compensation package. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered. In light of these scams, please bear the following in mind: McKesson Talent Advisors will never solicit money or credit card information in connection with a McKesson job application. McKesson Talent Advisors do not communicate with candidates via online chatrooms or using email accounts such as Gmail or Hotmail. title: Parcel Van Driver Professional
jd_text: McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care. What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you. Our McKesson Grapevine, TX location, is looking for a dynamic and motivated driver associate to join the team. This is a fantastic chance to work for a company that has a great reputation in the healthcare sector. Products you would deliver would include medical supplies and equipment. We currently have the following FT Parcel Van Driver Professional position available: Monday to Friday, 6:45am until completion What’s In It For You?
